02_31_0.chapter: 第一章 体系文件控制程序
02_31_0.text:
第一章  体系文件控制程序 
Chapter 01 SMS Document Control Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 
本程序规定了管理体系文件（以下简称体系文件）的控制方法和要求，旨在控制
公司管理体系的系统性、符合性、适合性和有效性。 
This procedure is to stipulate control methods and requirements for managing SMS documents, the 
purpose is to control the systematic, conformity, suitability and effectiveness of the management 
system of the company.  
1.2 
本程序适用于公司各部门和船舶对体系文件的控制。 
This procedure is applicable to all departments of the company and ships for the control of SMS 
documents. 
2 
定义和缩写 
Definition and Abbreviation  
2.1 
受控文件：列入安全管理体系《程序手册》附录1“SMS 文件总清单”和附录2“体
系文件配备表。 
Controlled documents: enlisted in the Procedure Manual of Safety Management System, see 
appendix I General Contents of SMS Documents and appendix II System Document Equipment 
Table. 
2.2 
体系文件缩写和编号：包括文件名称（中文、英文）、缩写、编号和相关记录表格
的编号。 
The abbreviations and numbers in documents include: file names (in Chinese and English), 
abbreviations, numbers and relevant record form numbers. 
2.3 
船管部：包括船管一部、船管二部、船管三部和船管四部。 
Fleet Department: Fleet1 department, Fleet2 department , Fleet3 department and Fleet4 department.  
3 
职责 
Responsibilities  
3.1 
体系管理部经理Manager of the ISM Department 
负责组织《安全管理手册》的编写和修改；负责拟定体系文件改版计划和组织实
施；负责其它复杂背景下体系文件修改的组织和协调；负责文件修改计划的组织
实施。负责文件修改计划的审核。 
Responsible for compilation and revision of the Safety Management Manual; 
Responsible for revision plan of SMS documents and organizing implementation; 
Responsible for the organization and coordination of SMS document modification under 
other complex background; Responsible for the organization and implementation of 
Document Revision Plan. Responsible for reviewing the Document Revision Plan. 
3.2 
体系主管 
SMS superintendent 
3.2.1 
负责公司体系文件的整体编辑、整理、校对、制作和发放操作； 
Responsible for the overall editing, collating, proofreading, making and issuing of the company 
system documents  
3.2.2 
负责文件修改通知的编制和发放； 
Responsible for the preparation and release of document modification notice。 
3.2.3 
负责体系文件的回收和归档。

Responsible for system documents recycling and Archive， 
3.2.4 
负责电子版体系文件的技术支持和维护。

3.3 
船管部负责《能效管理手册》和《船舶能效管理计划》的编制、修改和实施。 
The Fleet Department is responsible for the compilation, modification and implementation of 
Energy Efficiency Management Manual and Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan. 
3.4 
船员部负责《海事劳工管理手册》和《海事劳工声明》的编制、修改和实施。 
The Crew Department is responsible for the compilation, modification, and implementation of 
Maritime Labor Management Manual and Declaration of Marine Labor Compliance. 
3.5 
公司各部门经理 
Department Manager 
3.5.1 
负责组织编写或修改所主管的程序、须知和船舶手册文件； 
Responsible for organizing the preparation or revision of the procedures, instructions and Shipboard 
Manual in charge 
3.5.2 
本部门主管业务范围内的船舶单项操作手册和船舶记录簿的编制和提供。
Responsible for the compilation and release of the ship's single operation manual and ship record 
book of the business scope of the Department  
3.5.3 
本部门主管业务范围内的船舶各种记录表格编制和修改。 
Responsible for the compilation and revision of relevant ship record forms of the business scope of 
the Department 
3.6 
主管副总经理或总经理助理 
Vice General Manager or G.M Asst. 
审核其所主管部门制定的体系文件。 
Review the system documents formulated by the department in charge of  
3.7 
指定人员 
Designated Person(s)  
负责体系文件及文件修改计划的审核。 
Responsible for the review of SMS documentation and document modification plans  
3.8 
总经理 
General Manager 
负责体系文件及文件修改计划的批准。 
Responsible for the approval of SMS documents and document modification plans  
3.9 
文件持有人 
Document Possessor 
负责体系文件的接收、保管和修订。 
Responsible for Receiving, keeping and revising the SMS documents 
4 
工作程序 
Work Procedure 
4.1 
体系文件的内容和格式要求 
The content and format requirements of SMS Document 
4.1.1 
安全管理手册 
Safety Management Manual 
1） 《安全管理手册》的内容包括：Safety Management Manual content includes: 
安全管理体系的范围；The scope of Safety Management System 
为安全管理体系编制的程序或对其引用； 
The compiling procedures and references for SMS

2） 文件内容应符合有关公约、规则和标准等的规定和《安全管理手册》要求；

3） 文件之间应相互协调、步骤连续、接口清楚、职责明确；

4） 文件用词应规范，使用的术语、名称和代码应与《安全管理手册》一致；

管理须知手册 
Shorebase Instruction Manual 
1） 《管理须知手册》的内容包括：主题内容、适用范围、工作内容和要求。
“Shorebase Instruction Manual” content includes: subject, scope of application, work

Contingency Plan

 船舶应急反应须知 Ship’s emergency reaction instruction  
 船岸应急准备（包括应急训练和演习的要求）

 Numbered for sections, chapter of the Contingency Plan: CONP-01

Energy Efficiency Management Manual

4.2 
文件编写和审批 
Document compilation and approval  
4.2.1 
文件编写要求 
Requirements for the compilation of documents. 
1） 目的明确，内容符合有关公约、规则和标准等的规定和公司安全管理要求；
The purpose is clear, the content compliance with the relevant conventions, rules and 
standards, and the company's safety management requirements.  
2） 职责和权限清楚，接口关系协调； 
Apparent definitions of responsibility and right of authority and coordinative cooperation of 
the interface 
3） 措施和方法具体（可操作），工作步骤连续； 
Concrete implementations and methods (operative), in executive steps 
4） 文件易懂，用词规范，使用的术语、名称和代码与其它相关文件一致； 
The files are readable, the words are standard, range of glossary, jargons, names and 
numbers in use shall be in compliance with other relevant documents 
5） 规定和说明对记录格式的使用和保存等要求； 
Specify and explain the requirements for the use and keep of the record format 
6） 体系文件所使用的语言应符合《信息传递、交流程序》的规定； 
The language used in the SMS documentation should be in accordance with the provisions of 
“Delivery & Exchange of Information Procedure” 
7） 船舶操作性文件的编写应遵守《船上操作方案的制定程序》。 
The compilation of ship operation documents shall be in compliance with the “Shipboard 
operations Establishment Procedure” 
4.2.2 
文件的审批要求 
Document Approval Requirements  
1） 审查核对文件内容是否与规定要求（标准、规范）相一致； 
Check and verify whether the content is consistent with the requirements (standard and rules) 
2） 审查核对文件规定的职责是否明确和落实； 
Check and verify the responsibilities specified in the documents are clear and implemented 
3） 审查核对文件规定的措施和方法是否可行、适用； 
Check and verify the measures and methods stipulated in the documents are feasible and 
applicable 
4） 审查核对工作环节之间接口关系是否明确和协调。 
Check and verify the work process interface are clear and coordinated  
4.3 
体系文件的控制 
System Document Control 
4.3.1 
体系文件的配备标准 
Equipment Requirements for System Document 
1） 公司电子版体系文件建立、保存在局域网共享文件中。公司体系管理部配备
一套纸质体系文件，并负责其修改和保存，其他部门使用电子版体系。
Electronic edition documents are established and saved in the shared holder of local area 
network of the company, only Marine department is equipped with one set of paper SMS

02_31_1.chapter: 第一章 体系文件控制程序
02_31_1.text:
程序手册                             版本/修改：3.0/9.0                           PRO-01

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.        Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 6/16 
and responsible for its revising and preserving, other department use electronic documents. 
2） 船舶电子版体系文件保存于船舶特定的电脑内。船长处配备一份纸质体系文
件。 
Ship’s electronic edition documents are saved in the specific computer on board. Master 
shall keep a set of SMS in his office. 
4.3.2 
文件的发布和发放 
Document Release and Distribution 
1） 安全管理相关的体系文件列入SMS 文件总清单；  
System documents related to safety management are enlisted in the General Contents of 
SMS Documents. 
2） 体系文件由审核人（指定人员）和批准人（总经理）签署发布，体系管理部
负责统一制作，并按本程序规定的配备标准发放。 
System documents shall be signed and released by the reviewer (designated person) and 
approver (General Manager), and centrally generated and distributed by the ISM 
Department as per the requirements of this procedure. 
3） 体系文件是受控文件，应有 “受控”标识，并使用“文件发放控制表”进
行发放控制。 
System documents are controlled documents that shall be labeled as “controlled” and 
released through “Receipt For Document Distribution”. 
4） 体系文件封面标注“受控编号”，应标明文件持有人和文件名称（见附录二；
体系文件配备表）。 
System documents are marked with “controlled No.” on the front page, stating the document 
holder and file name (see appendix II: System Document Equipment Table). 
4.3.3 
日常修改和修订 
Routine Modification and Revision 
1） 文件责任部门在文件执行过程中发现文件有问题时，应填写“文件修改计
划”，经指定人员审核、总经理批准后实施。 
If a problem is identified in the documents, the department in charge should fill out the 
“Document Modification Plan”. The plan can be implemented after the verification of 
designated person and the approval of General Manager are granted. 
2） “文件修改计划”被批准后，由文件责任部门按照该计划进行文件的修改或
修订。公司持有的体系文件由体系管理部直接修改发布。船舶持有的体系文
件由体系管理部向船舶发出文件修改通知，明确修改或修订要求，船舶自行
按要求进行相应的更新。 
After the approval of “Document Revision Plan”, the department in charge of 
document will modify or revise document according to the plan. System 
documents for management offices shall be amended and issued directly by ISM 
Department. System documents for ships updated by ship crew according to the 
notices from ISM Department stating particular step and requirements. 
3） 非文件责任部门在文件执行过程中发现文件有问题时，应填写“文件修改建
议”递交体系管理部处理。 
If the problem is identified by a non-responsibility department, the department should fill out 
the “Document Modification Proposal” and submitted it to the ISM Department. 
4.3.4 
文件改版 
Document Upgrade 
1） 体系文件改版须由公司管理体系定期评价或管理复查决议确定，由指定人员

20

程序手册                             版本/修改：3.0/9.0                           PRO-01 
Procedure Manual                     Version/Revise: 3.0/9.0                          PRO-01

根据决议要求拟定改版计划，经总经理批准后由体系管理部组织实施。The 
version upgrade of the system documents should be determined by the management system 
periodical assessment and the result of management review, whereby the designated person 
will draft the version upgrade plan. Once the approval of the General Manager is granted, it 
will be organized and implemented by the ISM Department. 
2） 文件改版时手册批准页中的版本号升级，例如由2.0 升级到3.0，同时使手册
中的所有文件页的修改号重新起算。 
The version upgrade of system documents will lead to a change in the version number. For 
instance, an upgrade from 2.0 to 3.0. In that case, the revise number mentioned in different 
pages in the manual have to be re-numbered. 
3） 文件改版时不需制作“文件修改计划”，而由体系管理部准备完整的体系文
件，经指定人员审核后，由总经理签署批准。 
“Document Modification Plan” is not necessary for the version upgrade of documents. The 
ISM Department is responsible to prepare a complete system document to be reviewed by the 
designated person and signed by the General Manager. 
4） 新版文件由体系管理部重新发放，并废止原版文件。 
The new version of documents is to be released by the ISM Department, and the old version 
will be abolished. 
4.3.5 
文件修改 
Document Modification 
除改版之外对某文件或某章节进行修改时，可采用对修改文件进行换页方式，并
在版本/修改处表明修改次数。 
For modification to a document or a charter/section (except for document upgrade version), it can be 
made by a change of certain pages. The number of times in amendment should be indicated in the 
version / revise area. 
4.3.6 
销毁与归档 
Disposal and Archive 
1） 公司有关部门和船舶收到新版体系文件后，将失效文件现场销毁，并填写“文
件销毁记录”。 
In receipt of the new version, the department in charge and the ship shall destroy the 
outdated documents and fill out the “Document Disposal Record”. 
2） 文件持有人按“文件修改通知”要求修订文件时，被替换的文件页应由文件
持有人销毁，并填写“文件销毁记录”。 
When the holder of the documents revises the documents in accordance with the 
requirements laid out in the “Document Modification Notice”, the holder shall destroy the 
discarded pages and fill out the “Document Disposal Record”. 
3） 船舶脱离公司管理时，应将体系文件移交体系管理部处理，或者由体系管理
部授权船长销毁。 
When the ship withdraws from the management of the company, all system documents shall 
be transferred to the ISM Department or destroyed by the Master under an authorization from 
the ISM Department. 
4） 除了专门规定其它保存期限的以外, 所有的体系文件、记录、表格及检查清
单应在公司和船上保持3 年期限。 
All SMS documents, records, forms and checklists shall be retained in the Office as well 
as on board for a period of 3 years except in cases where other periods are specified.  
5） 在任何法定、国家或国际法律需要保存更长时间时，应在记录上特别注明指

Protection of System Document 
1） 不得涂改、标注和损坏文件； 
Do not correct, label or damage the documents. 
2） 未经公司许可，不得复制或向外泄露体系文件的具体内容。 
Do not copy or disclose the content of system documents without the authorization of the 
company.

Electronic System Documents Control 
5.1 
电子版体系文件的发布和发放 
Release and Distribution 
电子版体系文件由体系管理部负责统一制作、上传、发送。 
Electronic system documents shall be uniformly compiled, uploaded and distributed by the ISM 
Department. 
5.2 
电子版体系文件的配备 
The Allocation of Electronic System Documents  
5.2.1 
公司岸基部门使用的电子版体系文件建立在局域网共享文件中； 
The electronic system documents used by the shore-based departments is located in the shared 
folder in the Local Area Network (LAN) of the company; 
5.2.2 
船舶使用的电子文件保存于船舶特定的电脑内，并建立由船长的共享连接，船舶
各  公用电脑均可查阅； 
The electronic documents used by the ship is kept in the specific computer. The link is shared by the 
Master and it can be accessed in all public computers on the ship. 
5.2.3 
电子版体系文件由体系管理部保存备份。 
The ISM Department shall keep backup the electronic system documents. 
5.3 
电子版体系文件的修改和改版 
Modification and Upgrade 
电子版体系文件的修改和改版控制，参照本程序4.3.3 和4.3.4 执行。 
The control in modification and upgrade of electronic system documents shall be executed in 
accordance with 4.3.3 and 4.3.4 of this procedure. 
5.4 
电子版体系文件的维护 
Protection of Electronic System Documents 
5.4.1 
电子版体系文件由体系管理部责维护，负责对船舶电子版体系文件拷贝、更新。
其它人员严禁随意修改、标注和删除。 
The ISM Department is responsible for the protection, copy and update of the electronic system 
documents. Other parties are prohibited from modification, labelling and deletion of the documents. 
5.4.2 
船长要经常检查电子版体系文件的完整性、有效性，有问题及时向体系主管报告。 
The Master should always perform checking on the completeness and availability of the electronic 
system documents, and report to the system superintendent in case of a problem.

02_32.text:
第二章  外来文件控制程序 
Chapter 02 External Document Control Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 
本程序规定了管理体系外来文件的控制方法和要求，旨在对外来文件进行有 
 效的控制。 
The purpose of this procedure is to stipulate the control methods and requirements for managing 
external documents for effective administration. 
1.2 
本程序适用于公司有关部门和船舶对外来文件的控制。 
 
This procedure applies to all relevant departments and ships of the company. 
2 
定义和缩写 
 
Definition and Abbreviation  
2.1 
外来文件：即外部文件，主要包括适用的国际公约、规则和指南；主管机关颁布的法律、法规和
通告。列入《程序手册》附录I SMS 外来文件总清单。 
 
External Documents: documents from outside the company, mainly include international conventions,  
 
regulations and guidelines applicable to the company; laws, ordinances and notices promulgated by the 
 
Administration. see appendix I list of SMS External Documents. 
3 
职责 
 
Responsibility 
3.1 
各部门经理 
 
Department Manager 
 
负责本部门主管业务范围内的外来文件的搜集、评估和发放, 填写外来文件、信息处置登记表。 
 
Responsible for collection, evaluation and delivery of external documents of the department within the 
 
business scope，fill in the External Documents/Information Disposal Registration Form. 
3.2 
主管副总经理或总经理助理 
 
Deputy General Manager or Assistant General Manager 
 
负责审核、批准所主管部门的外来文件评估报告。 
 
Responsible for verification and approval of the Evaluation Report of External Documents. produced by 
 
the department in charge.  
3.3 
指定人员 
 
Designated Person  
 
负责外来文件符合性的监控。 
 
Responsible for monitoring the compliance of external documents. 
4 
工作程序 
 
Work Procedure 
4.1 
外来文件的新增和更新 
 
Addition and update of external documents 
4.1.1 外来文件应由主管机关、船级社及其认可的途径获得。 
 
External documents shall be acquired through Administration, classification societies and other   
 
authorized measures. 
4.1.2 各部门经理按《信息传递、交流程序》的规定，搜集有关外来文件的信息，获得文件或其更新信

息并组织评估，评估活动应记入外来文件评估报告。 
 
As required by the Delivery & Exchange of Information Procedure, all department managers are   
 
responsible to collect information about external documents, acquire the documents and update the  
 
information for further evaluation. Evaluation should be made and recorded in the Evaluation Report of 
 
External Documents. 
4.1.3 如评估认为外来文件应予采纳和执行，有关部门则应将外来文件评估报告报送主管副总经理或主
 
管总经理助理审核、批准后交给体系管理部，由体系管理部报送指定人员批准。 
 
If the external documents are to be adopted and executed as a decision of the evaluation, the concerned 
 
department should submit the Evaluation Report of the External Documents to the Vice General  
 
Manager or General Manager Assistant for verification and approval. Once approval is granted, the  
 
report should be submitted to the Designated Person by the ISM Department for further approval.  
4.1.4 外来文件被批准后由责任部门负责发放。 
 
The department in charge is responsible for the delivery of external documents once the approval is  
 
granted. 
4.1.5 有效的（公司使用的）外来文件由体系管理部列入外来文件清单（SMS 外来文件清单），并保持
 
清单的更新。 
 
Valid external documents (for company use) are enlisted in the list of external documents by the ISM  
 
Department. The department is also responsible to keep the information of the list up to date.  
4.1.6 如某一外来文件的采纳涉及管理体系文件的修改，按《体系文件控制程序》执行。 
 
If the adoption of any external documents involves modification of SMS documents, it should be  
 
executed in accordance with the SMS Document Control Procedure. 
4.2 
外来文件的废止 
 
Abolishment of External Documents 
4.2.1 各部门经理按《信息传递、交流程序》的规定，搜集有关外来文件的信息，获得文件废止信息并
 
组织评估，评估活动应记入外来文件评估报告。 
 
As required by the Delivery & Exchange of Information Procedure, all department managers are   
 
responsible to collect information about external documents, acquire the documents and update the  
 
information for further evaluation.  Evaluation should be made and recorded in the Evaluation Report 
 
of External Documents. 
4.2.2 如认为公司已采纳的某外来文件须在公司管理体系内废止，有关部门应将外来文件评估报告报送
 
主管副总经理或总经理助理审核、批准后交给体系管理部，由体系管理部报送指定人员批准，并
 
修改外来文件清单。 
 
To abolish any adopted external documents in the management system, the relevant department shall  
 
submit the Evaluation Report of External Documents to the Vice General Manager or General Manager 
 
Assistant for verification and approval. After the approval is granted, the report then proceeds to the 
 
ISM Department for the Designated Personnel to approve, and the list of external documents will be  
 
modified accordingly. 
4.2.3 某一外来文件的废止涉及管理体系文件的修改，按《体系文件控制程序》执行。 
 
If the adoption of any external documents involves modification of SMS documents, it should be 
 
executed in accordance with the SMS Document Control Procedure. 
4.3 
船用外来文件 
 
Ship’s External Documents 
 
船舶技术性外来文件管理，如海图和航海图书资料等，请见《船舶手册》中的相关要求。

As to the management of ship’s technical external documents, such as marine charts and books etc, see

5 
记录和归档 
 
Records & Archive  
 
有关部门和体系管理部保存外来文件评估报告。 
 
Evaluation Report of External Documents is kept by the concerned department and the ISM Department.

02_33.chapter: 第三章 记录控制程序
02_33.text:
第三章  记录控制程序 
Chapter 03 Record Control Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 
本程序规定了有关部门对记录的控制和管理要求，旨在保证管理活动所产生的记录
能提供符合要求和体系有效运行的证据。 
This procedure specifies the control and management requirements for records of the departments 
concerned, assuring that all management records produced are in compliance with the effective 
operation of the system. 
1.2 
本程序适用于公司有关部门和公司所管理船舶活动的记录。 
This procedure applies to the records by all relevant departments and all ships managed by the 
company. 
2 
定义和缩写 
Definition and Abbreviation  
（空）(Blank) 
3 
职责 
Responsibility 
3.1 
有关部门负责本部门涉及的记录的标识、收集、编目、归档、贮存、保管和处理（具
体的职责安排见职位说明书）。 
The department concerned is responsible for labeling, collecting, editing, archiving, storage, keeping 
and handling the records in our department(For more details as to the obligations, please refer to the 
Post Description). 
3.2 
船舶负责本船涉及的记录的收集、编目、归档、贮存、保管和处理。 
The ships are responsible for collecting, editing, archiving, storage, keeping and 
processing the records concerned. 
3.3 
船管部负责贮存于网络服务器的记录数据的备份工作。 
The Fleet Department is responsible for performing backup tasks of the data records on 
the network server. 
4 
工作程序 
Work Procedures 
4.1 
记录清单 
List of Records 
4.1.1 
船舶的记录清单写入《船舶手册》第四章第01 节《船舶文件和记录》。 
The list of ship record is included in the Section 01 “Ship Documents and Records” under Chapter IV 
of the Shipboard Manual. 
4.1.2 
公司各有关部门对有关程序、须知、作业指导书产生的记录进行收集和整理归类，
制定并保存与本部门有关的“记录清单”，复制一份送体系管理部备案。记录有变化
时相关部门应随时更新“记录清单”，并向体系管理部报备。在体系文件改版后，无
论记录是否有变化均应更新“记录清单”，并向体系管理部报备。 
Records of related procedures, instructions and operation instructions are collected and categorized 
by the departments concerned. These information is established and saved in the "List of Records”, 
which is related to the department. The copy will be delivered to the ISM Department for reference. 
The department concerned should always update the “List of Records” and report to the ISM 
Department whenever there is a change in the record. After a new version of system documents is 
released, the department should report to the ISM Department regardless of any changes in the

records.   
4.2 
记录的贮存、保管 
Record Storage and Keeping 
4.2.1 
公司各有关部门由专人负责本部门记录的贮存和保管，并保证贮存环境的适宜，以
防止记录的遗失和损坏。 
To prevent the loss and damage of records, as well as to provide a suitable environment for storage, a 
assigned person of each department in company is responsible for the storage and management of the 
records of our department.  
4.2.2 
对于电子媒体贮存的记录，由负责录入的部门指定专人进行存盘备份；而贮存于网
络服务器的记录数据由船管部指定专人进行数据备份工作。 
The assigned person of the department in charge is responsible to perform backup tasks 
for the electronic media storage records. The record data saved on the network server 
will be backed up by the assigned person of the Fleet Department. 
4.2.3 
船舶对自行保管的记录应妥善保管，并列入移交。 
All records shall be kept by the ship, properly filed and listed in hand over reports. 
4.3 
记录借阅 
Records for borrowing to read 
4.3.1 
借阅公司有关部门保管的记录，由借阅人向有关部门负责人申请，经部门负责人同
意后方可借阅。有关部门记录保管负责人办理借还登记手续。 
Application for any borrowed use of the corporate records shall be submitted by the borrower, the 
records can only be borrowed with the approval of the department concerned. The person in charge of 
the record in the department shall be responsible for the circulation and registration. 
4.3.2 
船舶记录的借阅，经船长同意后方可办理。 
Ship records can only be borrowed with the approval of the Master. 
4.4 
记录处理 
Records Processing  
4.4.1 
船舶记录簿 
Ship Records 
船舶记录簿由业务主管部门负责制定，请见《船舶手册》第四章第3 节船舶档案和
技术资料管理规定。 
Ship records shall be set up by the business management department. Please refer to section 3 Ship 
Documents and Technical Information Management Measures in the Shipboard Manual Chapter IV.  
5 
记录与归档 
Records and Archive  
5.1 
体系管理部保存各部门报送的“记录清单”。 
Copies of ‘List of Records’ by all departments shall be kept by the ISM Department. 
5.2 
公司有关部门保存本部门和管理的船舶产生的相关记录，船舶保存船上的记录。 
The records produced by a department and managed ships shall be kept by the department, the 
records produced by a ship shall kept onboard. 
5.3 
船舶和公司有关部门按各种船舶记录簿中规定的保管要求保管船舶记录簿。 
The ship record book should be kept by the department concerned and the ship according to the 
requirements laid out in the record books.

Relevant Documents

02_34.chapter: 第四章 船上操作方案的制定程序
02_34.text:
第四章  船上操作方案的制定程序 
Chapter 04 Shipboard Operations Establishment Procedure  
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose & Scope 
1.1 
规定关键性船上操作的标明及操作方案的制定程序，以保证船舶获得正确的操作方
法。 
The purpose of this procedure is to endorse the indication and establishment of the key shipboard 
operations, the purpose of this procedure is to ensure an accurate operation of the ship. 
1.2 
本程序适用于公司有关部门和公司所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to all relevant departments and all ships managed by the company. 
2 
定义和缩写 
Definition & Abbreviation 
2.1 
关键性船上操作：即重要的船上操作，操作中的错误可导致事故发生，关键性船上
操作可分为特殊操作和临界操作。 
Key shipboard operation: it means important shipboard operation. A mistake in operation may lead to 
the occurrence of accident. Key shipboard operation can be divided into special operation and critical 
operation.  
2.2 
特殊操作：是指其错误仅在已造成危险情况或事故已发生时才会明显看出的操作，
如海图改正、货物的系固、船舶稳性保证、重要设备的维护性操作等。 
Special operation: the mistake committed can only be seen obviously in time of hazardous 
occurrences or accidents, such as the correction of charts, the security of the cargo, the stability 
control of ship, maintenance of the important equipments and so on. 
2.3 
临界操作：是指其错误会立刻导致危及人员、环境或船舶的事故或危险情况的操作，
如雾中航行、狭水道航行、进出港操作等。 
Critical operation: the mistake committed will lead accidents or hazardous to immediate threats to the 
staffs, the environment, the ship, such as navigation in fog and narrow channel, operation in entering 
or leaving the port and so on. 
2.4 
有关部门：在本程序中是指船管部、供应部、船员部、海务部和体系管理部。
Departments concerned: it refers to Fleet Department, Purchasing Department, Crew Department, 
Marine Department and IMS Department in this procedure. 
2.5 
须知：对正确操作的指导和说明。 
Instruction: guidelines and instructions for accurate operation 
3 
职责 
Obligation 
3.1 
有关部门：负责标明和制定与本部门主管业务有关的关键性船上操作方案。指导和
协助船舶制定公司所属船舶设备和系统的操作方案和须知。 
Department concerned: responsible for indicating and setting up of key shipboard operations plan 
related to the business of the department, and to guide and assist the ship in setting up the operation 
plan and instruction of ship equipment and system owned by the company. 
3.2 
轮机长、大副负责组织制定“船上设备操作方案和须知”，船长批准后实施。 
Chief Engineer and Chief Officer are responsible for setting up the “Shipboard Equipment 
Operation Plan & Instruction. It will be executed once the approval of the Master is granted. 
4 
工作程序 
Work Procedures 

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/3.0                       PRO-04 
Procedure Manual                    Version/Revise: 3.0/3.0                     PRO-04

4.1 
操作方案的标明 
Indication of operation plan  
4.1.1 
操作方案的标明(项目的确定)从本公司船舶种类、技术状况、航区和货种等实际情
况出发确定，并考虑以下因素： 
Indication of operation plan (with confirmation of items) is confirmed according to the type of ships, 
technical conditions, navigation area, type of goods and other factors subject to actual situations. The 
following factors are also taken into consideration: 
1） 公约、规则、规范等强制性法规的要求； 
Conventions, regulations, standards and other compulsory legal requirements 
2） ICS/ISF、《国际安全管理规则》应用指南中的相关建议。 
Relevant suggestions by the application guidelines laid out in ICS/ISF， International Safety 
Management Code. 
4.1.2 
应在以下日常管理活动中持续地标明关键性船上操作项目，并增加、删除、修改或
协调操作方案或须知： 
Key shipboard operation items should be indicated constantly during the routine management 
activities. The operation plan or instruction should be supplemented, deleted, modified or coordinated 
accordingly: 
1） 事故和险情分析； 
Analysis on accidents and hazardous occurrences;  
2） 内审和外审活动； 
Internal and external audit;  
3） 定期评价和复查活动； 
Regular evaluation and review;  
4） 港口国和船旗国检查； 
port state control and flag state inspection.  
5） 其它日常管理活动。  
Other general management activities. 
4.1.3 
公司或船舶所制定的操作方案和须知应包括以下方面的内容，但不要求一一对应。
The operation plan and instruction set up by the company or the ship should include the following 
content. However, it is not required to include every each of them.  
1） 船员岗位职责Crew position and obligation 
2） 航行和停泊值班Navigation and harbor watch 
3） 船员交接班Crew’s work shift  
4） 靠离泊及锚泊作业Berthing/unberthing and anchoring operation 
5） 船舶航线制定Navigation route planning  
6） 海图作业Marine chart operation 
7） 航海仪器和航海图书资料的管理 
Nautical instrument and nautical charts and publication management 
8） 船舶操纵受限水域航行Ship manoeuvring in restricted waters  
9） 特殊气象条件下的航行Navigation under special weather 
10） 加驳油操作Bunkering and Oil transfering operation 
11） 压载作业的管理Ballast operation management 
12） 船舶主要高风险作业(热工、封闭处所作业等) 
High risk operation on the ship (hot work, working in a enclosed space and so on.) 
13） 船舶主要工作场所工作要求 
Work requirements in the main working locations of the ship

15） 重要的维护性操作Important maintenance operation 
16） 重要的船上设备和系统的操作Key shipboard equipment and system operation 
17） 船舶应急操作Ship contingency operation 
18） 船舶能效管理操作Ship energy efficiency management operation 
19） ECDIS 的操作ECDIS operation 
4.2 
操作方案的制定 
Formulation of operation plans  
4.2.1 
如可能，关键性船上操作方案和须知应包括：职责、操作步骤和方法、应保持的记
录等。 
Key ship operation plans and instruction, if possible, should include: obligation, operation 
procedures and measures, records that should be kept and so on. 
4.2.2 
操作方案和须知的具体内容，同样应考虑本公司船舶种类、船舶技术状况、航区、
货种和船员素质等实际情况。 
The actual situation as to the type of ships, the technical condition of ship, navigation area, type of 
cargos and the qualification of the crews should be taken into consideration in the content of 
operation plans and instruction.  
4.2.3 
对于某些操作方案和须知，在国际和国内规定中有相关要求，则应将这些规定纳入
操作方案和须知中。 
There are precise requirements in the international and domestic regulations as to particular operation 
plan and instruction. These regulations should be taken into consideration in the operation plan and 
instruction. 
4.2.4 
如果有要求，操作方案中应包括对设备和系统必要的检查和试验。见《关键性设备
和系统的标识程序》中的规定。 
Operation plans, if required, should include inspection and examination on equipment and systems, 
see the requirements in “Key Equipment and System Identifying Procedure”. 
4.2.5 
所有书面的程序、须知和计划应简单明确。为了保证某一特定操作所涉及的所有常
规项目都能被包括在内，应尽可能使用检查表。 
All procedures, instructions and plans in writing should be simple and precise. Check lists are highly 
recommended so as to guarantee all routine practices are included for the particular operation.  
4.2.6 
  临界操作应强调严格的操作步骤和操作人的能力，并使操作得到密切的监视；特
殊操作应采用多种手段进行验证。 
Strict operation procedures and the capacity of the operator are highly emphasized in critical 
operation. The operation will be monitored closely. Special operation should be tested and verified by 
multiple measures. 
4.2.7 
制定“船上设备操作方案和须知”的具体责任分工及资历要求如下表： 
The assignment of responsibilities and requirements on the qualification in the “Shipboard

4.3 
船上操作方案的控制 
Shipboard Operation Plan Control 
4.3.1 
对于船舶通用操作方案应纳入《船舶手册》或《应急计划》，并按《体系文件控制
程序》进行控制，包括对操作方案的修改和增减。 
Ship general operation plans should be incorporated in the “Ship Manual” or “Contingency Plan”, 
and controlled in accordance with the “SMS Document Control Procedure”, including the 
modification, addition and deletion in the operation plans.  
4.3.2 
对于单船操作文件，如船舶保安、压载水管理、油污应急、船舶能效管理等，应单
独编写成为单项操作手册，并由主管部门负责编写、发放和更新等有效性控制。 
As to operation documents of single vessel, such as ship security, ballast water management, 
contingency plans in oil pollution, ship energy efficiency management and so on, these should be 
written into separate operation manuals. The department in charge is responsible for writing, issue 
and update the documents for effective control. 
4.3.3 
必须制定“船上设备操作方案和须知”的机械、设备或系统，由主管驾驶员和轮机员
根据设备说明书和实际情况制定“船上设备操作方案和须知”，该须知由轮机长和大
副审核，船长批准。 
All machinery, equipment or systems indicated in the “Shipboard operations plan and instruction 
development Procedure” should be set up by the Deck Officer and engineer in charge according to 
the equipment manual and actual situation. It will be reviewed by the Chief Engineer and Chief 
Officer, followed by the approval of the Master. 
4.3.4 
制定的机械、设备或系统的操作方案和须知，要张贴于该设备或系统附近便于阅示
和操作。 
The operation plan and instruction of the machinery, equipment or system should be placed near 
that equipment or system for review and operation. 
4.3.5 
船上设备或系统发生变化或新增加时，设备操作方案和须知要做相应修改和补充。
When there is a change or addition of shipboard equipment or system, equipment operation plan and 
instruction should be modified and replenished accordingly. 
5 
记录与归档 
Records & Archive  
5.1 
操作方案制定过程中产生的记录按《体系文件控制程序》中的要求保存有关记录。
The developing process of the operation plan should be recorded and kept properly in accordance 
with the requirements laid out in the “SMS Document Control Procedure”. 
5.2 
“船上设备操作方案和须知”文本文件保存于船长、大副和轮机长处。 
“Shipboard Operation Plans and Instruction” should be kept by the Master, the Chief Officer and the

该方案和须知由大副、轮机长审核，船长批准实施，并注明实施日期。 
The plan will be reviewed by the Chief Officer and Chief Engineer, and to be executed after the

02_35.chapter: 第五章 信息传递、交流程序
02_35.text:
第五章  信息传递、交流程序 
Chapter 05 Delivery & Exchange of Information Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 
本程序规定了公司管理信息交流的方法和要求，旨在保证公司和船上人员能够及时
获得最新信息，以便对有关的公约、规定、规则、标准和指南有充分的理解。使船
岸及船员之间得到有效的信息交流。 
This procedure provides the measures and requirements of information management within the 
company. The purpose is to provide the latest information to the company staffs and crews, which 
contributes to the understanding of relevant conventions, laws, regulations, standards and guidelines. 
This can help to build up a framework of effective communication between the ship-to-shore and the 
crews. 
1.2 
本程序适用于公司有关部门和所有船舶。 
This procedure applies to all relevant departments and ships. 
2 
定义和缩写 
Definition and Abbreviation 
2.1 
信息传递、交流：是指为有效运行管理体系所需要的信息的搜集、分析和处理。
Delivery & exchange of information: collect, analyze and process information for effective operation 
of the management system.  
2.2 
安全管理信息：是指涉及公司安全及防污染管理活动的各种信息。 
Safety Management Information: information in relation to safety and pollution prevention 
management activities in the company. 
3 
职责 
Obligation  
3.1 
有关部门：负责本部门职能范围内的管理信息的搜集、分析和处理；负责本部门职
责有关的通函和通电的起草和有效性评估，负责本部门通电的发放控制。 
Department concerned: collect, analyze and process information within the business scope of the 
department; draft and evaluate the correspondences and circulars related to the department, and 
responsible for the control of circulars. 
3.2 
指定人员：批准和发布公司安全及防污染方面的通函和通电。 
Designated person(s): approve and issue correspondences and circulars in relation to safety and 
pollution management of the company. 
3.3 
船舶获得公司传递的有关信息，由船长进行传达并组织实施。 
As to the information delivered from the company to the ship, will be announced and implemented 
by the Master accordingly. 
4 
工作程序 
Work Procedure 
4.1 
信息的内容 
Information contents  
4.1.1 
有关公约、规定、规则、标准和指南及其修订的信息； 
Relevant conventions, rules, regulations, standards, guidelines and information as to the revision of 
these provisions; 
4.1.2 
主管机关、港口当局、船舶检验机构等主管部门的要求和规定及最新信息； 

程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0/2.0                         PRO-05 
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                       PRO-05 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2026/04/15          第2/4页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.      Effective Date: 2026/04/15              Page 2 / 4 
4.1.3 
Requirements, regulations and the latest information issued by administration, port authorities and 
vessel survey agencies; 
4.1.4 
航行通告、气象等海上安全信息； 
Navigation notice, weather and other marine safety information; 
4.1.5 
事故通报，船舶维护信息； 
Accident notification, ship maintenance information; 
4.1.6 
公司安全管理体系运行大事记等。 
Safety management system implementing important events records and so on. 
4.1.7 
公司对船舶的指导性信息。 
Instructive information from the company to the ship.  
4.1.8 
公司内部管理信息的互相传递。 
Delivery of internal information management. 
4.1.9 
其它有助于管理的信息。 
Other information contributed to the management.  
4.2 
信息的搜集、分析和处理 
Information collection, analysis and processing.  
有关部门或人员与主管机关、船级社和行业组织等建立联系以获得相关的管理信
息，对获得的管理信息进行分析，并可能采取以下处理： 
Any information collected by the concerned departments or personnel related to administration, ship 
classification societies and trade organization shall be analyzed and managed in the way as suggested 
below: 
4.2.1 
对于即时性的信息，及时进行内部沟通，如部门内通报、部门间通报、全公司通报
等。 
Temporary information should be communicated internally and timely, such as communication 
within the department, between the departments, and in the company.  
4.2.2 
对于短期有效的信息，使用书面文件形式发布，如通电、通函等。 
Short term information should be issued in writing, such as information derived from circulars and 
correspondences. 
4.2.3 
对于长期有效的信息，按《体系文件控制程序》的规定对体系文件作必要的修改或
补充。 
Long term information should be modified or replenished in accordance with the requirements laid 
out in the “SMS Document Control Procedure”. 
4.2.4 
对于长期有效、信息量巨大并且有外来文件作为支持的信息，按《外来文件控制程
序》的规定向有关部门、人员或船舶发放这些外来文件。 
Long term information of large amount with reference to external documents should be issued to the 
concerned departments, staffs or crews in accordance with the requirements laid out in the External 
Document Control Procedure. 
4.2.5 
将获得的非本部门主管的信息通知给相关职能部门或人员。 
Information acquired from the supervisor of other department should be forwarded to the concerned 
department or personnel. 
4.2.6 
发出资料的部门应将传递的文件、资料填入“文件签收回执表”，并交接受部门或船
舶。 
The sending department shall record the documents and information delivered in the “Document 
Receiving and Acknowledging Form” and submit it to the receiving department or ship. 
4.2.7 
各部门、船舶收到传递的文件、资料后，在文件签收回执上签字确认，一份自存，

程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0/2.0                         PRO-05 
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise: 3.0/2.0                       PRO-05 
 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2026/04/15          第3/4页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.      Effective Date: 2026/04/15              Page 3 / 4 
一份返回发放人，船舶和发放部门保存回执表。 
When documents or information are received, the department or ship should sign on the Document 
sign-in receipt Form as the proof of confirmation. One copy to be kept by the receiver, and original 
should be returned to the sender. The form should be kept by the ship and the sending department. 
4.3 
信息的语言要求 
Language Requirements  
4.3.1 
所有书面信息应使用执行人员懂得的语言和术语，文字要精炼、准确、易懂； 
All information in writing should be interpreted in the language and terms that is understandable to 
the executed staffs. The wordings should be concise, accurate and understandable; 
4.3.2 
形成文字的信息资料应使用英文。但应考虑到文件使用人员对英文的理解能力；
Literal information should be communicated in English. However, the level of understanding in 
English comprehension of the concerned staffs should be taken into consideration;  
4.3.3 
船上的交流应使用普通话，特殊情况下出于行业习惯及对外交流时可使用英语。
Verbal communication on board shall be conducted in Mandarin. English is also considered 
appropriate for industry customs and external communication under special circumstances. 
4.4 
信息的传递方式 
Delivery of Information 
传递信息应选择适当的方式，如： 
Information shall be delivered in an appropriate way, such as: 
4.4.1 
电话；Telephone 
4.4.2 
电子邮件；Email 
4.4.3 
局域网；Local Area Network 
4.4.4 
会议；Meeting  
4.4.5 
当面递交。Submission face to face  
4.5 
通电、通函的控制 
Notice and circular Control 
4.5.1 
公司通电、通函由公司相关责任部门编写，经总经理批准后由相关责任部门登记、
编号、发布和发放。通函的发放范围为公司领导层、公司各部门、公司所管理的船
舶。 
The company’s notice and circular should be produced by the concerned departments. Once the 
approval of the General Manager is granted, it will be registered, arranged in serial numbers, issued 
and delivered by the relevant responsible departments. The scope of delivery includes the executive 
level of the company, all departments and ships managed by the company. 
 
编号为：QDWS[年号]XX 号; 
Code: QDWS [Year] No. XX; 
4.5.2 
公司部门通电、通函由主管部门起草，经部门经理和主管副总经理批准，由该主管
部门发布和传递，范围由主管部门确定。编号为： 
The department’s notice and circular are drafted by the department in charge. Once the approval of 
the department manager and Vice General Manager are granted, the department in charge will issue 
and deliver the information. The scope is decided by the department in charge. The codes are written 
as followed: 
 
海务部：海务部通电、通函[年号]XX 号； 
Marine Department: Marine Department notice and circular [Year] No. XX 
 
船管部：船管部通电、通函[年号]XX 号； 
Fleet Department: Fleet Department notice and circular [Year] No. XX





4.5.3 
通电、通函由主管部门每年一月份进行有效性评估，对于过期和无效的文件，及时
废止或清除，并发布有效通函、通电清单。 
Evaluations on notice and circular shall be conducted every January, Outdated and ineffective 
documents should be abolished or eliminated timely. Effective list of notice and circular should be 
issued accordingly. 
4.6 
船岸通迅要求 
Ship-to-Shore Communication Requirements  
4.6.1 
船舶与公司岸上部门之间或岸船之间发送信函、传真、电子邮件等，应标明收件人、
发件人，发出电子邮件应抄送相关部门信箱。 
The receivers and senders should be clearly indicated in the communication between the ship and 
onshore departments, such as letters, faxes, email and so on. Emails sent should be carbon-copied to 
all concerned departments. 
4.6.2 
船岸往来电子邮件应在“主题”中注明船名、名称、事项。回复邮件可以不挂原邮件
内容。 
Name of ship, item or matter should be indicated in the title of ship-to-shore emails. The content of 
original email can be excluded when replying emails. 
5 
记录和归档 
Records and Archive 
5.1 
发布文字信息的部门应将所有信息资料的原件建立清单，予以编号、保存。 
The department responsible for sending the information should make a list for the original copy of 
the information, arrange the items in order with serial numbers and keep it in a good manner. 
5.2 
船舶接收到的通电、通函，按部门进行分类保存并建立清单，标注编号、时间、内
容，类别等。按要求范围及时进行传达、发布和公示。有关的主管人员阅读后要求
签名确认。 
All notices and circulars received by the ship should be kept and classified into different categories of 
departments. The ship should make a list with columns of serial numbers, time, content, categories 
and so on. The information should be communicated, issued and announced timely within the 
requirement range. The concerned supervising staffs should sign on the list after reading as a proof of 
confirmation. 
6 
相关文件 
Relevant Documents 
6.1

SMS Document Control Procedure 
6.2 
《外来文件控制程序》 
External Document Control Procedure 
6.3

02_36_0.chapter: 第六章 不符合规定的情况、事故、险情的报告和处理程序
02_36_0.text:
第六章  不符合规定的情况、事故、险情的报告和处理程序 
Chapter 06 Non-Conformities, Accidents and Hazardous Occurrences  
Reporting and Handling Procedure 
 
1 
目的 
Purpose  
 
为了有效地对不符合规定的情况、事故、险情、险失进行监控和管理，防止重复发
生，根据安全管理手册第九章《不符合规定的情况、事故和险情的报告和分析》的
规定，制定本工作程序。 
In order to effectively monitor and manage non-conformities, accidents, hazardous occurrence and 
near-misses and prevent their recurrence, this working procedure is formulated in accordance with 
the provisions of Chapter 9 of the Safety Management Manual - "Reporting and Analysis of 
Non-conformities, Accidents and hazardous occurrence”. 
2 
适用范围 
Application  
2.1 
本程序适用于管理公司各部门及船队在生产经营管理过程中发生的不符合规定的
情况、事故、险情和险失事件的报告与处理。 
This procedure is applicable to the reporting and handling of non-conformities, accidents, hazardous 
occurrence and near-misses that occur in the production and operation management of all 
departments and fleets of the management company. 
2.2 
船舶在内审、外审过程中，发现的不符合规定的情况的报告和处理，不适用于本程
序。 
This procedure shall not apply to the reporting and handling of non-conformities found during 
internal and external audit. 
 
3 
定义 
Definition  
3.1 
不符合规定的情况：指有客观证据表明不满足某一具体规定要求的可见情况。 
Non-Conformities: it means there is objective evidence showing the non-fulfillment of a specified 
requirement. 
3.2 
重大不符合规定的情况：是指对人身或船舶安全构成严重威胁或对环境构危害，并
需要立即采取纠正措施的可辨别的背离，包括未能有效和系统地满足《ISM 规则》
的要求。 
Major Non-Conformities:  it means a serious threat to the safety of personnel, the ship or the 
environment, which requires immediate corrective action to handle the deviation identified, such as 
unable to fulfil the requirements of “ISM Code” effectively and systematically. 
3.3 
事故：系指造成人员伤亡、环境污染、船舶、船舶设备、货物损坏及其它财产损失
的事件。 
Accident: refers to the incident causing casualties, environmental pollution, damage to ship, ship 
equipment, cargo and other property losses. 
3.4 
险情：系指如果进一步发展会造成事故的情况，即事故前兆。 
Hazardous Occurrences: refers to the warning signs before an accident, in which the conditions may 
pave the way to accidents if it continues to carry on. 
3.5 
险失：系指一事件或一系列事件，侥幸没有发生或造成实际损失， 但如果环境稍
有不利或变化，或许已经造成损失。 
Near miss: means an incident or a series of incident that have not happened or caused actual 
damages, but it may cause losses if the environment was slightly unfavorable or different. 

48

程序手册                         版本/修改：3.0/5.0                        PRO-06 
Procedure Manual                 Version/Revise: 3.0/5.0                       PRO-06 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                         生效日期：2026/04/15       第2/11页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2026/04/15       Page 2/11 
3.6 
“险情”与“险失”的区别：“险情”事件如果再发展下去，最终的结果一定导致事故的
发生。“险失”事件严重程度较“险情”级别低，达不到“险情/事故”的情况，强调可能
性与偶然性。用如下事例进一步阐述说明“险情”与“险失”的区别。 
The differences between Hazardous Occurrences and Near Miss: If the "Hazardous Occurrences" 
continues to carry on, the final result will certainly lead to the occurrence of accident. The severity of 
“Near Miss” is lower than that of "Hazardous Occurrences", and have not reach the "hazardous / 
accident" situation due to certain possibility and contingency. The difference between "Hazardous 
Occurrences" and "Near Miss" is further explained by the following examples: 
 
 前面有浅水区，如果船舶再向前继续航行一定会搁浅，驾驶人员猛然发现该危
险，采取紧急转向让开，这种情况属于险情。船舶意外偏离航线驶过浅水区，
恰好因为异常高潮的有利影响而没有搁浅，这种情况属于险失。 
When the shallow water area is up ahead, if the ship continues to navigate forward, it will be 
stranded definitely. The officers who suddenly discovered the danger, should make an 
emergency turn to avoid it from happening. Such situation can be seen as Hazardous 
Occurrences. When a ship accidentally deviates from the route and passes through the shallow 
water area, yet it is not stranded due to the favorable condition of the abnormal high tide, this 
can be seen as a Near Miss. 
 
 人员刚刚从甲板某处走过，从克令吊意外掉落的货物恰好落到该处甲板上，这
称为险失；如果克令吊滑落的货物掉落到甲板上之前，人员看到后紧急躲闪让
开，这属于险情。 
A crewmember passes by the deck while cargo falls down from the crane – a Hazardous 
Occurrences; yet, if the crewmember witnesses the fall and manages to dodge away, it would 
count as a hazardous occurrence 
 
 
关于险失的例子有很多，其中包括： 
There are many examples of near misses, include but not limited:  
 
 船舶安全驶离港口几个小时后，才发现没有值守该港口VTS 或Harbor 
Master 频道; 
A few hours after safe departure, it is discovered that the port is unattended with no VTS or 
Harbor Master Channel.   
 通过再次检查，发现第一次抄写的压力表读数不正确；发现电子海图显示的
范围/雷达扫描图的范围/正在使用的海图不能有效覆盖所航行的海域，但是
没有发生航行事故； 
The first record of pressure gauge index is found to be incorrect during recheck; the 
ECDIS/radar scanning range/the current marine chart in use, fails to cover the whole sea 
area along the navigation route, yet no accidents happen during the navigation. 
 人员滑跤,侥幸没受伤; 
The crew slipped on the floor, yet without injury; 
 缆绳送出时,人员跨过缆绳; 
When the mooring ropes are being sent out, the crew walks over it; 
 在工作场所或其它禁止明火的场所抽烟; 
Smoking in the workplace or other places where open flame is prohibited; 
 船上装有chart plotter,沿岸航行时,没有在30 分钟以内间隔定船位; 
Chart plotter is installed on board. Yet the location of the ship is not plotted out in the chart 
within the first 30 minutes when navigating along the coastline;  
 当值驾驶员及水手在大洋航行视线良好时,阅读与航海相关的书,而没有保
持前方了望； 
The Deck Officer and seaman on duty are reading books related to navigation and have not 

49

pay attention in lookout during ocean navigation with good visibility; 
 压力表显示不正常,但是船上人员却在检查表上打勾表示正常; 
Pressure gauge display is abnormal but the crew marks it as normal in the check sheet; 
 从库房取东西时,库房门因船摇晃而突然关上，因距离门较远，人员没有受
伤; 
While taking stocks from the storeroom, the doors shut suddenly due to the shaking of ship. N
one is injured since there is a certain distance from the door; 
 当船摇晃的较厉害时,船员发现boatswain’s store 里面漏水; 
When the ship shakes hard, the seaman discovers water leakage in the boatswain’s store; 
 当系泊带上缆绳并绞紧时,发现缆绳被障碍物挂住,于是匆忙松掉再重新带上
When a mooring rope is hooked and tightened into the mooring point, it is found to be 
blocked by obstacles, so the rope is unfastened and re-hooked once again; 
 当修完压舱水管路,由管路通道要出来时,人员找不到出路,心生恐慌; 
After fixing the ballast water piping, the crew is unable to find the way out and become 
frightened; 
 演习释放救生艇时,当解扶索的工作还没完成时,就有船员想要松刹车; 
In the drill for releasing lifeboat, while the work of unfastening manrope is not yet 
completed, the crew decides to release the break;  
 当进港时,因为海图水深足够,而没有使用测深仪; 
During entrance into the port, the echo sounder remains unused due to an adequate depth of 
water as shown in the marine charts. 
 厨房的菜刀随便的放置在桌台上； 
The knife is placed casually on the kitchen table; 
 到甲板上工作时未戴安全帽、未穿工作鞋等； 
The crew does not wear helmet and work shoes when working on the deck; 
 除锈工作或电砂轮作业时未戴防护眼镜 
The crew does not wear protective goggles during rust removal and grinding wheel 
operation; 
 当准备引水梯时,没有穿著救生衣; 
The crew does not wear a lifesaving jacket when preparing the pilot ladder. 
 
4 
职责 
Responsibility  
4.1 
总经理 
General Manager 
 
根据重大不符合规定的情况、事故、险情的性质，决定是否委派调查小组或指定负
责调查的部门； 
参加对重大事故、重大不符合规定情况的纠正措施计划的评审。 
To decide whether to appoint an investigation team or appoint a department in charge of the 
investigation according to the nature of major non-conformities, accidents and hazardous occurrence; 
Participate in the review of corrective action plans for major accidents and major non-conformities.  
4.2 
主管副总经理 
Deputy General Manager 
 
参加对重大事故、重大不符合规定情况的纠正措施计划的评审。 
Participate in the review of corrective action plans for major accidents and major non-conformities.  
4.3 
指定人员 
DPA 

50

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2026/04/15       Page 4/11 
 
负责监控不符合规定的情况、事故和险情报告； 
负责审核、批准调查报告和预防/纠正措施计划； 
参加对重大事故、重大不符合及预防/纠正措施计划的评审。 
To be responsible for monitoring report of Non-conformities, Accident and hazardous occurrence； 
To review and approve investigation report and preventive/corrective action plan； 
To participate in the review of corrective action plans for major accidents and major 
non-conformities 
4.4 
部门经理 
Department Manager 
 
负责不符合规定的情况、事故、险情报告的初审； 
负责事故调查报告和预防/纠正措施的审核、实施情况的监控、验证和关闭； 
参加对重大事故、重大不符合规定情况的纠正措施计划的评审。 
To be responsible for the preliminary examination of reports on non-conformities, accidents and 
hazardous occurrence； 
To be responsible for the audit of accident investigation report and preventive/corrective action, 
monitoring of implementation, verification and closure； 
To participate in the review of corrective action plans for major accidents and major 
non-conformities. 
4.5 
岸基管理部门 
Shore-based management department 
 
负责本部门发生或船上报来的不符合规定的情况和船舶事故/险情的报告； 
负责其责任范围内的调查分析原因，提出预防或纠正措施并落实； 
被指定作为调查部门时，负责不符合规定的情况、事故和险情的调查、分析及预防
/纠正措施方案的审核。 
Be responsible for reporting non-conformities and accidents/near miss that take place in the 
department or on the ship; 
Be responsible for investigating and analyze the causes of such incidents within the scope of 
responsibilities, suggest and execute prevention or corrective measures;  
When designated as the investigation department, it is responsible for the investigation and analysis 
of nonconformities, accidents and near-misses, and the review of preventive/corrective action plans. 
4.6 
各部门主管 
Relevant Department Supervisor  
 
对船舶发生的不符合规定的情况、事故、险情报告及预防/纠正措施的实施进行协
助、支持、监控和验证。 
Assist, support, monitor and verify the reporting of non-conformities, accidents, hazardous 
occurrence and the implementation of preventive/corrective actions. 
4.7 
体系主管 
SMS Supervisor 
 
负责不符合规定的情况、船舶事故/险情和险失事件报告的接收、登记、监控和保
存。 
To be responsible for the receipt, registration, monitoring and storage of reports of non-conformities, 
accidents, hazardous occurrence and near-misses. 
4.8 
调查人员 
Investigator  
 
根据总经理指派，负责对重大不符合规定的情况、事故、险情的调查，查明根本原
因，拟定预防措施，防止再次发生。 
参加事故调查的人员应接受过事故调查专业培训，并获得专业培训证书。 
As assigned by the general manager, be responsible for the investigation of major non-conformities ,

02_36_1.chapter: 第六章 不符合规定的情况、事故、险情的报告和处理程序
02_36_1.text:
程序手册                         版本/修改：3.0/5.0                        PRO-06 
Procedure Manual                 Version/Revise: 3.0/5.0                       PRO-06 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                         生效日期：2026/04/15       第5/11页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.            Effective Date: 2026/04/15       Page 5/11 
accidents and hazardous occurrence, find out the root cause and formulate preventive measures to 
prevent them from happening again.  
Personnel participating in accident investigation shall receive professional training in accident 
investigation and obtain professional training certificates. 
4.9 
船舶 
Ship  
 
负责对船上发生的不符合规定的情况、船舶事故/险情和险失事件进行报告，制定
预防/纠正措施计划并组织实施。  
To be responsible for reporting and implementing preventive/corrective action plan for 
nonconformities, accidents, hazardous occurrence and near-misses occurring on board. 
 
5 
工作程序 
Working Procedure  
5.1 
不符合规定情况的报告和处理程序 
Non-conformity Reporting and Handling Procedure 
5.1.1 
报告应以适当的调查为基础，报告应包括事件描述、产生原因、已采取的措施、防
止重复发生的预防措施和处理（关闭）情况及公司的建议。 
The report shall be based on an appropriate investigation and shall include a description of the 
incident, its causes, actions taken, precautions to prevent recurrence and recommendations for 
handling (closure) the situation and the Company. 
5.1.2 
船长在监控本轮体系运行中发现的不符合规定的情况或偏离体系操作的情况时，船
长应尽快采取必要的措施，减小其危害，并填写“不符合规定的情况报告”随时报
公司体系管理部。 
When monitoring the ship system operation, if non-conformities or derivation on system operation 
occur, the Master should take immediate action to minimize the loss and fill in the 
“Non-Conformities Report” and send it to the ISM Department at any time. 
5.1.3 
船旗国、港口国检查发现的缺陷批注或滞留项目，船长须填写“不符合规定的情况
报告”，及时报公司体系管理部和船管部。 
When deficiencies and detained items are found during the flag state and port state control 
inspection, the Master should fill in the “Non-Conformities Report” and send it to the ISM 
Department and Technical Department. 
5.1.4 
岸上管理部门负责人将日常管理活动中发现的不符合填写“不符合规定的情况报
告”报体系管理部。 
The person in charge of shore base management department shall fill in the "Report of 
Non-conformity" found in daily management activities and report to the ISM Department. 
5.1.5 
各部门对船主管人员发现不符合时，可直接填写“不符合规定的情况报告”，报体
系管理部。 
The ship’s supervisor may directly fill in the "Non-conformity Report" to the ISM Department.  
when he discovers the non-conformity of the ship. 
5.1.6 
体系管理部收到“不符合规定的情况报告”后，送交报送人的上一级主管人员（部
门经理或船舶主管），进行预防措施实施情况的验证。 
After receiving the report, the ISM department shall send it to the person in charge at the next higher 
level (department manager or ship supervisor) to verify the implementation of preventive measures. 
5.1.7 
上一级主管人员（部门经理或船舶主管）收到“不符合规定的情况报告”后，应查
核已采取的预防措施的证据是否充分，对于证据不充分的，应返回报送人补充关闭
证据。验证关闭的“不符合规定情况报告”及相关关闭证据送交公司指定人员审核
确认。 
Upon receipt of the "Non-conformity Report", the upper level supervisor (department manager or

ship supervisor) shall check whether the evidence of the preventive measures taken is sufficient or 
not, and shall return the evidence to the reporter for supplementary closing evidence if the evidence 
is not sufficient.  The "Non-conformity Report" and relevant proof of closure shall be sent to the

5.1.8 
确认完毕的“不符合规定的情况报告”随同关闭证据送体系管理部保存，复印件送
交报送部门存档。 
The confirmed "non-conformity report" shall be sent together with the closing evidence to the ISM 
department for preservation, and the copy shall be sent to the department for filing. 
 
5.2 
事故、险情的报告和处理程序 
Accident / Hazardous Occurrence Reporting and Handling Procedure 
5.2.1 
“事故、险情报告”应建立在一定的调查基础上，遵循“实事求是”的原则。 
"Accident and Hazardous Occurrence Report" should be established on the basis of certain 
investigation and follow the principle of "seeking truth from facts" . 
5.2.2 
船舶发生的事故、险情，船长应立即报告机务总管，并填报“事故、险情报告”报
公司体系管理部及相关部门。“事故险情报告”应简明阐述事故、险情的过程，分
析发生的原因，说明已采取的措施、下一步的行动方案以及人员伤亡情况。 
In case of any accident or hazardous occurrence, the master of ship shall report DPA of company and 
fill in the "Accident or Hazardous Occurrence Report" in time and report it to the ISM department 
and relevant department of the company. 
5.2.3 
体系管理部对“事故、险情报告”内容存疑的，应提醒船长补充报告内容，力求完
整，并将收到的“事故险情报告”，送交岸基主管部门经理签署意见。并送交主管
领导审阅签署。 
If the ISM department doubts the contents of the "Accident and Hazardous Occurrence Report", he 
shall remind the captain to supplement the contents of the report and make every efforts to complete 
it, and shall send the " Accident and Hazardous Occurrence Report " to the manager of shore-based 
competent department for signature and opinion.  And sent to the leader in charge for review and 
signature.  
5.2.4 
岸基公司主管部门经理签署意见后，分别送交主管副总、公司指定人员和总经理签
署。 
After the opinions are signed by the manager of the shore-based competent department of company, 
they shall be sent to the Deputy General Manager in charge, the DPA of the and the General Manager 
for signature. 
5.2.5 
总经理根据“事故、险情”的性质，决定是否委派有资质的调查小组或指定负责调
查的部门对事故险情进行调查。某部门被指定负责调查时，具体责任人由该部门负
责人确定（总经理有明确指示的除外）。 
The general manager shall decide whether to appoint a qualified investigation team or appoint an 
investigation department according to the nature of the "accident or hazardous occurrence".  When 
a department is designated to be responsible for the investigation, the specific responsible person 
shall be determined by the head of the department (unless expressly directed by the General 
Manager) 
5.2.6 
被指定负责调查的人员负责对事件的原因进行调查，调查应从人、机、环境和管理
这四个要素出发。调查报告应包括： 
The person designated to be in charge of the investigation is responsible for the investigation of the 
cause of the incident, and the investigation should start from the four elements of human, machine, 
environment and management.  The investigation report shall include ： 
 
 背景情况及事件的种类、时间、地点及详细经过； 
Background information and the type of incident, location, time and detailed allegation 

53

 事件原因分析； 
Analysis on the cause of incident; 
 损失情况及事件性质；包括人员伤亡、范围、费用等； 
Loss condition and nature of incident: including casualties, scope, fees and so on; 
 其它相关信息；

 所采取的纠预防/纠正措施和处置情况；

 处置结果和结论； 
Result of handling and conclusion; 
 船舶及公司各部门和领导的意见； 
Comments of the ship, all departments and leaders. 
5.2.7 
调查报告应取得事件相关负责人和责任人的签字确认，或附以事件相关负责人和责
任人的自述材料。 
The investigation report should contain the signature of the person in charge and the person directly 
responsible, or attached with their narrative statements. 
5.2.8 
被指定负责调查的人员根据调查情况，提交“船舶事故调查报告”，编制“预防/
纠正措施计划”和对情况进行处置，并以调查报告及其它背景材料为附件送相关部
门经理签署意见后，报主管副总、总经理审阅、批示。 
The designated personnel assigned for the investigation should submit the “Ship Accident 
Investigation Report” according to the actual investigation condition, create the 
“prevention/corrective measure plan” and handle the case. The investigation report and other 
background materials should be sent to the manager of the concerned department in the form of 
attachments. After the department manager concerned sign the documents and give comments 
accordingly, these will submit to the Vice General Manager and General Manger for review and 
approval 
5.2.9 
相关的部门和船舶应组织情况处置和实施采取的预防/纠正措施。船舶由船长，公
司由有关部门负责人实施监控，确保其有效性，并应向体系管理部提供纠正的相关
证据。 
Relevant departments and the ship should handle the condition and implement preventive/corrective 
measures. To ensure the effectiveness of the measures, the ship should be monitored by the Master, 
and the company should be monitored by the person in charge of the concerned department. The 
evidence of such measures should be submitted to the ISM department. 
5.2.10 公司有关部门主管对船舶处置情况或已采取的预防/纠正措施进行验证，并签署验
证意见。部门经理审核、验证已采取的措施的完成情况，确认已被关闭并签署审核
意见。 
The competent department of the company shall verify the disposal of the ship or the 
preventive/corrective measures taken and sign the verification opinions.  The department manager 
reviews and verifies the completion of the action taken, confirms that it has been closed and signs the 
audit opinion. 
5.2.11 体系管理部将相关部门经理审阅后的 “船舶事故/险情报告”及“预防/纠正措施
计划”报送指定人员审批。 
The ISM department shall submit the "Ship Accident/Hazardous Occurrence Report" and 
"Preventive/corrective action Plan" reviewed by the relevant department manager to the DPA for 
approval. 
5.2.12 指定人员审核、批准后的“不符合规定的情况报告”和“船舶事故/险情报告”及
“预防/纠正措施计划”，由体系管理部发送至所有与之相关的部门和船舶。

5.2.13 对于重大事故的预防/纠正措施计划，总经理、指定人员、主管副总经理和体系管
理部经理应参加评审。 
The general manager, designated personnel, deputy general manager in charge and ISM department 
manager shall participate in the review of the major accident prevention/corrective action plan. 
 
5.3 
险失的报告和处理程序 
Near Miss Event Reporting and Handling Procedures  
5.3.1 
公司对险失报告采取“无责备”的原则，鼓励船舶报告船舶发生的险失事件。 
The company adopts the principle of "no blame" for the reporting of loss of risk, and encourages 
ships to report the occurrence of loss of risk events. 
5.3.2 
船舶日常工作和操作中发生的险失事件（Near Miss），由船舶各部门填报“船舶
险失事件报告表”。险失报告应对险失事件进行简明的描述，对险失发生的原因进
行分析，表明已采取的措施，并拟定防止重复发生的预防措施。 
For Near Miss events occurring in the daily work and operation of the ship, each department of the 
ship shall fill in the "Ship Near Miss Event Report Form".  The report should provide a concise 
description of the event, analyze the cause of its occurrence, indicate the action taken, and draw up 
preventive measures to prevent its recurrence. 
5.3.3 
船长要对“险失事件”进监控、确认和保存，每季度末报公司体系管理部。 
The master shall monitor, confirm and save the "near miss event" and report to the ISM department 
of the company at the end of each quarter. 
5.3.4 
体系管理部每季度对船舶上报的“船舶险失事件报告”进行汇总、分析，报公司指
定人审核后，将汇总、分析报告发公司船舶。 
The ISM department shall summarize and analyze the "Ship Near Miss Event Report" reported by 
ships every quarter, and submit the summary and analysis report to the DPA for review, and then send 
the summary and analysis report to the ships of the company 
5.3.5 
各轮收到“险失事件汇总、分析报告”后，应组织人员熟悉、培训，避免类似情况
的再次发生。 
After receives the "summary and analysis report of Near Miss Event", the master of ship shall 
organize personnel to get familiar with and train them to avoid the recurrence of similar situations. 
 
5.4 
特殊情况的报告和处理程序 
Special case reporting and handling procedures 
 
对于船舶和设备缺陷报告，按《船舶和设备缺陷的报告与处理程序》进行报告和处
置。 
Ship and equipment defect report should be reported and handled in accordance with the “Ships and 
Equipment Defect Reporting and Handling Procedure”. 
 
船舶接受外审开具的不符合规定的情况处理按主管机关或其认可机构规定的整改
程序处置。 
When non-conformities are found during the external audit of the ship, it should be handled 
according to the rectification procedure required by the competent authorities in charge or authorized 
organization.

置和关闭。

02_37.chapter: 第七章 纠正/预防措施程序
02_37.text:
第七章  纠正/预防措施程序 
Chapter 07 Corrective Action / Prevention Measures Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose & Scope 
1.1 本程序规定了公司各有关部门和船舶采取纠正/预防措施的控制方法，针对已发生的不
符合规定的情况、事故和险情的原因，确定并实施纠正或预防措施，旨在消除不符合
的原因，以防止同类问题重复发生，确保安全管理体系的有效性。  
The purpose of this procedure is to endorse the control on corrective action / prevention measures in 
response to the cause of non-conformities, accidents and hazardous occurrences, confirm and execute 
corrective action / Prevention measures to resolve the problem and avoid the reoccurrence of the same 
kind of problems in order for the effectiveness of the safety system. 
1.2 本程序适用于公司有关部门和管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to each and every department and all ships managed. 
2 
定义 
Definition 
2.1 《安全管理手册》中的定义适用。 
Definitions in Safety Management Manual apply. 
2.2 纠正/预防措施计划：针对不符合规定的情况、事故和险情，所采取的纠正/预防措施，
旨在消除、纠正存在的问题，以防止同类问题的重复发生。 
Corrective action / Prevention measures plan: implement corrective action / prevention measures in 
response to non-conformities, accidents and hazardous occurrences, in order to evacuate the problems and 
avoid the reoccurrence of the same kind of problems. 
3 
职责 
Obligation 
3.1  公司有关部门和船舶：负责纠正/预防措施的制定、报告和实施。 
Department concerned and ship: set up, report and implement the corrective action / prevention measures. 
3.2  体系管理部：负责纠正/预防措施计划报告的接受和处置进程的控制。 
ISM Department: Control of the process responsible for the acceptance and disposition of 
corrective/preventive action plan reports 
3.3  主管人员：负责调查、分析、验证纠正/预防措施实施的可行性，签署验证情况意见。 
Department Manager or Superintendent: investigate, analyze and assess the feasibility of implementing 
the prevent/corrective actions, and sign with consent 
3.4  部门经理：负责本部门纠正/预防措施计划的实施和船舶主管人员对纠正/预防措施计
划验证的审核。 
Department Manager: be responsible to take correction measures of corrective action / prevention 
measures plan self-department and audit the verification of the implementation of correction action from 
the superintendent. 
3.5  指定人员：负责监控纠正/预防措施计划的实施，必要时指定负责调查的部门；组织
对调查结论及纠正/预防措施的评审。     
Designated personnel: supervise the implementation of the corrective action / prevention measures, 
designate the department responsible for the investigation as necessary; review the result of the corrective 
action / Prevention measures. 
4 
预防措施的制定 
The Setup of Prevention measure

4..1 公司有关部门和船舶针对出现的不符合规定的情况、事故和险情，制定有效地、可行
地“纠正/预防措施计划”，报公司审核后执行。 
Department concerned shall set up effective and feasible Corrective action / Prevention measures Plan in 
response to non-conformities, accidents and hazardous occurrences, and report to the company after 
execution  
4..2 纠正/预防措施的制定应综合考虑以下因素： 
Criteria to be considered 
 事件的描述； 
Description of event 
 产生的原因； 
Root Cause 
 危害程度（事件的性质）； 
Dangerous level (nature) 
 风险几率（再次发生的可能性）； 
Risk rate (reoccurrence rate) 
 纠正/预防措施的可行性； 
Feasibility of corrective action / Prevention measures  
 实施纠正/预防措施负责人及完成时间； 
Person in-charge and duration of the corrective action / Prevention measures 
4..3 纠正/预防措施可能包括以下几个方面（但不限于）： 
Corrective action / Prevention measures may include (but not limited to): 
 公司和船舶范围内的防范； 
Within the company and ships 
 对现有的程序或须知进行修改； 
Modify the existing procedures or notices 
 制定新的纠正/预防措施程序或须知。 
Set up the new prevention/corrective action procedure or notice 
4..4 纠正/预防措施的实施 
Implementation of corrective action / Prevention measures 
4.4.1 有关部门或船舶负责“纠正/预防措施计划”的制定和实施，并向体系管理部报告，
体系管理部将验证后的计划反馈回有关部门或船舶。 
Department or ship concerned is responsible for setting up and implementing the corrective action / 
Prevention measures Plan and reporting to the ISM Department, who returns the plan after assessed. 
4.4.2 有关部门经理或主管对“纠正/预防措施计划”的实施进行协助、支持，并对实施效
果进行验证。 
Department Manager or Supervisor shall provide assistance and support to and assess the 
implementation of Corrective action / Prevention measures Plan. 
4.4.3 部门经理、指定人员对“纠正/预防措施计划”，审查措施的实施效果。 
Department Manager and designated personnel review the implementation of corrective action / 
Prevention measures Plan. 
4.4.4 船舶填报“船舶事故/险情报告”时，跟随填报“纠正/预防措施计划”。 
Ship shall fill out the Corrective action / Prevention measures Plan when doing the Non-Conformities 
Report and Report of Ship Accidents & Hazardous Occurrences. 
4.4.5 “船舶险失事件报告表”的相关纠正行动和措施，在该表栏内填报。 
Relevant corrective action and measures shall be filled out in the Ship’s Near Miss Report. 
4.4.6 预防措施的效果通过管理体系定期评价活动进行验证，请参见《管理体系定期评价和

4.4.7 对于内部审核发现的不符合规定的情况按照《安全管理体系内部审核程序》，实施纠
正或采取纠正措施。 
For those non-conformities identified through internal audit, one should take corrective actions as per 
SMS Internal Audit Procedure. 
4.4.8 不符合规定情况的预防纠正措施计划在不符合规定情况报告中填写。 
The Corrective action / Prevention measures Plan for Non-conformity Report should fill in the N.C 
Report.

Records & Archive 
体系管理部、相关部门和船舶保存“纠正/预防措施计划”。

02_38_0.chapter: 第八章 管理体系内部审核程序
02_38_0.text:
第八章   管理体系内部审核程序 
Chapter 08 SMS Internal Audit Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose & Scope 
1.1 
本程序为公司进行管理体系的内审提供了工作方法，以验证管理体系实施的符合
性、有效性，并采取适当的纠正措施。 
The purpose of this procedure is to provide auditing approaches for the company to verify the 
conformance and effectiveness of the appliance to the management system, as well as conducting 
appropriate corrective actions. 
1.2 
本程序适用于公司岸基有关部门和所管理的船舶。 
This procedure is applied to shore-based and relevant departments and ships under its management. 
2 
定义和缩写 
Definition & Abbreviation 
2.1 
有效性：是指公司管理体系实施的有效性。 
Effectiveness: means effectiveness of the company’s management system  
2.2 
例行审核：是按照ISM 规则的要求，依照公司制定的年度内审审核计划安排的内审
动。 
Routine audit: the internal audit activities arranged by the company according to the company's 
annual internal audit plan in accordance with the requirements of the ISM code  
2.3 
附加审核：例行审核以外临时安排的审核。 
Additional audit: Temporary arranged audits other than routine audits 
3 
职责 
Obligation  
3.1 
指定人员 
Designated Person(s)  
负责审核员的管理；批准《年度内部审核计划》；指定审核员；任命审核组长；批
准《内部审核实施计划》；审阅并批示《内部审核报告》；决定、批准对管理部门
或船舶的附加审核。 
Responsible for the management of auditors; approve Annual Internal Audit Plan; designate auditors; 
appoint audit team leader; approve Internal Audit Implementation Plan; review and approve Internal 
Audit Report; and decide to approve the addition audit to management department or ship 
3.2 
体系管理部经理 
ISM Department Manager 
审核年度内审计划。 
Review annual internal audit plan 
3.3 
体系管理部 
ISM Department  
负责年度内审计划的制订和实施监控；跟踪不符合规定的情况和纠正措施的完成情
况。 
Responsible for the annual internal audit plan formulation and implementation of monitoring; 
tracking report of non-conformity and the completion of corrective measures 
3.4 
审核组长 
Audit Team Leader  
组织审核清单的编制，实施管理体系的内审工作；撰写审核报告并向指定人员报告
审核结果。 

62

程序手册                         版本/修改：3.0/3.0                         PRO-08 
Procedure Manual                  Version/Revise 3.0/3.0                       PRO-08 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2026/4/15           第2/6页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2026/4/15            Page 2/ 6 
Organize the preparation of the audit checklist and implement the internal audit of the management 
system; Write audit report and report the audit result to the designated person. 
3.5 
内审员 
Internal Auditor 
按审核组长的安排，编制内部审核检查清单和审核实施计划，准备和实施审核。跟
踪不符合情况的纠正(证据)和关闭。 
According to the arrangement of the audit team leader, prepare internal audit checklist and audit 
implementation plan, implement the audit. Follow up the corrective (evidence) and NC close  
4 
工作程序 
Work Procedure 
4.1 
审核的安排 
Audit Arrangement  
4.1.1 
对公司岸基部门和每艘船舶的例行审核间隔不能超过12 个月； 
The routine audit interval for the company's shore-based departments and each ship should not 
exceed 12 months. 
4.1.2 
如果由于现有的港口、码头、移民、旅行、疫情限制而无法完成实际到场审核，可
以展期三个月。但是，应将延迟情况予以说明，填报《体系内审延迟审批表》，并
报经指定人员和总经理批准。  
In case physical attendance cannot be concluded due to existing Port / Terminal / Immigration/Travel 
/ Epidemic restrictions, temporary extensions of up to three months may be granted. However, the 
delay should be explained, fill in the< Approval Form for Internal Audit Postponement PRO-08-07 >, 
submit and get the approval from the designated person and the general manager.  
对于这种展期后的审核，审核间隔期的计算，应当从上一次审核的到期日开始不超过12 个月。 
For such temporary-extension audits, the calculation of the 12month audit interval should start from 
the expiration date of the previous audit. 
4.1.3 
公司应做好计划，避免超期。无论如何，这些特殊情况下的内审，最长间隔也不应
超过15 个月. 
The Company shall make audit plan in advance to avoid overruns. In any case, the maximum interval 
for these exceptional circumstances should not exceed 15 months from last internal audit。 
4.1.4 
每年底体系管理部编制下一年度公司岸基部门和船舶的“年度内部审核计划”，经体
系管理部经理审核，报指定人员批准后由体系管理部负责跟踪实施。 
At the end of each year, the ISM Department prepares the Annual Internal Audit Plan for the 
company's shore-based departments and vessels in the next year and reviewed by the manager of ISM 
dept. Then submitted to the Designated Person(s) for approval, the ISM Department is responsible for 
tracking implementation. 
4.1.5 
“年度内部审核计划”应确定被审核的公司岸基部门和船舶审核时间（月份）。  
The Annual Internal Audit Plan shall identify the audited audit period (month) for company's 
shore-based departments and ships 
4.1.6 
当出现以下特殊情况时，应组织对公司或船舶的附加审核： 
Additional audit shall be implemented to company or ship when special situations occur, such as: 
1） 船舶发生重大事故(对船舶);Major accident occurred on the ship (to the ship) 
2） 某轮一般事故连续发生(对船舶); 
Continuous occurrence of a general accident on ship (to the ship) 
3） 某船舶被港口滞留(对船舶);The detention of a ship by a PSC (to the ship) 
4） 公司体系发生重大变化或调整后(对公司); 
The company system has undergone major changes or adjustments (to the company) 

63

5） 某船舶体系运行发生重大不符合规定的情况时或存在严重问题时; 
When a ship system operates in a situation of major non conformity or serious problems 
existing. 
6） 内审员提出建议，经指定人员批准时； 
Internal Auditors make recommendations when approved by designated personnel 
4.1.7 
附加审核的目的、对象和范围及人员均由指定人员确定。 
The purpose, scope and personnel of the additional audit are determined by the designated person . 
4.2 
审核的准备 
Preparation for audit 
4.2.1 
体系管理部按“年度内部审核计划”安排，并结合生产情况拟定审核的时间和地
点，提出审核组人选、审核分工、审核内容等，经体系管理部经理同意，经指定人
员批准后安排审核。  
The ISM Department shall study out date and place of audit according to the Annual Internal Audit 
Plan and combine the voyage period., propose the candidates for the audit team, audit jobs division, 
audit content, etc., and arrange the audit after the agreement of the manager of the ISM department 
and approved by the Designed Person.  
4.2.2 
指定人员应确定审核组成员，指定审核组长，由体系管理部通知被审核部门。审核
员不应从属于或来自于被审核部门。 
Designated Personnel should determine the audit team members, appoint audit team leader, the ISM 
department inform the audited department. Auditors should not be subordinated to or from the 
audited department. 
4.2.3 审核组长接受任命后，编制“内部审核实施计划表”报指定人员批准。 
After the audit team leader has accepted the appointment, the Internal Audit Implementation Plan 
shall be compiled and submitted to the Designated Personnel for approval. 
4.2.4  体系管理部根据被批准的“内部审核实施计划”，书面通知被审核部门和船舶。 
The ISM department shall inform the audited department and the ship in writing according to the 
approved "Internal Audit Implementation Plan". 
4.2.5  内审员在接到通知后按照要求向审核组长报到；按审核组长指定的任务研究相关体 
系文件；了解受审部门的有关材料；确定重点检查内容，并编制现场审核清单。 
The internal auditor shall, upon receipt of the notification, report back to the head of the audit team as 
required; study the relevant system documents according to the tasks assigned by the head of the 
audit team; understand the relevant materials of the audited department; determine the key audit 
contents and prepare the on-site audit checklist. 
4.3 
审核的实施 
Audit implementation  
4.3.1 
现场审核前，审核组长主持召开首次会议，审核组成员和被审核部门负责人参加，
船舶水手长、机工长以上人员参加。介绍审核组成员，说明审核的目的、范围和依
据，陈述审核的方法，确认具体的活动安排。 
Before the on-site audit, the audit team leader holds the opening meeting, the audit team members 
and the person in charge of the auditee department participate the meeting, the crew members above 
level of Bosun and Chief Motorman attended the meeting. Introduce members of the audit team, 
explain the purpose, scope and basis of the audit, the method of audit, confirm the specific activity 
schedule. 
4.3.2 
首次会议结束后，内审员按确定的计划实施现场审核，记录发现的问题。 
After the opening meeting, the internal auditor shall conduct on-site audit according to the specified 
plan and record the problems discovered. 

64

程序手册                         版本/修改：3.0/3.0                         PRO-08 
Procedure Manual                  Version/Revise 3.0/3.0                       PRO-08 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2026/4/15           第4/6页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2026/4/15            Page 4/ 6 
4.3.3 现场审核结束后，由审核组长召集审核组内部会议，综合审核中发现的不符合项，
填写“内审不符合情况报告”。 
After the completion of the on-site audit, the audit team leader convened the internal meeting of the 
audit team, synthesize the non-conformity during audit, and fill out the Internal Audit 
Non-Conformity Report. 
4.3.4 被审核部门负责人应确认“内审不符合情况报告”， 进行原因分析，并按要求由
被审核方制定的纠正措施。 
The person in charge of the audited department shall confirm that " Internal Audit Non-Conformity 
Report ", conduct cause analysis, the corrective measures to be develop by the auditee as 
requirements.  
4.3.5 “内审不符合情况报告”编制完成后，举行末次会议，参加人员同首次会议。由审
核组长宣布审核结果。 
After completion of the " Internal Audit Non-Conformity Report ", the close meeting was held and 
the participants same as opening meeting. Audit results are announced by audit team leader. 
4.3.6 末次会议后，审核组长制作完整的“内部审核报告”。 
After the close meeting, the team leader shall make a complete Internal Audit Report. 
4.3.7 “内部审核报告”应报送指定人员审阅、审批，并应送达被审核方。 
"Internal Audit Report" shall be submitted to the Designated Personnel for review and approval, and 
then shall be sent to the auditee. 
4.4 
纠正措施的实施和跟踪 
Implementation and follow up of corrective action 
4.4.1 被审核部门负责人和船长组织实施本部门和船舶相关的纠正措施，并在完成纠正后
将收集的纠正证据递交体系管理部。 
The person in charge of the audited department and the master of the ship organizes the 
implementation of corrective action concerning this department and the ship, Correction evidence 
collected after correction will be submitted to the ISM department.  
4.4.2 对公司各部门纠正措施的完成情况应采取现场验证的方式，由审核员完成并签署关
闭，将关闭的“内审不符合情况报告”送交被审核部门。 
The completion of the corrective action in all departments of the company shall be verified on spot 
by the auditors and make the close signature. the closed " Internal Audit Non-Conformity Report " 
hand over to the audited department. 
4.4.3 
船长负责船舶现场纠正措施的实施和跟踪，并在完成纠正后收集证据，将证据以邮
件方式发给体系主管。 
The master is responsible for the implementation and tracking of corrective actions on board the ship 
and, upon completion of the rectification, collects evidence and send to the SMS superintendent by 
email 
4.4.4 体系管理部或审核员负责验证船舶的纠正措施完成情况并签署关闭“内审不符合
情况报告”，然后邮件发回被审核船舶与内审资料一起保存。 
The ISM Department or auditor is responsible for verifying the completion of the ship's corrective 
actions and signing the closure of " Internal Audit Non-Conformity Report ", and then email back to 
the audited ship, the ship should keep it with the internal audit data together. 
4.4.5 
被审核部门或船舶没能按计划完成纠正措施时，体系管理部应进行督促，并报告体
系管理部经理，由体系管理部经理报告指定人员。 
When the audited department or the vessel fails to complete the corrective actions according to plan, 
the ISM Department shall supervise and urge, report to the manager of ISM department, and the 
Designated Person duly informed by the manager of ISM department. 

65

02_38_1.chapter: 第八章 管理体系内部审核程序
02_38_1.text:
程序手册                         版本/修改：3.0/3.0                         PRO-08 
Procedure Manual                  Version/Revise 3.0/3.0                       PRO-08 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2026/4/15           第5/6页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2026/4/15            Page 5/ 6 
4.5 
内审员资格（内审员指安全管理体系和船舶能效管理内审员资格） 
Internal auditor qualification (internal auditor means safety management system and ship energy 
efficiency internal auditor qualification)  
4.5.1 
经过相关培训并取得相应内审员培训合格证书，或持有任一主管机关认可的审核员
（外审员）证书。 
After relevant training and obtain the corresponding internal auditor training certificate, or hold the 
approval certificate of any competent authority auditors (external auditors). 
4.5.2 
内审员的培训由体系管理部拟定培训人选，报指定人员批准后由体系管理部组织培
训或外派培训，经考试合格后发给相应的内审员资格证书。 
For the training of internal auditors, the ISM Department shall propose the training candidates, 
submit them to the DPA for approval, and then either organize internal training or arrange external 
training. Those who pass the examination shall be issued the corresponding internal auditor 
qualification certificates. 
4.5.3 
如需要委托公司外人员作为内审员时，须经体系管理部经理向其介绍本公司的体系
概况，提出审核的有关要求，并代为制定现场审核检查清单。 
When needed to employ external personnel for audit, it must be introduced by the manager of ISM 
department about the system summary，with outlined requirements for audit and prepare the audit 
checklist for this external auditor. 
4.6 
内审员职责和权利 
Internal auditor duties and rights 
4.6.1 
根据审核组长的安排，编写审核检查清单，实施审核过程。 
According to the arrangement of the audit team leader, prepare the audit checklist and implement the 
audit process. 
4.6.2 
内审员要积极做好安全管理体系的宣传工作，使公司的安全和环境保护方针、目标
和措施落实的到涉及公司和船舶的每一项活动中，确保安全管理体系的有效性。
Internal auditors should actively promote the safety management system, so that the company's safety 
and environmental protection policies, objectives and measures are implemented in each of the 
activities involving the company and the ship, to ensure the effectiveness of safety management 
system. 
4.6.3 
 内审员对审核区域的安全管理体系运行情况做出明确的判断，要有敏捷的思路和
审核技巧，对审核主体要有针对性。 
The internal auditors make clear judgments on the operation of the safety management system in the 
audited areas, they must have quick ideas and audit skills, and should be specific to the auditing body 
4.6.4 
内审员有权进入指定的审核区域，查阅相关的记录。 
Internal Auditor has the right to enter the designated audit area, check the related records 
4.6.5 
有权对公司岸基或船舶安全和防污染活动进行抽样、试验和演习，向有关人员询问
情况。 
Have the right to conduct sampling, testing and exercises on safety and anti-pollution activities of the 
company's shore-based or ship, and ask the relevant personnel about the situation. 
4.6.6 
有权将发现的重大问题向审核组长、体系管理部经理报告。 
Have the right to report major issues to the team leader and the manager of ISM department. 
5 
记录和归档 
Records & Archive  
5.1 
体系管理部应保存“年度内部审核计划”、相关的跟踪验证记录和内审资料。 
The ISM Department shall keep the Annual Internal Audit Plan, relevant tracking records and internal 
audit documents & information.
