02_39_0.chapter: 第九章 管理体系定期评价、监控和复查程序
02_39_0.text:
第九章  管理体系定期评价、监控和复查程序 
Chapter 09 SMS Regular Evaluation, Monitoring and Review Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose & Scope  
1.1 
本程序规定了公司安全管理体系有效性评价、监控、管理复查和船舶管理复查的要
求和实施步骤。旨在保证体系的符合性、有效性和适合性。 
The purpose of this procedure is to provided the requirements and steps for the effective evaluation, 
monitor, management review of company safety management system, and ship safety management 
system review. Intending to ensure the system compliance, effectiveness and applicability.  
1.2 
本程序适用于公司管理体系内的岸基部门和公司所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to every and each shore-based department of the company and all ships 
managed.  
2 
定义 
Definition  
2.1 
公司安全管理体系有效性定期评价：是指由公司最高管理者或其指定的人员主持
的，公司管理层领导、各部门经理及相关人员参加，就公司安全管理体系的连续性、
适用性和有效性所进行的总体评价活动。 
Company’s safety management system regular effectiveness evaluation: hosted by the highest rank of 
managerial personnel or designated person and attended by the management leaders, department 
managers and relevant parties, evaluating the consistency, applicability and effectiveness of safety 
management system of the company. 
2.2 
管理复查：是指在特定情况下所进行的管理体系复查活动。 
Management review: Refers to the management system review activities are carried out under 
specific circumstances. 
2.3 
船舶安全管理体系运行情况监控：系指由船长组织的对船舶安全管理体系在船运行
情况的符合性和适合性进行监督和控制，是公司安全管理体系有效性定期评价或管
理体系复查的重要基础信息。 
Ship safety management system implementation monitoring: refers to the captain organized 
supervision and control for compliance and suitability of implementation safety management system 
on board, these are an importance basic information for company’s periodic evaluation or review of 
the effectiveness of SMS. 
2.4 
公司各部门安全管理体系运行情况监控:系指由公司各部门经理组织对本部门安全
管理体系运行情况进行有效监控或复查，是验证安全管理体系在本部门运行情况的
评估活动。 
Company’s departments SMS Implementation Monitoring: refers to the managers of the departments 
in the company organized effectiveness monitor or review on the implementation of individual 
departmental safety management system. It is the verification of the evaluation activity of the 
implementation of the safety management system in the individual department. 
2.5 
会议：指公司的管理体系定期评价或管理复查会议。 
Meeting: any regular evaluation or management review meeting of the company 
3 
职责 
Duties 
3.1 
总经理： 
General Manager  

68

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/6.0                   PRO-09 
Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/6.0                  PRO-09

负责主持公司安全管理体系有效性定期评价或管理复查会议；批准公司安全管理体
系有效性评价或管理体系复查报告。 
Host the safety management system regular effectiveness evaluation or management review meetings 
and approve of the safety management system effectiveness evaluation or management review 
reports of company. 
3.2 
指定人员： 
Designated Person : 
负责公司安全管理体系有效性定期评价或管理复查会议的召集；审核公司安全管理
体系有效性评价报告或管理复查报告；审核公司各部门安全管理体系运行情况监控
报告，向总经理提出管理复查建议。 
Responsible for convening about the company SMS efficiency regular evaluation or management 
review; review the company's safety management system effectiveness evaluation report or 
management review report; review the safety management system implementation monitoring report 
from company's various departments, provide management review recommendations to the General 
Manager. 
3.3 
体系管理部经理  
ISM department manager 
负责审阅船舶安全管理体系运行情况监控报告，制定信息搜集和数据统计方案；编
写管理体系有效性定期评价或管理体系复查报告。 
Responsible for reviewing the ship safety management system implementation monitoring report, 
formulate information collection and data statistics plan; editing management system effectiveness 
regular evaluation or safety management system review report. 
3.4 
公司有关部门经理： 
Company relevant department manager 
负责对本部门安全管理体系运行情况进行监控或对复查的领域提出评价意见；完成
会议确定的纠正措施；处理船舶安全管理体系运行监控报告中的相关事项。 
Responsible for monitoring the implementation of the safety management system of the individual 
department or comment on the scope of reviews, completion the corrective measures from the 
meeting, to deal with related matters from the ship safety management system implementation 
monitoring report.
3.5 
体系管理部 
ISM Department  
负责、跟踪公司安全管理体系有效性评价报告、管理体系复查报告和船舶安全管理
体系运行情况监控报告的分发、接收、登记、传递和存档。 
Responsible, tracking the distribution, receipt, registration, delivery and archiving of the company 
safety management system effectiveness evaluation report, management system review report and 
ship safety management system implementation monitoring report. 
3.6 
船长： 
Master 
负责组织、实施对船上安全管理体系运行情况进行有效性和符合性监控，并填报“船
舶安全管理体系运行情况监控报告”和船舶“管理体系复查报告”向公司体系管理
部报告。 
Responsible for organizing and implementing the monitoring of the effectiveness and compliance of 
the operation of the shipboard safety management system, and filling in the " SMS Implementation 
Monitoring Report " and the ship's " SMS Review Report " to report to the company's ISM 
Department.

4 
工作程序 
Working Procedure 
4.1 
管理体系有效性定期评价、监控： 
Management system regular effectiveness evaluation and monitor 
4.1.1 
管理体系定期评价的输入 
Input of management system regular evaluation 
1) 
公司安全及环境保护方针和目标实现情况； 
Safety and environmental protection measures and goal realization  
2) 
年度内，管理复查报告及体系实施情况； 
SMS review report and implementation during the year. 
3) 
年度内，内、外审核情况； 
Internal/external audit during the year. 
4) 
公司部门和船舶体系运行情况的监控情况； 
Monitor on company’s departments and ship’s SMS implementation status  
5) 
采取纠正和预防措施的有关情况； 
Taking actions to corrective and prevention measures 
6) 
船旗国检查、港口国检查及其它有关方面的检查情况； 
Flag state inspection, port state inspection and other inspections status 
7) 
不符合规定、事故、险情和险失事件报告及分析情况； 
Non-Conformities, accidents, Hazard Occurrences and near miss reports and 
analysis  
8) 
公约、法律、法规的变化情况； 
Amendment status of conventions, laws and regulations 
9) 
船员职业健康防护、船上消除骚扰与欺凌、劳动保护及执行劳工公约情况； 
Ship crew occupational health protection, eliminating shipboard harassment and 
bullying, labor protection and implementation status of labor conventions 
10) 船员投诉与处理的情况; 
Crew’s complaints and treatment. 
11) 船舶能效管理情况； 
Ship energy efficiency management  
12) 管理体系改进的建议； 
Improvement’s proposal & comments for management system 
13) 政策修订；  
Revision of Policy  
14) 上次公司的管理体系定期评价或管理复查会议未完成事项。 
Outstanding from previous regular evaluation or management review meeting of 
the company 
4.1.2 
管理体系有效性评价的输出（结论）应包括： 
Output of management system effectiveness evaluation (conclusion) shall include: 
1) 
管理体系是否得到有效的贯彻和实施； 
Whether the management system is effectively implemented  
2) 
对相关国际公约和法律、法规的符合性； 
Compliance with relevant international conventions and laws and regulations 
3) 
组织机构和职能、岗位职责和权力及其它资源配置的合理性；

The rationality of organizational structure and functions, post responsibilities and

4) 
管理程序的可操作性； 
Operationality of the management procedure 
5) 
安全和防污染的有效性； 
Safety and pollution prevention effectiveness 
6) 
对于管理方针、目标、组织结构、资源配置的调整方案。 
Revision and adjustment plan for management policy, objective, organization 
structure and resource allocation.  
4.1.3 
管理体系定期评价、监控的实施  
Implementation of management system regular evaluation and monitor 
1) 
公司管理体系有效性定期评价每年进行一次，在公司体系内审结束后进行，
并填  报“公司安全管理体系有效性评价报告”，该报告通报公司部门和船舶。
Management system regular effectiveness evaluation is conducted every year after the system 
internal audit. The Company SMS Efficiency Evaluation Report shall be filled out and 
submitted to the department and ship concerned. 
2) 
公司各部门安全管理体系运行监控每季度一次，每季度末进行。并填报“公司
部门安全管理体系运行监控记录表”报公司体系管理部。运行监控应包括； 
The Company’s department SMS Implementation Monitoring shall be conducted once at the 
end of each quarter. Department Safety Management System Implementation Monitoring 
Report shall be filled out and submitted to the ISM department. The implementation 
monitoring includes:  
 
本部门分解目标的实现情况； 
      The realization of the department decomposition target 
 本部门对船指导、检查监督情况； 
The guidance, supervision and inspection to ship of the department  
 本部门不符合规定及纠正措施实施情况； 
Implementing status of Non-conformity and correction measures by the department and 
analysis implement status  
 本部门新公约、法规及有关规定对船实施情况； 
Implementing status of the new conventions, regulations and relevant regulations to ship 
by the department  
 本部门职能的发挥情况； 
The implementing status of department functions  
 管理体系在本部门运行情况； 
Implementing status of management system in the department; 
 对管理体系的改进建议； 
Suggested improvements for the management system  
3) 
指定人员对公司各部门每季度进行的管理体系运行监控记录和船舶安全管理
体系运行情况监控，对有效性进行评价和监控，填报监控意见。 
Designated person supervises company’s department management system operation 
monitoring records each quarter and ship safety management system monitoring report each 
half-year and give suggestions in regard to effectiveness evaluation and monitor  
4) 
船舶每年的6 月末和12 月末，由船长组织对船舶进行安全管理体系运行情况

5) 
体系管理部经理制定信息搜集和数据统计方案，方案应考虑到本程序第4.1.1

Company’s management review

02_39_1.chapter: 第九章 管理体系定期评价、监控和复查程序
02_39_1.text:
程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/6.0                   PRO-09 
Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/6.0                  PRO-09 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                      生效日期：2026/4/15           第6/9页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.          Effective Date: 2026/4/15            Page 6/ 9 
4.2.1 
在下列情况下公司应组织管理复查： 
The company shall organize management review when following happens: 
1) 
涉及安全和环境保护法定规则发生重大变化时； 
Regulations related to safety and environment protection experiencing a huge change; 
2) 
组织机构有较大调整时； 
Enormous change in the organization structure; 
3) 
发生重大事故、一般事故连续发生或其他影响体系正常运行的重大事件发生
时； 
Major accidents, continuous occur common accidents or any major incident influences system 
normal implementation;    
4) 
 公司增加新船种船舶时； 
Company adds a new ship type; 
5) 
内、外部体系审核结论表明有必要时； 
Required by internal and external system audit; 
6) 
总经理认为必要时； 
Required by the General Manager; 
4.2.2 
管理复查的输入和输出取决于复查的目的和所复查的领域，并可能包括本程序        
4.1.1 或4.1.2 所列的内容。 
The input and output of the management review is decided by the purpose and scope of review, 
which may include the content of the articles 4.1.1 or 4.1.2 in this procedure. 
4.2.3 
针对本程序第4.2.1 条所述的公司遇到的具体问题，指定人员向总经理提出管理复
查建议。由总经理确定是否组织管理复查及复查的领域。 
Designated person shall suggest to execute management review when the company in the face of 
certain problems as stated in the article 4.2.1 in this procedure.  The General Manager will confirm 
whether organize management review and the scope of review. 
4.2.4 
管理复查的工作流程，应按总经理批示，根据实际情况进行组织，并可参照本程序
4.1.3 条的酌情简化。 
The workflow of management review shall follow the instructions of the General Manager, 
accordance with the actual situation, to organize, and reference with the article 4.1.3 of this procedure 
to discretionary simplify. 
4.2.5 
总经理根据会议进程决定会议的日程。 
The General Manager will decide the meeting as per the agenda. 
4.2.6 
会议结束后，体系管理部经理总结并编写“管理体系复查报告”，报请指定人员审核、
总经理批准后发放至公司各部门和船舶，所有相关的部门和人员均应执行其中的决
定。 
The ISM department Manager shall conclude and prepare the “Management System Review Report” 
after the meeting, report to designated person for review and distribute to all company departments 
and ships once approved by the General Manager. All departments and personnel concerned shall 
execute the decisions. 
4.2.7 
管理体系复查报告的内容由体系管理部经理负责传达到公司所有管理部门、人员和
所有船舶。 
The content of the management system review report shall be delivered by the ISM department 
Manager to all the managerial departments and personnel of the company and ships. 
4.3 
船舶管理体系复查

Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/6.0                  PRO-09

Ship management system review 
4.3.1 
船舶在发生下列情况时，应组织、实施管理复查： 
In the following circumstances, the ship shall organize and carry out the management review: 
1) 
发生等级以上的海损、机损、污染事故时； 
Serious average, mechanical damage and pollution; 
2) 
发生人员重大伤亡事故时； 
Major casualty occurs;  
3) 
内、外审核发现严重不符合规定情况时； 
Major Non-conformity found during internal/external audit;  
4) 
船舶管理出现重大问题时； 
When there is a serious problem in ship management; 
5) 
PSC 和FSC 检查被滞留时； 
Detained by PSC & FSC inspection ; 
6) 
指定人员认为必要时； 
When the designated person deems necessary ; 
7) 
船长离任前。 
Before change of Master. 
4.3.2 
船上管理体系的复查应以会议形式进行，主要的高级船员出席会议。 
Ship management system review onboard shall be conducted in the form of meeting, attended by 
senior officers. 
4.3.3 
船上管理体系复查的目的是检查船上管理体系的合理性。 
The purpose of ship management system review is to check on the rationality of the ship management 
system. 
4.3.4 
船上管理体系的复查应从总体上关注管理体系的符合性（对公约、对法律、对船舶
实际、各相关规定之间）、管理体系的有效性（执行程度及执行效果），以及管理体
系的适宜性（优劣问题），同时，也应针对以下方面的管理考虑其符合性、有效性
和适宜性： 
Ship management system review shall as a whole consider the compliance of the management system 
(to the Convention, the law, the actual ship, the between the relevant regulations), management 
system effectiveness (level and effect of execution) and suitability (merits and demerits). At the same 
time, should also be considered for the following aspects of the management of its compliance, 
effectiveness and suitability: 
1) 
船员管理方面； 
Crew management;  
2) 
船舶维护方面； 
Ship maintenance;  
3) 
应急准备方面； 
Contingency plan; 
4) 
船上关键操作方面； 
Ship key operation; 
5) 
文件和资料管理方面； 
Documentation and materials management; 
6) 
船长对船舶管理的监控方面； 
Monitor on ship management by the Master;

4.3.5 
对于船上所识别的风险，船长应按照《风险评估程序》实施风险评估并采取防范措

For the identified risk onboard, the Master shall accordance with ‘Risk Assessment Procedure’

4.3.6 
体系管理部经理根据船舶管理复查的情况，组织、安排（人员）实施船舶管理体系
的管理复查。 
The ISM Department Manager shall accordance with the situation of the management review for ship,

4.3.7

部。

System Review Report" and reported to the ISM department. 
4.3.8 
体系管理部经理将管理体系复查报告交指定人员审批后反馈给船舶，并根据指定人
员的批示内容将管理体系复查报告转发给相关部门落实。 
After approved by the designated person, ISM department manager will return the "Management 
System Review Report feedback to the ship and according to the instruction detail of the designated 
person, delivery Management System Review Report to the related department for implementation. 
4.3.9 
对船上管理体系复查报告或指定人员的批示需要会商时，体系管理经理与有关部门
负责人会商确定相应措施。体系主管根据管理体系复查报告，并跟踪验证措施的实
施。措施完成后将指定人员审批的管理复查报告反馈给船舶。 
When the ship's Management System Review Report or the designated person's instructions need to 
be consulted, the ISM department manager and the relevant department heads to determine the 
corresponding measures. The SMS superintendent follows the Management System Review Report 
and tracks the implementation of the verification measures. After the measures completed, will return 
the designated person approved management review report feedback to the ship.

第十章 船舶检查、监督程序 
Chapter 10 Ship Inspection & Supervision Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
  Purpose & scope  
1.1 
确保公司准确了解船舶和设备的运行状况及现场管理情况，及时为船舶提供岸基支
持，适用公司有关部门实施对船舶检查、监督的要求，保证公司船舶的工作符合管
理体系的规定；保证船舶结构和设备处于良好状态，并满足相关公约和法规的要求。
To ensure that the company accurately understand the operation of ships and equipment and on-site 
management of the ship, to provide shore-based support in time, it is applicable to the requirements  
of the relevant departments of the company to for  the  inspection and supervision to ships, to ensure 
that the company's operations to ship in line with the provisions of the management system; ensure the 
ship’s structures and equipments are in good condition, and meet the relevant conventions and 
regulations requirements.  
1.2 
本程序适用于公司所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to ships managed by the company. 
2 
定义和缩写 
  Definitions & Abbreviations 
2.1 
访船检查：由公司各部门主管人员对船舶实施的访船检查、指导。 
Inspect ship during visit: The superintendent of departments in company shall implement inspection 
and guide to ship. 
2.2 
船舶自查：由船长、轮机长及各主管人员实施的船舶例行检查。 
Ship self-inspection: the captain, chief engineer and in-charged personnel implement the routine 
inspection of the ship. 
3 
职责 
  Obligation  
3.1 
公司有关部门积极协助、配合对船舶检查工作，根据检查报告的缺陷，协助、督促
船舶采取整改措施。 
The relevant departments of the company actively assist and cooperate with the ship inspection work, 
according to the defects in the inspection report, to assist and urge the ship to take corrective measures. 
3.2 
各部门根据船舶的情况，安排主管海务、机务总管和船员部人员上船对船舶的安全、
维修保养、船员管理等情况进行检查和监控。 
Each department shall, in accordance with the circumstances of the ship, arrange marine superintendent, 
technical superintendent and crew superintendent to come onboard for inspection and monitoring the 
ship safety, maintenance and crew management condition. 
3.3 
船长接受、配合各部门主管的检查、监督工作，督促船舶各部门和主管人员，按规
定期限纠正所发现的缺陷，向公司相关部门以“船舶检查缺陷整改反馈表”的形式反
馈缺陷整改结果。 
The captain to accept, co-operate with the officer who do the inspection and supervision work of 
departments in charge, and urge the ship departments and in-charged personnel, according to the

specified period to correct the defects found, report to the company relevant departments by using Ship 
inspection defects rectification feedback form to feedback the defects rectification results. 
3.4 
船长组织、督促船舶各部门和主管人员，按规定期限实施船舶自查并及时纠正所发
现的缺陷。 
The captain shall organize and supervise the ship departments and in-charged personnel, according to 
the prescribed period to implement ship self-inspection and rectify the defects found timely. 
4 
工作程序 
  Working procedures  
4.1 
访船检查 
Inspect ship during visit  
4.1.1 海务主管、机务总管不定期访船，对船舶航行安全、设备设施、维护保养、船舶管
理、和整体状况进行综合检查，对存在的问题督促整改和疑难问题协助解决，对船
舶工作给出指令和要求。 
Marine superintendent, technical superintendent visit ships non-scheduled, check the safety of ship’s 
navigation ，equipment and facilities, maintenance, management of ship and overall situation 
comprehensive, urge rectification of existing problems and solve the difficult . Give orders and 
requirements for ship works.  
4.1.2 访船检查的要求 
Requirements for inspecting ship during visit  
船舶主管人员对船舶的检查应以强制性法规和公司管理体系的规定为标准，以海务、
机务和船员管理检查为重点。 
The ship inspection by the superintendent shall be based on the provisions of the mandatory regulations 
and the company management system, focusing on the marine, technical and crew management. 
1) 机务总管在审批SMIS 报表和日常工作中，搜集船舶和设备维护保养的相关信息，
汇总船舶和设备存在的问题、公司指定的工作和主要的维护保养的完成情况、新
生效的公约、法规等，作为重点检查的项目，在登轮检查时进行落实或验证。 
The technical superintendent in the review of SMIS report and daily work, to collect relevant 
information on the maintenance of ships and equipment, summarize the problems of ships and 
equipment, the company designated work and the completion condition of the major maintenance, 
the new effective convention, regulations, etc., as the key inspection items, implementation or 
verification when carry out the onboard inspection. 
2) 机务总管/海务主管依据《机务登轮检查表》/《海务登轮检查表》对船舶实施检查；
要求全年至少覆盖检查表中的检查项目。 
The technical superintendent/marine superintendent, inspect the ship according to the technical 
superintendent onboard checklist / Marine superintendent onboard checklist; It is required to cover 
at least the inspection items in the inspection table throughout one year.  
3) 如机务总管/海务主管对所管理船舶的相关登轮检查项目无法在一年内覆盖，应委
托其他适任人员进行相关项目的检查。 
If the technical superintendent / marine superintendent cannot cover the relevant boarding 
inspection items for his in-charged ships within a year, he should delegate the other qualified 
personnel to carry out the inspection on the relevant items.

4.1.3 访船检查的范围通常应包括以下方面： 
The scope of the ship inspection should normally include the following: 
1) 船舶证书和文件管理； 
Ship certificates and documents management. 
2) 船舶保安和安全操作制度的建立和执行； 
Establishment and implementation of ship security and safe operation systems. 
3) 船舶关键性设备的状况和操作； 
The status and operation of the ship's critical equipment. 
4) 船上培训、应急演习、安全活动等； Onboard training, emergency drills, safety activities, etc. 
5) 船舶应急设备、救生设备和消防设备的状况； 
The status of ship emergency, life-saving and fire-fighting equipment; 
6) 船舶航行安全、助航仪器状况、货运管理； 
Ship navigation safety, navigation aid equipment status, cargo operation management; 
7) 船舶卫生、船员生活设施和伙食等基础管理； 
Ship’s sanitation, crew living facilities and food and other basic management; 
8) 船员的状况、船领导班子配备、人员素质、安全意识和责任心； 
Crew status, ship management team formation, staff quality, safety awareness and sense of 
responsibility;  
9) 船舶保养维护的整体状况。 
Overall condition of maintenance of ships. 
10) 
海务和/或机务总管人员每年至少现场指导1 次船舶应急演练，以提升船舶的应
急反应和救援能力。 
The person in charge of maritime affairs and/or engineering affairs shall conduct 
on-site guidance for ship emergency drills at least once a year to enhance the ship's 
emergency response and rescue capabilities. 
4.1.4 访船检查实施要求 
Implementation requirements for ships visit inspection   
1) 访船人员登轮后根据船舶的实际情况，填写“船舶主管访船报告”，评述船舶的维
护保养情况，航行安全状况、船舶管理状况等，并将缺陷内容填写在表中，访船
人员负责跟踪缺陷的纠正，直至完成为止。 
According to the actual situation of the ship, the ship superintendent shall fill in the "ship 
superintendent visiting report", descript the maintenance condition of the ship, safety of 
navigation, ship management, etc. and fill in the form of the found defects, the technical 
superintendent shall be responsible for tracking the correction of the defects, until completion. 
2) 船管部经理和主管机务副总审阅机务总管访船报告，并听取机务总管的汇报，对
具有普遍性的问题制定相应的预防纠正措施，通报公司船队。 
The Fleet Department manager and technical in-charged Vice-General Manager (VGM) review 
the technical superintendent visit inspection report, and listen to the technical superintendent 
presentation, develop appropriate preventive and corrective measures on common issues, and 
notify the company fleet. 

79

3) 海务部经理和主管海务副总审阅海务主管访船报告，并听取海务主管的汇报，对
具有普遍性的问题制定相应的预防纠正措施，通报公司船队。 
The Marine Department manager and Marine in-charged Vice-General Manager(VGM) review 
the marine superintendent visit inspection report, and listen to the marine superintendent 
presentation, develop appropriate preventive and corrective measures on common issues, and 
notify the company fleet. 
4) 船舶因航线一直在外、或受疫情及其他不可控因素的影响，如港口防疫要求禁止
登轮访船，以及其他外在因素影响无法及时访船检查时，可以实行远程检查的方
式，按照访船检查清单，进行相关检查，提供照片、视频等作为辅助凭证，并据
此综合评估目前的船况，填写《船舶主管检查报告》。后续一旦允许访船，应及
时访船并对远程检查给与验证。 
When the ship has been outside due to the fact that the route has been outside, or is affected by the 
epidemic situation and other uncontrollable factors, such as the port epidemic prevention 
requirements prohibiting boarding and visiting the ship, and other external factors cannot visit the 
ship in time, it can implement remote inspection, in accordance with the ship inspection list, carry 
out relevant inspections, provide photos, videos, etc. as auxiliary vouchers, and comprehensively 
assess the current ship condition accordingly, and fill in the "Ship Supervisor Inspection Report". 
Once the subsequent visit to the ship is allowed, the ship should be visited in time and the remote 
inspection should be verified. 
4.1.5 船舶主管对船舶的访船检查间隔期原则上6 个月内，特殊情况下不超过7 个月。对
于重点船舶，应增加访船检查次数。 
In principle, the ship superintendent ship visit interval should be within 6 months, in exceptional 
circumstances, not more than seven months. For focused vessels, the number of ship visits should be 
increased. 
4.1.6 船舶主管访船后，填报《船舶主管访船报告》。 
After the ship visit, the ship superintendent shall fill in the "Ship’s superintendent visiting report". 
4.1.7 船舶主管对船长反馈的“船舶检查缺陷整改反馈表”进行验证，然后反馈给船舶。
The ship's superintendent shall verify the " Ship Inspection On Defects Rectification Feedback Form " 
fed by the ship's master， And then feed back to the ship. 
4.2 
船舶自检 
Ship self-inspection  
4.2.1 船舶每季度进行一次安全和防污染工作的检查。 
The safety and pollution prevention inspection should be conducted every quarter. 
4.2.2 实施检查要求 
Implementation inspection requirements 
1) 由船舶部门长组织检查，检查出的问题和缺陷要有专人负责消除，如果需要公
司协助，及时报告相关部门。 
The inspection organized by the ship department head, found problems and defects to be specific 
personnel responsible for elimination, if the company assistance needed, timely reporting to the 
relevant departments. 
2) 部门长对检查情况分别填写《甲板部安全自查报告表》和《轮机部安全自查报
告表》。

The department heads fill in the "Deck Department Safety Self-Inspection Report" and the " 
Engine Department Safety Self-Inspection Report " of the inspection situation respectively. 
3) 开航、抵港前检查按照《船舶手册》“船舶进出港安全制度”的要求，由大副、轮
机长组织有关人员进行安全检查。检查的内容如下： 
Pre-departure, pre-arrival inspection in accordance with the "Ship Arrival & 
Departure safety Regulation" requirements in "Shipboard manual", the chief officer, chief 
engineer organize relevant personnel to carry out safety inspection. The contents of the inspection 
are as follows: 
➢ 
船员是否已按规定配齐，接班船员是否已基本掌握了本职工作。 
Whether the crew has been in accordance with the provisions of the safe manning, the 
take-over crew has basically grasp their own work. 
➢ 
船舶证书、驾驶员和轮机员的职务证书及船员所需的各种证件是否完备有
效。 
The ship certificates, the Certificates of Competence of the officers and engineers, and the 
various documents required by the crew are complete and valid. 
➢ 
货物积载是否符合规定；可移动物件是否绑扎牢固。 
Whether the cargo stowage meets the requirements; whether the moving object is securely 
lashed. 
➢ 
主机、副机、锚机和舵机是否处于适航状态，必须配备的备件、物料是否
备齐。 
Whether the main engine, auxiliary machine, windlass and steering gear are in 
seaworthiness, essential spare parts, materials are ready. 
➢ 
本航次必备的海图航海图书资料是否已备齐；航海通告是否领至最近期。
Whether the necessary voyage charts and nautical publication have been are prepared; 
whether the latest Notices to Mariners have been received. 
➢ 
通导设备是否处于正常使用状态，通讯联系有无特殊要求，有关人员是否
明确。 
Whether the communication and navigation equipments are normal using situation, whether 
there is any special requirement for communication, and whether the personnel concerned 
are clear. 
➢ 
本航次所经港口、海峡、水道的有关情况及资料, 有关人员是否掌握。Whether 
the relevant personnel grasped the relevant situation and information about the voyage call 
the port, transit the strait, channel. 
➢ 
燃油、润滑油和淡水、食品是否按计划要求添加备妥，主管人员是否清楚。
Whether the in-charged personnel are clear the fuel, lubricating oil and fresh water, food are 
prepared as per plan. 
➢ 
救生、消防设备是否处于正常使用状态,船员是否明确在应变情况下的任务。
Whether the life-saving and fire-fighting equipment are in normal using situation, the crews 
are clear with their emergency duties. 
➢ 
各应急设备是否进行检查和试验，处于正常状态。 
Whether all emergency equipments are inspected and tested, in normal condition.

➢ 
按照《预防船舶机电设备故障自查清单》，对所列机电设备进行检查，发现
问题及时采取措施纠正，并报公司船管部，寻求岸基支持，确保各机电设

5.1

02_41_0.text:
第十一章  外部检查控制程序 
Chapter 11 External Inspection Control Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围Purpose and scope 
1.1 制定本程序的目的是指导公司和船舶有序接受各种外部检查，以保证及时纠正缺陷，
避免影响船舶正常营运。 
These procedure guide to company and all ships to facilitate any external inspections, to ensure rectify 
deficiencies in time, to avoid affecting the normal shipping of the ship. 
1.2 程序适用于公司岸基各有关部门和所管理的船舶。   
This procedure applies to the company shore-based relevant departments and managed ships. 
1.3 本程序适用于船舶迎接港口国、船旗国、Rightship 检查和其它外部检查。 
This procedure applies to ships facilitate the port State controls, flag State control，Rightship inspections 
and other external inspections. 
2 
组织机构 
Organization 
2.1 公司成立港口国、船旗国和Rightship 检查领导小组，总经理任组长，主管船管副总经理
任副组长，各部门经理任组员，船管部经理任联系人。 
The company should set up a leading group for port state control, the flag state control and Rightship, 
General Manager as the group leader, fleet in-charged Vice-General Manager as the deputy group leader, 
department’s managers be the members, fleet department manager be the contact person. 
2.2 船舶船长、轮机长和大副组成港口国、船旗国、Rightship 检查或其它外部检查领导小组，
船长任组长。 
Captain, chief engineer and chief officer form a leading team for the port state control, the flag state 
control，Rightship inspection or other external inspections.. The captain will be the team leader. 
3 
职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船舶负责安全自查、港口国、船旗国、Rightship 检查及其他第三方检查和缺陷的报告、
纠正及复查申请。 
The ship is responsible for the safety self-inspection, port state control, flag state control，Rightship and 
other  parties inspection and deficiencies report, rectification and re-inspection application. 
3.2 船管部负责港口国、船旗国检查、Rightship 检查及其他第三方检查的协调、跟踪、报告
和缺陷纠正情况的监督。 
The fleet departments are responsible for supervising the coordination, tracking, reporting and deficiencies 
rectification situation of the port state control, flag state control inspection, Rightship inspection and other 
third parties inspections. 
3.3 公司各有关部门负责对相关缺陷的纠正提供岸基支持。 
The relevant departments of the company are responsible for providing shore-based support for corrective 
deficiencies. 
3.4 公司领导小组对港口国、船旗国检查、Rightship 检查及其他第三方检查进行监督、处置
和决策。 
The company's leading group supervises, disposes and makes decisions on port state control and flag state 
control inspection. 
4 
港口国检查

4.1 自查和准备

Self-inspection and preparation 
4.1.1 船舶要重视港口国的检查，船长应按照有关港口国规定和公司“PSC 检查自查项目（附
表）”的要求组织船上进行安全自查，针对自查发现的缺陷及时采取措施进行整改。 
The ship shall pay attention to the port state control and the flag state control inspection, the captain shall 
organize onboard to carry out safety self-inspection in accordance with the provision in Ship safety 
activities (SHIP-01-04) in Shipboard Manual, the relevant provisions of the port state control, the flag 
state control and the company "PSC inspection self-inspection items (schedule)" requirements, to The 
deficiencies are found from self-inspection, taken timely measures to rectify, corrected before arriving in 
the port. 
4.1.2 船舶在抵港前将自查中发现的缺陷以“船舶抵港前PSC 自查反馈表”报告船管部，船
舶应在有关部门支持和指导下尽最大努力纠正缺陷，对于船员不能自力解决的缺陷，
公司各相关主管部门应给予船舶必要的岸基支持。 
Before arriving the port, Captain should fill in the Ship Pre-arrival PSC self-inspection feedback form to 
report the deficiencies found in the self-inspection to the fleet departments. The deficiencies should to 
make the greatest efforts to correct with the support and guidance by relevant departments. For the 
defects cannot be resolved by crew, the relevant departments in-charge of the company should be given 
the necessary shore-based support. 
4.1.3 船管部在接到船舶自查缺陷报告后，应根据分类协调各部门主管人员逐项落实，应尽
最大努力给船舶支持和指导，并跟踪缺陷被消除的整个过程。公司相关部门经理和指
定人员进行监督。 
After receiving the self-inspection deficiencies report from ship, the fleet department shall, according to 
the classification, coordinate the relevant department in-charge, implement each item, make the best 
efforts to support and guide the ship, and follow the whole process of deficiencies rectification. The 
company relevant department manager and designated personnel to monitor. 
4.1.4 机务总管将处置后的船舶抵港前PSC 自查反馈表，反馈回船舶。 
“Ship pre-arrival PSC self-inspection feedback form” after disposal, the technical superintendent will 
feedback to the ship. 
4.1.5 为了获取最新的港口国检查相关信息，船管部负责每周进入各港口国检查备忘录组
织、美国海岸警备队、其他港口国检查机构以及船旗国主管机关的网站，并注意收集
船级社相关的通函，以获得有关港口国检查的最新信息，并将相关的最新信息提供给
船管部经理。 
In order to obtain the latest information on the port state control inspection, the fleet department is 
responsible for the weekly visit the port state control inspection memorandum of understanding 
organization, the US Coast Guard, other port state control inspection institute, and the flag state control 
Administration 's website, and collect classification society relevant circular, to obtain the latest 
information on the port state control inspection and to provide the relevant information to the fleet 
department manager. 
4.1.6 船管部经理应每季度结合本公司船舶的实际情况，审查公司所管理的船舶接受港口国
检查的状况，对检查中出现的问题进行分析、归类，查找缺陷造成的原因和发展趋势，
统计分析船舶自查报告、核查船舶纠正和改进措施的效果，制定措施和持续跟踪并予
完善。向公司管理的所有船舶通报，指导船舶避免发生类似的问题。 
Fleet department manager should quarterly merge the company's ship actual situation, review company 
managed ship receiving port state control status, analyze and classify the problems found in the 
inspection, find the causes and trends of deficiencies, statistical analysis of ship self-inspection report, 
review the effectiveness of the ship's corrective and improvement measures, develop measures and keep

on existing deficiencies shall be sent to NOA@liscr.com by master at least 4 working days, or 96 hours, 
prior to the vessel’s arrival at its first port of call in Australia, China, Europe, or the USA. A copy of an

2) 每一艘挂靠美国港口的船舶，都必须在预计抵达美国首个挂靠港口的到港时间（ETA）

arrival check list (RLM-258) at least 96 hours prior the calling the first US port ETA. For the 
checklist, which must be signed by the Master and the Chief Engineer, and additional information, 
please refer to Marine Operations Note 04/2025  
3) 对于挂靠中国、欧洲或澳大利亚港口的船舶，一旦确定相关地区内的某个港口为下一
个抵达港，就必须尽快提交“抵港前检查表RLM-258”。 
For vessels calling a port in China, Europe or Australia, the prearrival checklist must be submitted as

发送至：传真号码 (852) 2545 0556，或通过电子邮件发送至 ss_css@mardep.gov.hk。 
Before a Hong Kong-registered ship enters the waters of the United States or Australia, the 
master shall conduct a self-inspection and complete the "PSC Checklist for Hong Kong 
Registered Ships", submit it to the technical superintendent, and after it is signed by the 
designated person (or an alternate), the technical superintendent shall submit it to the 
Marine Department of Hong Kong.  
Send to: Fax number (852) 2545 0556, or by email to ss_css@mardep.gov.hk. 
2) 船舶拟驶入美国或澳大利亚港口时，本检查表应至少每三个月填写一次。若船舶在过
去十二个月内曾被港口国监督（PSC）滞留，则填写间隔应至少为每月一次。 
This checklist shall be completed at least once every three (3) months when a ship is to 
enter a US or Australian port. For a ship with PSC detention record in the last twelve (12) 
months, the interval shall be at least once every month.

4.2 接受检查 
Acceptance Inspection 
4.2.1 船舶抵港后，在没有接受港口国检查前，船长应严格控制船员离船，保证有足够的且
适当人员配合港口国官员的检查。 
After the ship arrival port, before accepting the port state control inspection, the master shall strictly 
control the crew from leaving the ship and to ensure have sufficient and appropriate personnel to 
cooperate with the port state control inspector inspection. 
4.2.2 船舶在接到港口国检查的通知或港口国检查官已经登轮时，必须以最快捷的方式立即
通知该轮机务总管。机务总管应在整个受检期间给予实时跟踪，及时了解受检进展及
提供相应的指导、支持。机务总管视检查情况，可不受时间等条件限制，随时通报公
司检查领导小组。 
The ship shall, in the event of receive a notice of a port state control inspection or when the port state 
control officers has boarded, must promptly notify the in-charged technical superintendent of the ship. 
Technical superintendent should be real-time tracking in the entire inspection period, timely 
understanding of the inspection progress and provide the appropriate guidance and support. The 
technical superintendent review the situation, not be limited by time and other conditions, notify the 
company inspection leading group at any time. 
4.2.3 在接受检查期间，船长应按实际情况向PSC 检查官声明已知缺陷，以及公司和船舶所
采取的应对措施。 
During the inspection period, the captain shall be according to the actual situation, declare the known 
deficiencies to the PSC officers and the measures taken by the company and the ship. 
4.2.4 船长、轮机长要全程陪同并协助检查。如果有多个检查官同时检查时，轮机长和轮机
员陪同检查轮机部，船长、大副和驾驶员陪同检查甲板部。陪同人员要积极主动地与
检查官员进行沟通和交流。必要时，船长可决定增加其他人员陪同并协助检查。船长
应安排专人在驾驶台值守，以保持与机务总管的联系，及时报告受检进展及查出的缺
陷情况。 
The captain, chief engineer shall accompany the whole process and assist during the inspection. If more 
than one PSCO checking at the same time, the chief engineer and the engineers accompany inspection in 
the engine room, the captain, chief officer and officers accompany inspection on deck. Accompanying 
personnel should actively communicate and exchange with the PSCO. If necessary, the master may 
decide to add other personnel to accompany and assist the inspection. The master should arrange the 
person to be on duty at the bridge to keep in touch with the technical superintendent, and timely report 
the inspection progress and the deficiencies found. 
4.2.5 对于检查官指出的缺陷，船方应现场尽快采取整改措施，争取在检查官离船前解决。
如检查官员提出导致船舶被滞留的项目，船长和船员应尽力进行解释和协商，并积极
采取措施整改，同时立即报告机务总管。 
For the deficiencies found by the PSCO, shall take on-site corrective action as soon as possible, and 
strive to rectify before the PSCO leaves the ship. If the PSCO found items that causes the ship to be 
detained, the master and the crew shall endeavor to explain and negotiate, and take actively measures to 
rectify, and immediately report to the technical superintendent. 
4.2.6 一旦检查官员提出可导致滞留的缺陷，或表示船舶将被滞留，船长除应与检查官努力
沟通外，应立即报告机务总管。机务总管将检查的情况立即报告公司检查领导小组或
联系人（船管部经理）。领导小组应尽快反应，调动所有资源协助船舶做好现场处置，
力争避免船舶被滞留，并遵照主管机关的指示积极采取措施整改和补救。 
Once the PSCO found a deficiency which may result in detention, or indicates that the ship is to be

4.2.7 如果检查官坚持滞留船舶，船长应就检查官提出的滞留缺陷和依据相应的公约、法规
逐条核实并合理解释。如条件允许，应尽可能通过拍照、录像等方式采集证据，以备
将来公司报告主管机关，或向港口国检查机构提出申诉之用。 
If the PSCO insists to detain the ship, the master shall verify and explain every detention deficiency 
proposed by the PSCO, and on the basis of the corresponding convention and regulations. If conditions 
permit, as far as possible through the camera photo, video, etc. to collect evidence, for company report to 
the Administration in the future, or to file an appeal to the port State inspection authority. 
4.2.8 对于航行途中出现的设备意外故障，可能影响到船舶安全或可能出现港口国检查的缺
陷时，船长应通知公司相关部门的负责主管, 参考《船舶和设备的报告与处理程序》
填写船舶和设备缺陷报告与处理记录表；并保留好公司岸基支持的相关文件、函件、
邮件，在检查时，提供给检查人员作为证明资料。 
For the sudden failure of the equipments occurring during navigation, may affect the safety of the ship or 
may cause deficiencies of port state control inspection, the master shall notify technical superintendent 
of the company relevant department in-charge; fill in the Ship and Equipment Defect Report and 
Handling Record as to Ships and Equipment Defect Reporting and Handling Procedure, and preserve 
the relevant documents, correspondence, mails of company shore-based support, provided to the 
inspectors as a proof of information. 
4.3 受检后的处理 
After inspection handling 
4.3.1 检查结束后，船长应立即将检查官开具的检查报告以电话方式提前通报主管人员，然
后用传真或邮件形式发送到公司，同时按检查报告的要求尽快采取措施纠正缺陷。公
司相关部门应根据需要与主管机关或船级社联系，向船舶提供支持，协调解决问题。 
Upon completion of the inspection, the master shall promptly inform the in-charged person about the 
inspection report issued by the PSCO by telephone, send it to the company by fax or e-mail, and take 
measures as soon as possible to correct the deficiencies as required by the report. The Company relevant 
departments shall, in accordance with the needs, contact the Administration or the classification society, 
to provide support to the ship, coordinate to solve the problems. 
4.3.2 机务总管收到港口国检查报告后应及时与相关部门进行沟通，落实纠正措施并报告本
部门经理。 
After receiving the port state control inspection report, the technical superintendent should communicate 
with the relevant departments in time, to implement the corrective measures and report to the department 
manager. 
4.3.3 公司有关部门在接到机务总管通知后，应尽快指导船舶纠正缺陷，并给予全力的支持。 
The relevant departments of the Company shall, after receiving the notice from the technical 
superintendent, guide the ship to rectify the deficiencies as soon as possible and give full support. 
4.3.4 船舶完成缺陷项目的纠正后，应按检查官的要求申请港口国当局复查或向有关当局报
告。申请和报告均应抄送船管部。 
After completed the defect rectification, it shall apply to the port authorities for re-inspection or report to 
the relevant authorities at the request of the PSCO. Application and report shall be copied to the fleet

Report 
4.4.1 检查结束后，船长应进行总结，分析出现缺陷的原因，并总结、分析当地港口国检查

fleet departments.

Technical department and ISM department. 
4.4.3 巴拿马籍船舶，在PSC 检查结束后，立即将所有的PSC 报告文件报给船管部，并由船
管部将PSC 检查报告发送给船旗国PSC 部门（psc@amp.gob.pa）；对于检查中发现的缺陷，

发送巴拿马海事机构，收到回执后机务总管应及时转送船上存档。巴拿马PSC 检查报告
递送地址：psc@amp.gob.pa 
After the inspection, all PSC inspection reports shall be sent immediately to company fleet department, the 
corrective actions taken by the vessel shall be sent as soon as possible to company using the format 
“Correction of Deficiencies Reports”Form (F-27). reviewed by the technical superintendent and then 
forward to Marine authority of Panama. After received the receipt, the technical superintendent should 
timely forward onboard achieve. The Panama PSC Inspection Report Email Address: psc@amp.gob.pa 
4.4.4 利比里亚旗船舶Ship flying Liberia flag 
1) 利比里亚籍船舶PSC检查结束后，根据船旗国通函PSC-01要求，应将所有检查报告尽
快发送公司，由公司在PSC 检查结束48 小时内递交到船旗国船队绩效部门
（PSCfollowup@liscr.com）。 
For ship flying Liberia flag, based on the requirements of Marine Notice PSC-01, All the inspection 
reports should be sent to the company as soon as possible after the PSC inspection. The company 
should report to the fleet performance department of the flag State administration within 48 hours of 
the PSC inspection. （PSCfollowup@liscr.com） 
2) 若被滞留，在向公司报告的同时，须第一时间报告船旗国主管部门值班人员
（dutyofficer@liscr.com）和船队绩效部门（prevention@liscr.com），同时发送一份PSC
检查报告。 
If detained, report to the company immediately, at the same time, send an immediate notification to the 
Administration’s Duty Officer at DutyOfficer@liscr.com and the Fleet Performance Department at 
Prevention@liscr.com and a copy of the PSC inspection report shall be sent at the same time. 
3) 任何被港口国检查中开出缺陷，船旗国主管部门要求尽快报告整改行动（CAR）到
PSCfollowup@liscr.com邮箱，从检查日期起最迟不超过7天。 
If deficiencies are found during the inspection, the Administration requires submission of a Corrective

2) 根据公司发船检查单，组织全船人员进行一次自查，及时发现问题，每个问题都要

Early report the defect which could not be correct to fleet department, fleet department puts forward 
solutions. 
6.1.3 其他第三方的检查，船管部也应该尽早通知船舶，提供有效的指导。 
If have other third inspection, the fleet department should also early inform the vessel, and give them 
effective guidance.  
6.2 接受检查    
Acceptance Inspection 
6.2.1 在进行Rightship 检查时，船管部尽可能安排人员陪同检查，陪同人员应积极主动和检
察官进行沟通和交流。如果缺少某些文件可以当场请公司提供给船舶，也可以对相同
类型的缺陷请检查官合并成一项缺陷，减少缺陷的数量。 
During the period of Rightship inspection, the fleet department should send personnel on board to assist 
as far as possible, the accompanying person shall take the initiative to communicate with the prosecutor. 
If some documents are missing, he can ask the company to provide them to the ship on the spot. He can 
also ask the inspector to combine the same type of defects into one defect to reduce the number of 
defects. 
6.2.2 在进行Rightship 检查时，船长应安排轮机长和大副及相关人员一起陪同并协助检查，
对可以纠正的缺陷马上安排整改。  
When conducting a Rightship inspection, the master shall arrange for the chief engineer, chief officer 
and relevant personnel to accompany and assist in the inspection and immediately arrange rectification 
of any defects that can be corrected.

6.2.3 其他第三方的检查，船长应安排合适的人员陪同检查。 
For other third party inspection, the master should also arrange appropriate personnel to accompany the 
inspection. 
6.3 受检后的处理   After inspection handling 
6.3.1 Rightship 检查结束后船长应将完成整改的缺陷及时报告给检察官，力争不要再列出，
也应该积极向检察官了解想要列出的缺陷，力求减少缺陷数量，尽可能将相同类型的
缺陷协商合并为一项，尽最大努力减少遗留的缺陷，并尽可能遗留一些比较容易改正
的缺陷。 
After completing the Rightship inspection, the captain should report timely to the inspector about the 
rectification of deficiencies, strive to don't list, the captain should also be positive and know the 
deficiencies that the inspector want to list, makes every effort to reduce the number of deficiencies, as far 
as possible to the same type of deficiencies consultation as a combined, will try his best to minimize the 
left deficiencies, and some relatively easy to correct the deficiencies of legacy as much as possible. 
6.3.2 其他第三方的检查结束后，船长也应积极主动地和检查人员核对检查缺陷，减少缺陷
的数量，落实整改和反馈要求。 
The inspection by other third parties is completed, the captain should also take the initiative to verify the 
deficiencies with the inspectors, reduce the number of deficiencies, implement rectification and feedback 
requirements. 
6.3.3 检查结束后，船长应尽快将检查官开具的缺陷报告以电话方式提前通报主管人员，然
后用传真或邮件形式发送到公司。 
Upon completion of the inspection, the master shall inform the in-charged person about the inspection 
report being issued by the inspector by telephone as soon as possible, send it to the company by fax or 
e-mail. 
6.4 报告  Report 
6.4.1  Rightship 检查全部结束后，船长应尽快将检查官开具的缺陷以电话方式提前报告主管
人员，然后用传真或邮件形式发送到公司船管部。也应尽快根据检查官的要求进行整
改，完成整改后按照要求格式填写纠正报告发给机务总管，机务总管尽快将船上的缺
陷纠正报告整理并递交给dryinspections@rightship.com，超过15 天检查作废。 
After the Rightship inspection is completed, the captain should report the deficiencies to the 
superintendent by telephone as soon as possible, make rectification according to the requirements of the 
inspector. After completing the rectification, the captain should fill in the rectification report in the 
required format and send the rectification evidence to the technical superintendent. The technical 
superintendent 
should 
organize 
the 
rectification 
report 
on 
the 
ship 
and 
submit 
it 
to 
dryinspections@rightship.com as soon as possible, more than 15 days for the inspection to be invalid. 
6.4.2 其他第三方的检查也应报告机务总管，根据检查要求将整改结果告知相关方。 
The inspection of other third parties shall also be reported to the technical superintendent and the 
rectification result shall be notified to the relevant party according to the inspection requirements. 
 
7 
记录和归档 
Records and archives 
7.1 船管部和船舶保留船舶抵港前PSC 自查反馈表、检查报告和整改记录。 
Fleet departments and ship retain Ship Pre-arrival PSC self-inspection feedback form and "inspection 
report". 
7.2 船管部和船舶保留船舶接受PSC 检查报告表，体系管理部和船舶保留不符合规定的情况
报告表。

02_42_0.text:
第十二章  人力资源控制程序 
Chapter 12 Human Resources Control Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose and scope 
1.1 对承担管理体系职责的人员规定其相应岗位的能力要求，通过教育、培训、招聘和管
理以满足熟悉职责的要求。 
To meet the requirements of the competencies of the staff responsible for the management system, through 
education, training, recruitment and management. 
1.2 适用于公司管理体系内职责的所有人员。 
Applicable to all personnel within the company's management system. 
2 
定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
2.1 新聘人员：是指原来不在公司安全管理体系内的某岗位工作（包括在本公司但不在体
系内工作）新到体系内某岗位任职的人员。 
New recruits: refers to the staff has not worked in any position of company safety management system 
( including working in the company but not within the system), newly join a position in the system. 
2.2 转岗人员：指原来在公司安全管理体系内的某岗位工作，新调至体系内的另一岗位工
作的人员，包括职务晋升人员。 
Job transfer staff: refers to the staff had worked within the safety management system, transferred to 
another post within the system, including job promotion staff. 
2.3 新员工：既安全管理体系内的新聘人员。 
New employee: New staff in the safety management system. 
2.4 熟悉职责：是指熟悉岗位职责，熟悉相关管理程序、操作方案和须知，熟悉工作环境，
熟悉安全管理相关法规、规则和指南等。 
Familiar with the duties: refers to be familiar with job duties, familiar with the relevant management 
procedures, operating procedures and instruction, familiar with the working environment, familiar with 
relevant safety management regulations, rules and guidelines. 
3 
职责 
Duties 
3.1 责任部门负责编制机关员工岗位职责，交相关部门实施培训。 
Responsible departments responsible for the preparation of employee positions duties, submit to the 
relevant departments to implement the training. 
3.2 体系管理部制定岸基员工年度体系培训计划并组织实施培训工作，对培训效果进行评
价。负责对公司新聘、转岗人员进行安全管理体系培训。 
The ISM department to establish the shore-based employee annual system training program and organize 
the implementation of training works, evaluation on the training effectiveness. Responsible for conducting 
the safety management system training to company's new staffand transfer staff. 
3.3 船员部制定船员上船前的培训计划，根据计划由公司各部门实施培训。 
The crew department develops a crew training plan before boarding, according to the plan to implement 
the training by various departments of the company.  
3.4 船员部负责船员的资格及能力审核、船员培训控制、船员调配等。详见《船员培训控制
程序》、《船长和船员的审核调配程序》和《船员管理办法》。 
The crew department is responsible for the review of seafarers qualification and capacity, crew training 
control, crew deployment, etc. Detail see Crew Training Control Procedures, Master & Crew Assignment

Evaluation Procedure and Crew Management Regulation . 
3.5 船长按照年度计划，负责组织和实施对在船人员的安全管理体系培训。 
The captain, in accordance with the annual plan, is responsible for organizing and implementing the safety 
management system training of the onboard crew. 
3.6 各有关部门负责对新员工、新聘、转岗人员等进行相关业务培训，以保证其熟悉职责。 
The relevant departments are responsible for the related training of new recruits, new staff, transfer staff, 
etc. to ensure that they are familiar with their duties. 
3.7 总经理负责批准陆地员工招聘计划、人员录用，定岗。确定公司机关员工年度培训计划
等。 
The General Manager GM is responsible for approving the shore-based employee recruitment plan, staff 
hiring, fixed position, confirming company’s employee annual training program etc. 
3.8 指定人员负责审核、批准年度体系培训计划。 
The designated person is responsible for reviewing and approving the annual system training plan. 
4 
工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 人员招聘 
Staff recruitment 
4.1.1 岸基人员的招聘由公司人力资源部负责实施。 
Recruitment of shore-based staff is carried out by the company human resources department. 
4.2 新员工录用  
New employee hiring 
4.2.1 新员工到人力资源部报到，提供个人信息材料和有关证书，人力资源部备存相关资料。 
New employee report to the human resources department, to provide personal information data and 
related certificates, the human resources department to keep relevant information. 
4.2.2 人力资源部安排陆地新员工体检，保存体检记录。如有传染病或其它不能短期治愈的
疾病，则不能安排接收。 
Human resources department to arrange the physical examination for the land-based new employee and 
preserve examination records. If there is an infectious disease or other disease that cannot be cured in a 
short period of time, the reception cannot be arranged. 
4.2.3 公司与新员工签订劳动合同，人力资源部负责办理参加社会保险手续。 
The company will sign a labor contract with the new employee, the human resources department is 
responsible for handling the social insurance formalities. 
4.2.4 人力资源部组织安排新员工上岗前培训（见本程序4.4.5），并到用人部门报到。 
Human resources department organizes new employee pre-work training (see procedure 4.4.5) and 
report to the employing department. 
4.2.5 人力资源部公布新员工上岗通知。 
The Human resources department announces the appointment of new employees. 
4.2.6 试用期结束后，新员工完成试用期总结，用人部门出具新员工鉴定意见。 
After the trial period, the new staff to complete the trial period summary, the employment department 
issued a new employee appraisal comment. 
4.3 劳动合同 
Labor contract 
4.3.1 人力资源部负责管理劳动合同，劳动合同一式二份，由公司和员工各执一份。 
The human resources department is responsible for the management of labor contracts, the labor contract 
in duplicate, the company and employees each holding a copy. 
4.3.2 人力资源部代表公司与陆地员工签订书面劳动合同。

The human resources department on behalf of the company signs a written labor contract with the 
land-based employee. 
4.3.3 公司留存的合同文本统一交人力资源部存入本人档案。 
The company retains the contract copy, unified forward to the human resources department save in the 
personal file. 
4.4 人员的培训 
Personnel training 
4.4.1 员工培训内容包括熟悉管理体系、相关法规、岗位专业技能及应急反应技能、企业文
化理念等。 
Staff training content includes familiar with the management system, the relevant laws and regulations, 
post professional skills and emergency response skills, corporate culture and so on. 
4.4.2 培训的标明 
Marking of training 
可在以下管理活动中，发现岸上人员培训的需求： 
The need for shore-based staff training is found in the following management activities: 
 公司管理体系运行、评价、内外审实践等； 
Company management system operation, evaluation, internal and external audit practice etc.; 
 有关新公约、法规、规定和指南； 
Relevant conventions, regulations, rules and guidelines; 
 主管机关的通知和通函。 
Notice and circular of the Administration. 
相关部门负责人通过对上述信息来源进行分析，确定培训的内容和方式。 
Relevant departments in-charge through the analysis of above information, to determine the content and 
method of training. 
4.4.3 公司培训计划 
Company Training plan 
 体系管理部负责调研了解培训需求，制订岸基员工年度培训计划报指定人员批准
后组织实施。 
The ISM department is responsible for investigating the training needs, formulating the On shore 
staff annual training plan, and organizing implementation after reported and approved by the 
designated person. 
 需要外部培训时，由各部门上报人力资源部，报总经理批准，由人力资源部安排
并组织实施。 
When the external training is needed, the various departments will report to the human resources 
department, and report to the General Manager GM for approval. The implementation will be 
organized by the Human resources department. 
 培训由公司统一组织，或根据需要由各部门进行安排。 
Training is unified organized by the company or arranged by various departments as needed. 
4.4.4 部门员工培训 
Department employee training 
 在岗培训适合于管理业务、操作技能、体系文件、公约法规等方面的培训。 
On-the-job training is suitable for training in management, operational skills, system documentation, 
conventions and regulations etc. 
 在岗培训可采用授课人讲解、集休学习、自学、工作研讨、模拟操作等方式。 
On-the-job training can be used by the instructor to explain, group study, self-study, work seminars, 
simulation operations.

4.4.5 新员工上岗前培训 
New employee pre-work training 
 人力资源部负责公司新员工上岗前的基础培训。内容包括企业文化理念、公司结

4.4.7 各部门安排的外部培训，经主管副总经理或主管总经理助理和总经理审批后实施。

Training costs: The company approved on-the-job training, training costs borne by the company. During

4.4.9 凡外出脱产培训3 个月以上，公司与参加培训员工签订专项培训协议。 
When there is more than 3 months full-time training, the company will sign a special training agreement 
with the participating staff.

Crew training 
船员培训由船员部组织实施，详见《船员培训控制程序》中的规定。 
The crew training is organized and implemented by the crew department, as detailed in the Crew 
Training Control Procedures.

Work evaluation

4.5.1 每年一月底前各岗位员工完成上一年度工作总结。总结工作成绩、统计相关数据、提
出工作计划和建议等。 
Before the end of January each year, the employee of every post to complete the work summary of the

4.5.2 部门经理收集部门员工工作总结，安排逐一面谈，了解思想动态，交换意见，提出要
求，做出考评意见。

understand their ideological dynamics, exchange views, make requests, make evaluation comments. 
4.5.3 主管副总经理或总经理助理收集主管部门经理、副经理的工作总结并安排面谈，提出
要求，交换意见，做出考评。 
The Vice-General Manager VGM in charge or assistant General Manager GM collects the work 
summary of competent department manager, Vice manager, arrange interviews, make requests, exchange 
views, and make an evaluation. 
4.5.4 人力资源部收集各部门工作总结，并完成公司工作总结。 
Human resources department collects the work summary of each department and completes the company 
work summary. 
4.5.5 部门经理留存本部门员工总结及考评结果，人力资源部留存部门经理、副经理工作总
结及考评结果。 
The department manager to retain the summary and evaluation results of department employees, human 
resources department retain manager, vice manager work summary and evaluation results. 
4.5.6 船员考评由船员部负责，详见《船舶手册》有关规定。 
The crew department is responsible for the ship crew assessment, as specified in the "ship manual". 
4.6 请假、销假及考勤 
Leave, cancel leave and attendance 
4.6.1 机关工作时间为每周一至周五，上午08:45 至11:45，下午13:30 至17:45。 
The working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 08:45 to 11:45, from 13:30 to 17:45. 
4.6.2 公司实行打卡考勤制度，人力资源部负责人员的考勤，每月汇总留存。 
The company implement the card attendance system, the human resources department responsible for 
staff attendance, monthly summary and retain. 
4.6.3 员工请假根据公司制度执行。 
Employee leave is based on company system to implement. 
4.6.4 员工事假先抵扣本年应休未休带薪年休假期。 
Employee casual leave is firstly deducted from the current year annual leave. 
4.6.5 部门员工半天内的假期由本部门经理批准，一天之内（含一天）的由主管副总经理或
主管总经理助理批准，超过一天的假期由总经理批准，部门正、副经理假期由主管副
总经理或主管总经理助理、总经理批准。 
Leave for department staff within half a day, are approved by the department manager. Within one day 
(including one day) approved by the   Vice-General Manager VGM in charge or assistant General 
Manager GM, more than one day's leave is approved by the General Manager GM. Department manager, 
vice manager leave approved by the Vice-General Manager VGM or assistant General Manager GM, 
General Manager GM. 
4.6.6 船员请假见《船员管理办法》有关规定。 
The ship crew leave, see the relevant provisions of the Crew Management Regulation. 
4.7 岗位变动与工作交接 
Post changes and work handover 

101

4.7.1 部门间转岗：经公司总经理批准后由人力资源部统一安排部门间转岗，转岗人员交接
清楚本岗位工作后由部门经理安排到人力资源部报到，人力资源部做好相关记录。员
工岗位工作交接按照公司《岗位交接制度》要求执行。 
Inter-departmental transfer: approved by the company General Manager GM, the human resources 
department unified arrangements inter-departmental transfer. After the transfer staff clearly handover the 
works of the original post, the department manager arranges to report to the human resources department, 
the human resources department does the relevant records. Staff handover works implement in 
accordance with the company Post Shift Regulation requirements. 
4.7.2 部门内转岗：部门内岗位的变动，由主管副总经理或主管总经理助理批准后并按照部
门间转岗程序办理，转岗情况报送由人力资源部。工作交接按照《岗位交接制度》要
求执行。 
Transfer within the department: changes in the post within the department, approved by the Vice-General 
Manager VGM or assistant General Manager GM, and to handle in accordance with the 
inter-departmental transfer procedures, transfer situation submitted to the human resources department. 
Works handover implement in accordance with the company Post Shift Regulation requirements. 
4.7.3 机关员工职务晋升：根据总经理意见由人力资源部统一安排。员工接任新职务前完成
新岗位培训，包括必要的基础管理技能培训、岗位职责培训、安全管理相关公约法规
培训等，培训后经评估通过后方可履行新岗位职责。 
Department employee promotion: In the opinion of the General Manager GM, unified arrangements by 
the Human resources department. Employee to complete the new post pre-work training before takeover 
the new post, including the necessary basic management skills training, job duties training, safety 
management related to the relevant laws and regulations training. After training and pass the assessment, 
the employee will perform the new job responsibilities. 
4.7.4 因不适合原岗位工作经转岗培训后仍不合格的，人力资源部将安排待岗；自学后再次
考核不合格，按《劳动合同书》规定予以解除劳动合同。 
Due to not suitable for the original post work, failed after the post transfer training, the human resources 
department will arrange the employee to be post-waiting; failed again after self-study, according to 
Labor Contract to dismiss the labor contract. 
4.8 岗位替代制度 
Backup Post System 
4.8.1 
为确保各部门工作的正常运行，有效地防止工作断档，岸基各部门应对每位员工 
安排岗位替代人。 
In order to ensure the normal operation of the work of each department, and effectively prevent the  
work from being interrupted, each department of Shore-base shall arrange Backup Post System for  
each staff. 
4.8.2 
岗位替代人明细表需经部门负责人签字确认。 
The detailed list of Backup Post System shall be confirmed by the signature of the head of department. 
4.8.3 
员工因开会、出差、请假或者其他原因一天以上无法到岗的，应在离港前向上级 
负责人汇报正在办理和待办理的事项，上级负责人及时指定相关人员代其行使职责 
并做好工作交接。 
If a staff is unable to be on duty for more than one day due to meeting, business trip, leave or other 
reasons, he/she shall report to the superior in charge of the matters being handled and to be handled 
before the ship leaving the port, and the superior in charge shall promptly appoint the relevant person to 
exercise the duties on his/her behalf and do a good job handover. 
4.8.4 
替代人员应认真履行替代岗位职责，办理情况应及时与原岗位员工交接清楚。 
Backup post personnel shall conscientiously perform the duties of the replacement post, and the handling

situation shall be promptly and clearly handed over to the original post staff. 
4.8.5 
岗位替代对应人员特殊情况均不在岗时，由部门负责人临时指定人员替代。 
When the backup post personnel is not on duty under special circumstances, the head of department shall 
temporarily designate the replacement personnel. 
 
4.9 奖惩 
Rewards and punishments 
员工奖励和处罚根据《员工奖惩条例》执行。 
Employee rewards and punishments are carried out under Employee Incentive Regulations. 
4.10 离职 
Resignation 
4.10.1 机关员工申请辞职，须提前30 日向人力资源部经理当面递交亲笔签名的辞职申请
书，否则公司不予承认。船员申请辞职应向船员部经理当面递交辞职申请。 
The department employee's resignation application, shall be an autographed application letter in person, 
submit to the human resources department manager, 30 days in advance, otherwise it will not be 
recognized by the Company. The ship crew should apply for resignation in person, submit to the crew 
department manager. 
4.10.2 人力资源部经理收到员工辞职申请后，了解并确认申请人劳动合同、岗位工作等有
关情况，知会主管副总经理或主管总经理助理后报总经理批准办理离职手续。由人力
资源部通知本人办理工作交接安排和办理离职手续时间。 
The human resources department manager shall, after receiving the employee resignation application, 
understand and confirm the applicant's labor contract, post works and relevant circumstances, notify the 
Vice-General Manager VGM or assistant General Manager GM in charge, report to the General Manager 
GM for approval of the resignation formalities. The human resources department will inform the 
applicant to handle the work handover arrangements and the time of handling resignation formalities. 
4.10.3 辞职员工根据人力资源部通知按时到公司办理离职手续。人力资源部经理开具办理
离职手续通知单，离职员工持此通知单到相关部门办理手续。各部门为辞职员工办结
相关手续后，部门经理签字确认。 
Resigned employee according to the human resources department notice, to complete the resignation 
formalities in the company on time. The human resources department manager issued a "Notice of 
resignation formalities", resigned employee holds this notice to the relevant departments for the 
formalities. After the departments completed the relevant procedures for the resigned employee, the 
department managers sign to confirm. 
4.10.4 离职手续办妥后，人力资源部为离职员工出具解除或终止劳动合同证明书。 
After completed the resignation formalities, the human resources department will issue a certificate of 
dismission or termination of the labor contract for the resigned employee. 
4.10.5 员工不按规定办理工作交接，或不按通知时间来公司办理离职手续的，公司暂缓为
其办理离职手续。  
The employee does not conduct the work handover according to the regulations, or does not complete 
the resignation formalities in the company on time, the company will suspend to handle his resignation 
procedures. 
4.10.6 解除劳动合同员工应根据公司通知办理离职手续。 
Termination of labor contracts, employees should handle the resignation formalities in according to the 
company notice.

Records and archives

02_43.chapter: 第十三章 船长和船员的审核调配程序
02_43.text:
第十三章  船长和船员的审核调配程序 
Chapter 13 Master & Crew Assignment Evaluation Procedure 
 
1 
目的和适用范围 
Purpose and scope of application 
1.1 
本程序规定配备船长和船员的审核和调配方法，以保证船长和船员的配备符合主管
机关和国际有关法律和法规的规定。 
This procedure governs the evaluate and deploy method for deployment of captain and crew, to 
ensure the master and crew are in compliance with the requirements of the Administration and the 
relevant international laws and regulations. 
1.2 
本程序适用于各相关部门及所管理船舶。 
This procedure applies to all relevant departments and managed ships. 
2 
职责 
Duties 
2.1 
船长：负责报告申请公休船员名单；负责船员交接的现场监控；负责船员在船履行
职责情况的监督、考核和报告。 
Captain: responsible for submit to the company a crew relief request; responsible for supervision 
crew’s handover; responsible for onboard crew performance duties supervision, evaluate and 
reporting. 
2.2 
船员部： 
Crew department: 
1) 负责船员公司派遣、各种证书和证件的最终审核工作，负责船员换班计划的制  
定和实施。 
Be responsible for the deployment of the crew manning company, the final review of 
various certificates and credentials, and the formulation and implementation of the crew 
change plan. 
2) 负责操作级、支持级船员适任及调配的最终审核。 
Responsible for the operational level and support level final decision on the crew competence 
and deployment. 
3) 审核船员换班计划、高级船员适任审核和船员调配工作的具体执行。 
Review the crew change plan, officer’s competence review and implementation of the crew 
deployment.   
2.3 
船员部经理：负责批准船员换班计划；负责管理级船员调配的最终审核。 
Manager of crew department: responsible for approving crew change plan; Be responsible for the 
final review of management level crew deployment. 
2.4 
船管部经理：负责船长、轮机长以及轮机员在船管部适任审核的组织、审批。 
Fleet Department Manager: responsible for the Captain, Chief Engineer and Engineers of the 
competent evaluation organization, approval in the Fleet department. 
2.5 
机务总管：负责主管船舶轮机长、轮机员及驾驶员的适任审核。 
Technical Superintendent: Responsible for the Chief Engineer, Engineers and Officers competent 
evaluation of vessel in charge. 
2.6 
海务部经理：负责船长以及驾驶员在海务部适任审核的组织、审批。 
Marine Department Manager: Responsible for the Captain and Officers organization and approval in

the Marine Department. 
2.7 
海务主管：负责主管船舶船长及驾驶员的适任审核。 
Marine Department Superintendent: Responsible for the competence evaluation of the Captain and 
Officers of the vessel in charge. 
2.8 
总经理：监控船长的适任审核。 
General Manager: Monitor the Captain's competence review. 
3 
工作程序 
Working procedures 
3.1 
船员的适任条件 
The conditions of competence crew 
1) 持有有效的应持证书；hold all valid certificate 
2) 身体健康；healthy; 
3) 年满十八周岁；Over 18 years old; 
4) 担任值班职责的人员需具有相当的航海经历； 
Person who perform watch keeping duty should have considerable sea service experience; 
5) 管理级和操作级船员应具备相关的专业技术能力、英语交流能力、沟通能力和
指挥能力； 
Management level and operational level officers should have the relevant professional and 
technical ability, English communication skills, communication skills and command ability; 
6) 完成规定的熟悉职责的培训并达到要求的效果。 
Complete the familiar duties training and achieve the desired effect. 
3.2 
船长的适任条件 
Appointment of the Master 
1) 取得主管机关签发有效的适任证书，具有操纵同类型、吨位船舶的良好业务技
能和丰富资历，身心健康，无重大海事责任事故记录。 
Qualifications of the master: Possessing a certificate of competency issued by the national 
maritime competent authority, have good business skills and rich qualifications in operating 
vessels of the same type and tonnage, be physically and mentally healthy, and have no record of 
major maritime liability accidents. 
2) 如不具备同类型船舶任职资历者，应先行参加公司统一组织的大船模拟器实操
培训，待考核结果达标后，方可办理上船任职手续。 
Those who do not have service experience on the same type of ships shall first 
participate in the large ship simulator practical training organized uniformly by the 
company, and can only go through the procedures for taking up positions on board 
after passing the assessment. 
3) 完全熟悉公司的管理体系。fully familiar with the company's management system. 
3.3 
适任的审核:以下审核适用于新聘船员、船员在船晋升。 
Competence review: the following review applies to the new crew, crew promoted onboard. 
3.3.1 高级船员的适任审核 
Competent review for officers 
1) 对于新聘船长指挥资格的确定：新聘船长由船员部负责基本情况的面试、审核,
包括：个人基本情况、证书是否齐全、身体健康状况的初步了解、海上资历是否
适合所上船舶、英语熟练程度等，并填写“高级船员适任审核表”，船员部经理对
初步审核情况予以评价。通过审核者提交给海务主管和机务总管审核。审核要包
括被审核人的职业经历、安全业绩、决策能力、组织能力、协调能力和应变能力

等方面，审核合格后报海务经理、总经理批准，即认为具备适当的指挥资格。 
Determination of captain command eligibility: The determination of the qualification of the newly 
appointed captain: The Crew Department is responsible for the basic situation review of the newly 
appointed captain, including, the basic situation of the individual, whether the certificate is 
complete, the initial checking of the health condition, whether the sea service experience suitable 
for the ship deployed, English proficiency, etc., and fill up the "Senior Officer Proficiency Audit 
form", the crew department manager to evaluate the initial review. Submitted to the Marine 
Department Superintendent and Technical Superintendent for review. The review shall include the 
auditor's professional experience, safety performance, decision-making ability, organizational 
ability, coordination ability and adaptability, etc., after pass the review, report will send to the 
Marine Department manager, General Manager GM for approval. After approval, the newly 
appointed captain is recognized with the command qualification. 
2) 高级船员的新聘适任审核由船员部按适任审核表的要求内容进行初步审核，填
写相应的“高级船员适任审核表”，船员部经理对初步审核情况予以评价。船员部
将 “高级船员适任审核表”送交海务部海务主管和/或船管部机务总管进行审核，
审核合格后报部门经理审批。 
The Officers and Engineers new appointment competent review by the crew department according 
to the requirements from competent assessment table for the initial review, fill out the appropriate " 
Senior Officer Proficiency Audit form ", the crew department manager comment on the initial 
review. The crew department will submit the " Senior Officer Proficiency Audit form " to the 
Marine Department Superintendent and / or Technical Superintendent for approval. After approved, 
report the department manager for approval. 
3) 船管部、海务部应建立并使用各职位高级船员的审核提纲和保存面试资料。 
Fleet Department and Marine Department shall establish and use the review outline for each officer 
and engineer post, maintain the interview data. 
4) 适任审核还应包括其是否适合某船种、某特定船舶，以及管理级船员搭配情况。
Competent review should also include whether it is suitable for the ship types, a particular ship, and 
matching with the management level crew. 
5) 高级船员在船职务晋升必须由船舶推荐，海务部或船管部主管进行业务考核，
船员部审核批准。 
Officers and Engineers promotion onboard must be recommended by the ship. Marine Department 
or Fleet Department Superintendent will conduct performance assessment, the crew department 
review and approval. 
3.3.2 
支持级船员的适任审核 
Competent review of the support level crew 
对于新聘的此类船员，由船员派遣单位对其健康状况、证书和资历等进行审核。 
For the newly employed crew members, the crew manning company shall review their health status, 
certificates and qualifications.  
3.3.3 在船工作期间的适任考核 
Assessment of the work onboard the vessel 
1) 船员在船期间，船长和部门长应按照《船舶手册》第三章第五节要求进行考核，
考核结果报船员部保存，作为调配的依据。 
During the crew onboard period, captain and department head should carry out the assessment in 
accordance with the requirements of the Ship's Manual, Chapter 3, Section 5, the results shall be 
kept by the crew department as a basis for deployment.

    第4/5页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.     Effective Date: 2026/2/10          Page 4 of 5 
 
2) 船员供方公司评价:当公司计划从某一船员供方公司聘用较多船员时，应对其
管理资质和信誉进行评价，认为合格后方可聘用，并保留评价记录。详细情况请
参阅程序手册第30 章《船员招募和安置机构的评估程序》，并将我公司对船员的
常规要求提供给该船员供方公司。为某一艘船舶配备的船员是来自某一船员供方
公司时，公司应与该公司签订合同，并明确双方的责任和权力。  
Crew supply company evaluation: When the company plans to hire large number of crew from a 
crew recruitment company, they should evaluate their management qualifications and reputation, 
that qualified before they can hire, and retain the evaluation records. For details, please refer to 
Chapter 30 Procedure of RPS Evaluation in the Procedure Manual. And provide the company's 
general requirements of crew to the crew supply company. When a ship is equipped with a crew 
from a crew supply company, the company shall make a contract with the crew supply company 
and define the responsibilities and powers of both parties。 
3.4 
船员调配 
Crew deployment 
3.4.1 船长向船员部报告申请公休船员名单，对本船不适岗船员有权向船员部提出更换建
议。 
The captain shall report to the crew department a list of leave applications. For the incompetence 
crew, captain has the right to make replacement proposals to the crew department. 
3.4.2 船管部经理海务部经理有权向船员部对不适岗船员提出更换要求，船员部根据实际
情况，尽快安排人员更换。 
Fleet Department Manager, Marine Department Manager has the right to make replacement proposals 
of an incompetence crew. Crew department accordance the actual situation, arranges the replacement 
as soon as practicable. 
3.4.3 船员部经理应该选定合理可行的换班港口，控制换班人数。由于疫情和港口规定等
导致的特殊情况，船员部应该汇同机务总管和海务主管，制定有效的换班方案和接
班船员培训计划，提醒船长做好交接班监控。 
The manager of Crew department shall select a reasonable and feasible port, and control the number 
of replacements. Due to the special circumstances caused by the epidemic and port requirements, the 
crew department shall response to formulate an effective crew change plan and training plan with the 
technical superintendent and the maritime, and remind the captain to supervise crew’s handover. 
3.4.4 船员部负责编制“船员换班计划”，船员部经理负责审核和批准“船员换班计划”。
Crew department prepare the "Crew Change Plan", the crew department manager is responsible for 
reviewing and approving "Crew Change Plan". 
3.4.5 船员部在船舶配员工作中满足船舶最低配员证书的要求并符合安全及防污设备证
书要求、船舶舱室证书要求。并遵守《船员管理办法》的有关规定。 
The crew department when deploying ship's crew, shall meet the requirements of the minimum safe 
manning certificate, Safety and pollution prevention equipment certificate, Certificate of Inspection 
of Crew Accommodation. And comply with the "crew management Regulation" of the relevant 
provisions. 
3.4.6 船长和部门长对接班船员的适任情况进行考察和监督。如接班船员存在不能履职的
情况，及时报告船员部，并采取安全措施。 
The captain and department head shall evaluate and supervise the competency of the sign-on crew, If 
the sign-on crew cannot perform their duties, Captain should report to the crew department in time 
and take safety measures.

02_44_0.text:
第十四章  船员培训控制程序 
Chapter 14 Crew Training Control Procedure 
 
1 
目的和适用范围 
Purpose and scope of application 
1.1 
本程序规定了船员培训的控制方法，保证向船员提供各种培训，使船员具备 必须
的技能，熟悉其职责，并不断提高船员的管理水平、应变反应能力和技术水平，确
保船舶安全。   
This procedure provides for the control of the crew training to ensure that the crew is provided with 
the necessary training to familiarize the crew with the necessary skills, knowing his duty, and to 
improve the management level, the responsiveness and the technical level of the crew to ensure the 
safety of the ship. 
1.2 
船员培训包括：上船前培训、在船培训、应急训练和演习、救生消防及防污染培训、
履约培训、公司强化培训、提职培训等等。 
Crew training includes：before boarding training, onboard training, emergency training and exercises, 
lifesaving/firefighting and pollution prevention training, compliance training, company strengthen 
training, pre-promotion training, etc. 
1.3 
本程序适用于公司相关部门及公司所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to the relevant departments of the company and the company managed ship. 
2 
定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
2.1 
新聘船员：指原不在公司管理体系覆盖的船舶上工作，新到体系内某岗位任职的船
员。 
Newly recruited crew: refers to the crew has not works onboard a vessel covered by company 
management system, newly join a post in the system. 
2.2 
转岗船员：指原在体系内的某岗位工作，新调至体系内的另一船员岗位工作的船员。
转岗船员包括：本船职务变动的船员；曾在某船某岗位工作，再回到该船原岗位任
职的船员，但离开该岗位时间超过6 个月，或离开期间管理体系发生了改版。 
Transfer post crew: refers to the crew had work within the system, newly transfer to another post within 
the system. Transfer includes: change of position onboard; had worked onboard a ship, and returned to 
the same ship same position, but have left the post for more than six months or management system 
had revised edition in the leaving period. 
2.3 
熟悉职责：是指熟悉公司管理体系（特别是岗位职责、相关的管理程序、操作方案
和须知）， 相关设备的布置、性能及其操作，船舶工作环境尤其是应急环境（如应
急设备的布置、撤离路线等），以及熟悉有关的法律法规、规定、规则和指南。 
Familiar with the duty: refers to the familiar with the company management system (in particular, job 
duty, related management procedures, operating procedures and instructions), the relevant equipment 
layout, performance and operation, ship working environment, especially emergency environment 
(such as emergency equipment layout, evacuation routes, etc.), and familiarity with relevant laws, 
regulations, rules and guidelines. 
2.4 
航前培训指令：上岗船员在开航前必须熟悉操作须知和预案，包括：管理体系的相
关要求，船舶详细情况的资料，船舶的各种应急准备，为确保安全开航所必需熟悉
的船上设备和应急设备，公司职能部门对船上货物、航线、性能的特别要求，等等。
开航前培训指令，应针对不同的人、船、货、航线等特殊情况做出具体的指示或增
补。也可通过船员上船前培训提出要求，以及干部船员交接班中上一任船员交待的

Pre-departure training instructions: On-signer must be familiar with the operating instructions and 
plans before sailing, including the management system requirements, the details of the ship's 
information, the ship's various emergency preparedness, to ensure safe navigation must be familiar 
with the equipment on board and emergency equipment, other special requirements on goods, routes, 
performance, etc. from company's functional departments. Pre-sailing training instructions should be 
specific for different people, vessels, goods, routes and other special circumstances to make specific 
instructions or supplement, through the crew before boarding training requirements, and important note 
in management level crew handover and supervisor instructions and other ways to achieve. 
2.5 
熟悉职责提纲：指岸基提供的熟悉职责培训中的内容提纲。 
Familiar duty outline: refers to the contents outlined in the shore based familiar duty outline training. 
2.6 
培训内容：是指用以帮助船员熟悉职责“船员熟悉职责培训记录表”中，按不同部
门、不同操作级别和不同职务而提出的培训内容。在规定的时间段内完成所有项目
的培训。 
Training content: refers to the training content used to help the crew familiar with the duties of "Crew 
duty familiarization training record ", according to different departments, different operating levels and 
different positions of the training content. Complete the training of all tasks within the specified time 
period. 
2.7 
管理级船员：系指船长、轮机长、大副和大管轮。 
Management level crew: refers to the captain, chief engineer, chief mate and second engineer. 
2.8 
操作级船员：系指二副、三副、二管轮、三管轮和电机员。 
Operating level crew: refers to the second officer, third officer, third engineer fourth engineer and 
electrical engineer. 
2.9 
支持级船员：系指管理级和操作级以外的其它船员。 
Support level crew: means the crew other than the management level and the operational level. 
2.10 
最低培训： 
Minimum training： 
系指公司对新招募的船员进行的以公司管理方针、目标和安全文化基础的培训。新
招募船员应接受以下最低培训： 
It refers to the training conducted by the company for newly recruited crew members based on the 
company's management policies, objectives and safety culture. Newly recruited crew members shall 
receive the following minimum training: 
1) 
公司管理方针和管理目标； 
Management policies and objectives of the company; 
2) 
公司的安全管理文化； 
Safety management culture of the company; 
3) 
船舶日常工作安全须知； 
Safety instructions for daily work of ships; 
4) 
船上应急知识； 
On board emergency knowledge; 
3 
职责  
Responsibilities 
3.1 
船员部：负责编制涉及本部门培训内容的船员培训材料和熟悉职责提纲，培训内容
应包括以下内容：企业文化、管理理念、人身安全、船员职业健康、船上骚扰与欺
凌预防、服从服务性、船员管理、岗位职责、船上培训、船员考核、团结配合等。
负责制定“船员上船接班前培训计划表”，负责船员上船前的培训组织工作；负责

公司强化培训的组织安排。负责涉及本部门培训内容的培训实施。 
Crew department: Responsible for preparing training content related to Crew department in crew 
training materials and duties familiarization outline, the training content should include the following: 
corporate culture, management philosophy, personal safety, crew occupation health, prevention of 
shipboard harassment and bullying, obedience, crew management, job duties, on board training, crew 
Assessment, unity and cooperation, etc. Responsible for the development of the "Before boarding crew 
training schedule", responsible for the crew before boarding ship training organization work; 
responsible for company strengthen training organization arrangement. Responsible for the 
implementation of the training content of the Crew department. 
3.2 
船管部：负责编制涉及本部门培训内容的船员培训材料和熟悉职责提纲，并根据船
员部“船员上船接班前培训计划表”安排负责对管理级、操作级船员涉及船舶机务
管理方面内容的培训。主要内容：本船设备及维护保养等情况介绍、船舶管理新要
求、新公约和法规和相关外部检查新情况，针对本船情况提出工作要求、相关操作
注意事项，船岸联系及工作流程等事项。 
Fleet Department: Responsible for preparing training content related to Fleet department in crew 
training materials and duties familiarization outline and accordance with crew department "Before 
boarding crew training schedule" arrangements for the management level, operating level crew 
involved in ship engineering management training. Main contents: Ship equipment and maintenance 
condition introduction, the new requirements on ship management, the new conventions and 
regulations and the relevant new situation on external inspection. For the ship situation, list out work 
requirements, related operational considerations, ship-shore contact and work processes. 
3.3 
海务部：负责编制涉及本部门培训内容的船员培训材料和熟悉职责提纲，并根据船
员部“船员上船接班前培训计划表”安排负责对管理级、操作级船员培训上船前涉
及本部门的内容的培训，培训内容应包括：船舶保安新信息及公司要求。船舶操纵、
货物配载、船舶航行及锚泊安全、航次计划的制定和航次报告制度、压载水管理、
熟悉ECDIS 功能和使用等注意事项，船舶保险、提单、航次租船、期租、货物安
全、防损等注意事项。 
Marine Department: Responsible for preparing training content related to Marine department in crew 
training materials and duties familiarization outline and accordance with crew department "Before 
boarding crew training schedule" arrangements for the management level, operating level crew training 
on before boarding training content related to Marine department, training content should include: ship 
security new information and company requirements. Ship handling, cargo loading, ship navigation 
and anchoring safety, voyage planning and voyage reporting system, ballast water management, 
familiar with ECDIS function and usage, etc., ship insurance, bill of lading, voyage charter, charter 
period, cargo safety, loss prevention and other precautions. 
3.4 
体系管理部：根据船员部“船员上船接班前培训计划表”安排负责对管理级、操作
级船员培训上船前有关体系的培训，培训内容应包括：体系文件基本情况及近期修
改，船舶体系运行情况的要求，体系内、外部审核及不符合项的处置。 
ISM Department: Accordance with Crew department "Seafare Training plan Before joining vessel" 
arrangements for the management level, operating level crew training before onboard on the relevant 
system training, training content should include: the system documents basic situation and the recent 
changes. Onboard System operation requirements, action on internal, external audit nonconformity. 
3.5 
船长：按照管理体系年度培训计划，及时下达培训指令；根据港口换班情况，及时
下达航前培训指令；并监督船舶各部门的培训落实和实施情况。 
Captain: In accordance with the annual training plan of the management system, timely release of 
training instructions. Based on port shift changes, timely release pre-sailing training instructions.

工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 
培训的标明 
Marking of training 
4.1.1 
船员培训内容 
Crew training content 
1)上船前熟悉职责培训按各部门的熟悉职责提纲实施，熟悉职责提纲应包含开航前
指令中管理体系的相关要求、船舶情况介绍。 
Before boarding familiar with duties training accordance with various department familiar duties

2)在船培训按本程序、《船舶手册》和“船员熟悉职责培训记录表”中的有关内容实

设备的内容，本部分内容应在开航前熟悉，但涉及航行中交接班的至少在正式接
任前熟悉。 
Onboard training accordance with the related content of these procedures, "ship manual" and "Crew 
duty familiarization before departure training record form" implement training. These shall include 
the in pre-departure instruction on familiar with equipment and emergency equipment necessary to 
ensure safe departure. This part content should be familiar before sailing, but related to navigation 
handover should be familiar before handover. 
3)对于新招募的船员，由船员部负责组织（包括安排机务主管、海务主管及其他相
关人员）对其进行培训，至少包括最低培训要求的内容。 
For newly recruited crew members, the crew department is responsible for organizing (including 
arranging technical superintendent, marine superintendent and other relevant personnel) to train them, 
including at least the contents of the minimum training requirements. 
4.1.2 
船员部和船长在以下管理活动中，注意发现船员需要的培训，并加强该方面的培训。
Crew training supervisors and captains in the following management activities, it is important to note 
the training required by the crew and to strengthen the training in this area. 
1)内部审核和外部审核； 
   internal audit and external audit; 
2)对不符合规定的情况、事故和险情调查、分析； 
   Investigation, analysis on Non-conformity, accident and hazard occurrence; 
3)公司安全检查以及船旗国和港口国安全检查发现的缺陷分析； 
   Defect analysis from company safety inspection, flag State and port state control inspection; 
4)船员在船工作评价考核结果； 
   Assessment results from crew performance assessment; 
5)国际公约及主管机关的规定； 
  The provisions of international conventions and Administration; 
6)应急演习和训练的结果；

02_44_1.text:
