4.1.3 
船员部负责船员需进行培训的标明。 
The crew training officer is responsible for the training of the crew. 
4.2 
培训的计划和实施 
Planning and implementation of training 
4.2.1 
体系管理部负责制定船员在船年度培训计划，报指定人员批准后实施。 
The ISM department is responsible for the development of the Annual Crew Training Program onboard, 
report to Designated Person for approved and implementation. 
4.2.2 
船员部负责公司安排在船统一培训的跟踪、公司强化培训的计划和组织实施。 
The crew department is responsible for arranging onboard unified training, tracking and company 
strengthen training planning and organize implementation.  
4.2.3 
船员部负责根据本程序第4.1 条标明其它培训需求，组织相关的培训并保存记录。
The crew department is responsible for accordance with Article 4.1 of this procedure marked other 
training needs, organizing relevant training and keeping records. 
4.2.4 
船员部负责船员上船接班前培训计划制定、组织安排和针对个人情况要求在船培训
内容的落实。 
The crew department responsible for the before onboard crew training plan development, organization 
and targeted on the individual characteristics requirements training onboard content implement. 
4.3 
船员上船前派遣教育和熟悉职责培训 
Before onboard crew deployment education and familiar duties training 
4.3.1 
船长在上船前的熟悉岗位培训应达到完全熟悉公司的安全管理体系，着重于船长对
ISM 规则的充分理解，对公司安全管理体系构成的了解，对体系运作特点的把握，
主要管理程序、本公司特殊规定的熟悉等。培训方法：向船长提供公司的体系文件
并给予足够的阅读时间，并由各主管部门安排讲解。 
The captain should be fully familiar with the company's safety management system before onboard, 
focusing on the master's understanding of the ISM rules, the understanding of the company's safety 
management system, the grasp of the characteristics of the system, the main Management procedures, 
familiarization the company's special provisions. Training methods: provide captain with company's 
system documents and give enough reading time, and explained by the various department head. 
4.3.2 
新聘及转岗的管理级、操作级船员，在上船前必须到公司接受公司的岸基培训。特
殊情况需急需上船接班时，可由公司人员在船进行相关内容培训。支持级船员上船
前，由派员单位进行培训。 
The newly recruited and transferred management level, operational level crew, before boarding must 
go to the company and accept the company's shore-based training. Special circumstances need 
immediately sign-on, related content training can be done by the company personnel. The crew of 
support level shall be trained by the crew manning company before boarding. 
4.3.3 
由于特殊情况，上岗船员无法面对面交接时，船长应通过网络将相关船舶资料传递
给船员主管转上岗船员，也可通过课件、视频或语音等形式进行网络沟通，使接班
船员提前熟悉船舶和了解操作。 
When the sign on/off crew cannot be handed over face to face due to special circumstances, the master 
should transmit the relevant ship documents to the sign-on crew via the crew department by the network, 
or communicate through the network in the courseware, video or voice, the sign-on crew want to be

familiar with the ship particular and operation procedures in advance. 
4.3.4 
培训内容：新聘船员的熟悉职责培训应包括除必须在船才能完成的培训外的全部熟
悉职责的培训，并给予足够的学习时间。转岗船员的熟悉职责培训重点为职责的变
化、船舶环境的变化、体系文件修订部分并进一步熟悉管理体系的其他相关内容。
船员派遣教育应包含服务公司的情况介绍、企业文化、管理理念、人身安全、船员
职业健康、船上骚扰与欺凌预防、服从服务意识、劳工公约和船员管理的有关内容。
如需要，应针对船舶及船员个人特点进行有针对性的培训。 
Training content: The familiar training for newly recruited crews should include all familiar duties 
training, expect those must be completed onboard, give sufficient time to study. For transfer crew, 
familiar duties are focused on changes in duties, changes in the ship's environment, revision of the 
system documents and further familiarity with other relevant aspects of the management system. Crew 
deployment education should include the service company's briefing, corporate culture, management 
philosophy, personal safety, crew occupation health, prevention of shipboard harassment and bullying, 
obedience, labour conventions and the relevant content of crew management. If necessary, targeted 
training should be conducted on the individual characteristics of ships and crew. 
4.3.5 
培训实施：船员部组织船员的熟悉职责培训，下达船员上船接班前培训计划，相关
部门按熟悉职责提纲的要求对船员进行培训。 
Training Implementation: The crew department organize crew familiar duties training, issue "Before 
boarding crew training plan", the relevant departments accordance with the requirements in familiar 
duties outline provide training to the crew. 
4.3.6 
培训记录 
Training records 
1)管理级船员在公司接受岸基培训结束后，培训人、受培训人分别在“管理级船员
上船前培训记录表”上签名，该记录表一份由船员部保存，一份交船长保存。
Management level crew has accepted the shore-based training in the company, the trainer and trainee 
are signed on the "Before boarding management level training form ", one copy will be kept by the 
crew department and one copy will be kept by the captain. 
2)因情况特殊，急需管理级船员上船接班时，可由公司人员在船进行培训，并填报
“管理级船员上船前培训记录表”，该表由船长和船员部保存。 
Due to the special circumstances, the urgent need of management level crew onboard, onboard 
training by company personnel is acceptable, and fill in the " Before boarding management level 
training form", copies will be kept by captain and crew department. 
3)操作级船员接受岸基培训后，填报“操作级船员培训记录表”，该表一份由船员部
保存，一份交船长保存。 
Operation level crew after received the shore-based training, fill up " Before boarding operation level 
training form", one copy will be kept by the crew department and one copy will be kept by the captain. 
4)支持级船员派遣教育后，填报“支持级船员派遣教育记录表”，由船长和船员部保
存。 
Support level crew after deployment education, fill up "Support level crew deployment education 
record form", copy will be kept by captain and crew department. 
5)船员上船接班或在船岗位变更时，由船舶部门按照“船员熟悉职责培训记录表”
的内容进行培训，培训结束由培训人、受培训人签名，并在船长处保存。 
When the crew join ship or change post onboard, the ship department training in accordance with the 
contents of the "Crew duty familiarization training record form". After training, signed by the trainer 
and the trainee and kept by the captain. 
4.4 
船员在船培训 

115

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/9.0                          PRO-14 
Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/9.0                     PRO-14 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期： 2026/4/15         第7/10页

Crew training onboard 
4.4.1 
船长按照管理体系年度培训计划，下达、组织、安排和实施船员在船的培训工作，
或船舶临时安排的其他培训，如针对某项特殊操作所进行的培训等。 
The captain shall accordance with management system Annual training program, plan, issue, organize, 
arrange and carry out the onboard crew training, or ship temporary arrange other training, such as 
targeted training for a particular operation. 
4.4.2 
所有船员上船接班后（包括船长、轮机长和大副），按照“船员熟悉职责培训记录
表”的内容完成培训。使新接班及转岗船员熟悉船舶安全开航所必需的设备和应急
设备的培训和对工作环境的熟悉并予以记录，以确保新聘及转岗船员在开航前适当
熟悉其职责。交班船员应协助接班船员在其接班前熟悉其职责。熟悉公司的安全管
理体系、业务培训、公约法规等的学习根据船舶实际培训需求予以安排。 
All crew members (including the captain, chief engineer and chief officer) join ship, in accordance 
with the "Crew duty familiarization training record form" to complete training. To enable the newly 
take-over and transfer crew familiar with the equipment and emergency equipment necessary for safe 
departure and the familiar with the working environment and keeping record, to ensure the new crew 
and transfer crew are familiar with their duties before departure. Sign-off crew should assist the sign-
on crew in familiar with their duties before they handover. Familiar with the company's safety 
management system, business training, convention and regulations to learn according to the actual 
training needs of the ship. 
4.4.3 
船长负责执行和监督所有在船培训项目，大副和轮机长负责计划和执行本部门所要
求的培训。 
The master is responsible for the execution and supervision of all training programs in the ship. The 
Chief Officer and the Chief Engineer are responsible for the planning and implementation of the 
training requirement by the department. 
4.4.4 
船员在船培训可通过以下方式进行：应急演习和训练、安全会、日常工作中由设备
/业务负责人进行讲解并现场示范。培训人可由部门长担任，也可由交班船员或能提
供指导的干部船员担任。 
Crew training onboard can be carried out in the following manner: emergency drill and training, safety 
sessions, daily work, by the equipment / job in-charge to explain and on-site demonstration. The trainer 
may be the head of the department or by the sign-off crew or the officer who can provide guidance. 
4.4.5 
船员在船培训后，要填报“船员培训记录表”，由船长监督，部门保存。 
After onboard crew training, to fill in the "Crew Training record form", by captain supervision, kept 
by the department. 
4.5 
应急训练和演习、救生、消防及防污染培训 
Emergency training and exercises, life saving, fire fighting and pollution prevention training 
船舶应急训练和演习按《应急计划》：船舶应急训练和演习执行。《SOLAS 训练手
册》及油污应急计划中要求的救生、消防及防污染培训按相关要求进行培训和记录。 
Ship emergency training and exercises according to the "contingency plan": ship emergency training 
and exercise. Training and recording of life-saving, fire fighting and pollution prevention training 
required in the SOLAS Training Manual and the Oil Pollution Emergency Plan are carried out in 
accordance with the relevant requirements. 
4.6 
职务晋升培训Pre-promotion Training 
海务部和船管部分别制订了“职务晋升在岗培训大纲”，根据大纲的要求，船长和
轮机长分别对驾驶员和轮机员、电机员的培训进行指导，船长应监督培训的执行，
并将完成的培训报告递交海务部或船管部。海务主管和机务总管对培训效果进行验
证。

Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/9.0                     PRO-14

The maritime department and the fleet department have separately formulated the “Pre-promotion 
Training Program”. According to the requirements of the program, the master and the chief engineer 
shall guide the training of officers, engineers, and electrician engineers respectively. The captain shall 
supervise the implementation of the training, and submit the completed training report to the maritime 
department or the fleet department. The marine superintendents and technical superintendents shall 
verify the training effect. 
4.7 
公司强化培训 
Company strengthen training 
4.7.1 
船员部根据船员培训计划举办培训班，对在岸船员进行企业文化、安全意识与安全
操作、安全管理体系、业务技术提高、船舶管理等内容的培训。 
The crew department conducts training courses according to the crew training plan, and carries out the 
training of the on-shore crew on corporate culture, safety awareness and safe operation, safety 
management system, business technology improvement and ship management. 
4.7.2 
根据船员培训计划安排船员参加外部培训班和研讨会。 
Arrangements for crew participation in external training courses and seminars in accordance with the 
crew training plan of the crew. 
4.7.3 
船员部负责组织培训并保存相关记录。 
The crew department is responsible for organizing the training and keeping the relevant records. 
5 
ECDIS 培训程序与须知 
ECDIS Training Procedures and notice 
5.1 
培训目的：确保船长、驾驶员能够熟练操作船上安装的ECDIS，包括ECDIS 备份
装置、外接信号源及外围设备操作。 
Purpose of the training: to ensure that the captain and OOW are able to proficient operate the ECDIS 
installed on board, including ECDIS backup device, external signal source and peripheral equipment. 
5.2 
培训要求 
Training requirements 
5.2.1 
在安装符合公约要求的ECDIS 系统的船舶工作的船长和驾驶员，应接受经主管机
关认可的相关培训（通用培训），并持有经主管机关认可的证书或培训证明； 
The captains and OOW who work onboard a ship had installed in compliance with the conventional 
requirements ECDIS system, shall receive a relevant training (generic training) approved by the 
Administration and hold a certificate or training certificate approved by the Administration; 
5.2.2 
针对性设备培训 
Type specific training 
公司确保每一位船长及驾驶员在上船前，由有资质的第三方培训公司或管理公司海
务部对船长及驾驶员进行针对性的与船载ECDIS型号一致的设备培训。如果经第三
方培训公司培训，需要出具培训计划及培训证书或培训证明材料。 
The company ensures that, before onboard, every captain and OOW is engaged by a qualified third 
party training company or management company Marine Department conduct type specific training 
coincides with shipboard ECDIS models. If trained by a third party training company, needed to issue 
a training plan and training certificate or training material certificate. 
5.2.3 
针对性设备培训计划制定 
Type specific equipment training program development 
公司船员部负责制定船员上船前培训计划，如果有船长或驾驶员换班，必须考虑到
ECDIS设备培训的时间安排，海务部根据上船前培训计划制定具体的ECDIS设备培
训计划。 
The crew department of the company is responsible for the development ship training program before

ECDIS equipment training plan. 
5.3 
设备培训效果监控 
Equipment training effectiveness monitoring 
参加设备培训的船长及驾驶员要确保熟悉如下相关操作：熟悉相关功能，菜单架构，
显示设置，安全参数设置，报警与故障显示以及相应的措施，航次计划的制定与监
控，备用系统的使用，ENC基础数据输入与ENC更新等。 
The captain and OOW attended the equipment training should be familiar with the following: familiar 
with the relevant function, menu structure, display settings, safety parameter settings, alarm and fault 
display and the corresponding measures, development and monitoring of voyage plans, use of backup 
systems, ENC basic data entry and ENC updates, etc. 
5.3.1 
透彻地理解电子海图（ENC）数据、数据精度、表示规则、显示模式选择和其他海
图数据格式； 
A thorough understanding of electronic navigation chart (ENC) data, data accuracy, presentation rules, 
display mode selection and other chart data formats; 
5.3.2 
熟悉性能标准所要求的ECDIS 功能，熟练地操作、解释和分析从ECDIS 获取的信
息； 
Familiar with the ECDIS function required by the performance standard, skillfully operate, interpret 
and analyze the information obtained from ECDIS; 
5.3.3 
能够以有助于安全航行的方式监控ECDIS信息，正确地解释和分析从ECDIS（包括
雷达叠加和/或雷达跟踪功能，如装有）获取的信息，并考虑设备的局限性、所有相
连的传感器（包括雷达和AIS，如连接）以及当时的环境和条件； 
Ability to monitor ECDIS information in a manner that facilitates safe navigation, correctly interpret 
and analyze information obtained from ECDIS (including radar overlay and / or radar tracking 
functions, if installed), and consider the limitations of the equipment, all connected sensors (including 
radar and AIS, if connections) and the prevailing environment and conditions; 
5.3.4 
通过 ECDIS 控制的航迹保持功能（当装有）调整船舶航向和航速，使船舶的航行
安全得以保持，并能依照航海惯例清楚简明地交流并确认； 
Through the ECDIS controlled track maintenance function (if installed) adjusts the ship's course and 
speed to keep the ship's navigational safety and is able to communicate and confirm in a clear and 
concise manner in accordance with navigational practices; 
5.3.5 
船长、驾驶员还要具备以下操作程序、系统文件和数据管理的能力：管理海图数据
和系统软件的申请、使用许可证和数据更新，以符合既定的程序；系统和信息更新，
包括根据厂商产品开发，而对ECDIS 系统进行版本升级的能力；创建和维护系统
配置和备份文件、运行记录文件、航线计划文件；使用ECDIS 日志和历史航迹回放
功能，检查系统功能、警报设定和用户反应；使用 ECDIS 航线功能进行航行审查、
航线设计和系统功能的审查。 
Captain, the OOW also has the following operating procedures, system files and data management 
capabilities: management of chart data and system software applications, the licenses and data updates 
to meet the established procedures; system and information updates, including the ability to upgrade 
the ECDIS system according to the makers’ development, development and maintenance of system 
configuration and backup files, log files, route plan files; use ECDIS log and historical track playback, 
system check functions, alarm settings and users response; use ECDIS route function for voyage review, 
route design and system function review. 
ECDIS设备培训结束后，由培训导师对培训效果进行考核监控，并填写ECDIS熟悉

02_45.chapter: 第十五章 货物安全运输管理程序
02_45.text:
第十五章  货物安全运输管理程序 
Chapter 15  Safe Transport of Cargo Management Procedure 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and scope 
1.1 为保障船舶安全运载货物，特制定本程序。 
For the safe transport of cargo by ships, this procedure is specially formulated. 
1.2 谷物以外的固体散装货物的运输应符合《国际海运固体散货(IMSBC)规则》的相关规定。 
The carriage of solid bulk cargoes other than grain shall be in compliance with the relevant provisions of 
the < International Maritime Solid Bulk Cargoes Code (IMSBC Code) >. 
1.3 散装谷物的运输需遵守《国际散装谷物安全运输规则》和地方规定。 
The carriage of grain bulk shall be in compliance with the relevant provisions of the < International Code 
for the Safety Carriage of Grain in Bulk (IGC)> and the local regulation.  
1.4 货物单元在整个航程中，应按照许可的《货物系固手册》进行装载、积载和系固。 
The cargo units shall be loaded, stowed and secured throughout the voyage in accordance with the Cargo 
Securing Manual approved by the Administration. 
1.5 满足危险货物运输的船舶运载危险货物，还需遵守《国际海运危险货物（IMDG）规则》。 
Ship that meet the conditions for the carriage of dangerous goods shall be in comply with the 
International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code when carrying dangerous goods. 
1.6 本程序适用于船管部、海务部和所有船舶。 
This procedure applies to the Fleet Department, Marine Department and all ships. 
2.0 定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
2.1 固体散装货物的定义：系指除液体或气体以外，由粒子、颗粒或较大块状物质组成的
任何货物，成分通常一致，并直接装入船舶的货物处所而无需任何中间围护形式。例
如散装干货铝土矿、铁矿和散装谷物。 
Solid bulk cargo means any material, other than liquid or gas, consisting of a combination of particles, 
granules or any larger piece of material, generally uniform in composition, which is loaded directly into the 
cargo spaces of a ship without any immediate form of containment. Examples of such dry cargo are bauxite, 
iron ore and grain in bulk. 
2.2 散装谷物，谷物包括小麦、玉蜀黍（苞米）、燕麦、稞麦、大麦、大米、豆类、种子
以及由其加工而成并在自然状态下具有类似特征的制品。 
Grain in bulk，the grain covers wheat, maize (corn), oats, rye, barley, rice, pulses, seeds and processed 
forms thereof, whose behaviors is similar to that of grain in its natural state 
2.3 货物单元（Cargo Units）的定义：系指车辆（公路车辆、滚装拖车等）、铁路车辆、
集装箱、板材、托盘、便携式容器、中间散装容器、包装单元、成组货、其他货物运
输单元如船运箱盒、件杂货如线材卷、重货如火车头和变压器。 
Means vehicles（road vehicles, roll trailers, etc.）, railway wagons, containers, flats, pallets, portable tanks, 
intermediate bulk containers（IBC）, packaged units, unit loads, other cargo carrying units such as shipping 
cassettes, cargo entities such as steel coils and heavy cargo items such as locomotives and transformers. 
2.4 集装箱货物运输（container transport） 是以集装箱作为运输单位进行货物运输的
一种运输方式。 
Container cargo transportation (container transport), It is a kind of transportation method that uses the 
container as a cargo unit for transferring cargo. 
2.5 危险货物的定义：系指具有爆炸、易燃、毒害、腐蚀、放射性、污染危害性等特性，
在船舶载运过程中，容易造成人身伤害、财产损失或者环境污染而需要特别防护的物

程序手册                            版本/修改：3.0/1.0                       PRO-15 
Procedure Manual                     Version/Revise:3.0/1.0                     PRO-15 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                    生效日期：2022/05/10         第2/3页 
    Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.      Effective Date: 2022/05/10           Page: 2/3 
品。 
Definition of dangerous cargo: refers to the explosion, flammable, toxic, corrosive, radioactive, hazardous 
pollution and other characteristics, in the process of transport onboard the ship, easily lead to personal 
injury, property damage or environmental pollution and need for special protection items. 
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 在装载装货物之前，船长需检查船舶证书及船舶适货条件，船长和大副应全面掌握关
于船舶稳性、强度和标准装载条件下全面的货物信息。 
Prior to loading cargo, the master shall check the ship’s certificate and suitability of carrying, the master 
and chief officer shall be in possession of comprehensive information on the ship's stability/strength and on 
the distribution of cargo for the standard loading conditions. 
3.2 船长需根据租家指示和航运法规，及时报告和递交商务文件，并谨慎签署货物文件。 
Masters should report and submit business documents in a timely in accordance with charterers` 
instructions and shipping regulations. also master be very vigilant in signing cargo documents 
3.3 大副就货物的安全操作直接向船长负责。 
The Chief Officer is directly responsible to the Master for the safety of the Cargo operations. 
3.4 被委派值班的人员在货物操作时直接向大副负责，并应按照大副的指令执行。 
Personnel delegated for the duty watchkeeping during cargo operations are directly responsible to the Chief 
Officer and shall discharge such orders as instructed by the Chief Officer. 
3.5 轮机长负责所有燃油、轻油、滑油的加装和驳油等作业。 
The Chief Engineer is responsible for the safe & smooth execution of all fuel oil, diesel, lubricating oil 
bunker and transfer operations. 
3.6 对于危险货物，船长负责检查并确定危险货物的适装准备；向海务部报告配载图和“危
险货物装前检查表”；监控货物的装卸操作和保管。 
The captain is responsible for checking and determining the suitability of dangerous cargo; report the 
stowage plan and the "pre-shipment checklist for dangerous cargo" to Marine department; and monitor the 
handling and storage of the cargo. 
3.7 海务部负责监控和指导船舶的货物装载； 
The Marine Department is responsible for monitoring and directing the loading of dangerous cargo of 
ships; 
3.8 机务总管负责相关证书的提供，和提供监测设备、系固设备等。 
Technical superintendent is responsible for the provision of relevant certificates, and provide the 
monitoring equipment or lashing equipment, etc. 
4.0 载重线要求 
Requirements of the international convention on load lines 
4.1 为保证船舶有足够的稳性，并避免过度的结构应力,应遵守载重线公约，并满足船旗国
的要求。 
In order to secure sufficient stability of the ship and the avoidance of excessive structural stress，The 
international convention on load lines should be complied, the requirements of the flag state should be met. 
4.2 使用多重载重线时，至少考虑以下几点： 
When multiple load line assignment, considering at least the following points:  
 
在任何给定时间内，仅仅一份载重线证书可以使用。 
One (1) Load Line Certificate is in use at any given time.  
 
附加载重线证书保存在单独的文件中，并由船长安全保管。 
 
Additional Load Line Certificate(s) is/are kept in a separated file and kept under the safe custody of 

程序手册                            版本/修改：3.0/1.0                       PRO-15

    Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.      Effective Date: 2022/05/10           Page: 3/3 
the Master.  
 
当载重线标志更改时，需要记录在航海日志中。 
Official entry shall be made in the log book for change in Load Line marking. 
 
当使用附加载重线时，GT 和NT 将保持不变，最深吃水状态也不许改变。 
GT and NT will remain unaltered as well as the deepest draft condition. 
 
其他法定证书，可以不同于附加载重线证书，国际载重线证书应仅包括与船舶指定干舷相对应
的最大载重量。 
Other statutory certificates, different than the additional International Load Line Certificate, shall 
include only the maximum deadweight corresponding to the vessel’s assigned freeboard. 
 
当船舶更换载重线时，应遵守船旗国和认可组织的要求，并做好载重线转换记录（如有要求）。 
When the ship changes the load line, the requirements of the Flag State and Recognized Organization 
should be complied, and record of conditions of assignment of load lines (If required).  
5.0 危险货物运输的工作要求 
Work requirements for the transportation of dangerous cargo  
4.1 船舶应按照《船舶手册》中的“危险货物运输注意事项”的要求做好危险品的装载。 
The ship shall load the dangerous cargo in accordance with the requirements of the "Notice of the Transport 
of Dangerous Cargo" in the ‘Ship Manual’. 
4.2 海务部如发现配载图和“危险货物装前检查表”中存在问题，应及时通知船舶进行改
正。 
If the Marine department found a problem between the stowage plan and the "pre-shipment checklist for 
dangerous cargo", should make a promptly notify the ship to correct. 
4.3 船舶应按《船舶手册》中的有关规定作好危险货物的接收、装卸和保管。如果船上人
员发现所承运的危险货物在装卸和运载过程中发现异常情况，应立即向海务部报告。 
Ships shall responsible for the receipt, handling and storage of dangerous cargo, in accordance with the 
relevant provisions in the ‘Ship Manual’. If the ship's personnel during the loading, unloading and 
transporting process found that abnormal circumstances of the dangerous cargo, should immediately report 
to the Marine department. 
4.4 机务总管负责装运危险货物所必需的设施和相应的监测仪器的配备、检验和保养，并
向船舶提供相关证书。 
Technical superintendent is responsible for the requisition, inspections and maintenance of corresponding 
monitoring equipment necessary for the shipment of dangerous cargo and provide of relevant certificates to 
the ship. 
6.0 记录和归档 
Records and archives 
货物装卸纪录和绑扎检查记录于航海日志，船舶配载图和“危险货物装前检查表”应
留船，保存至少二年 
Cargo operation and lasing inspection want be recorded in logbook. The ship's stowage plan and the 
‘Pre-shipment checklist for dangerous cargo’ should be kept on board at least two years 
7.0 相关文件 
Related documents 
《船舶手册》、《系固手册》 
"Ship Manual", “Cargo Securing Manual”

Schedule

02_46_0.text:
第十六章 风险评估程序 
Chapter 16  Risk Assessment Procedure 
 
1 
目的和范围： 
Purpose and Scope: 
1.1 提供适当的方法，以识别对船舶、人员和环境的风险，并采取适当的控制措施，防止
危害的发生或减轻危害的程度，确保船舶、人员及海洋环境和大气环境的安全。 
Provide appropriate means to identify risks to ships, persons and the environment and take appropriate 
control measures to prevent the occurrence of hazards or reduce the degree of harm to ensure that the ship, 
personnel and the marine environment and atmospheric environment safety. 
1.2 本程序针对船舶、船员、海洋环境和大气环境任何风险所开展的评估活动,适用于公司
纳入体系的所有部门、船舶和人员。 
This procedure evaluates any risks to the ship, crew, marine environment and the atmospheric environment, 
applies to all departments, vessels and personnel within the Company.  
2 
定义 
Definition 
2.1 危害 (Hazards) 是潜在损伤、伤害和损害的根源。它可能来自许多来源，例如：情况、
环境或人为因素等。 
A hazard is a source of potential injury, harm or damage. It may come from many sources, e.g., situations, 
the environment or a human element etc. 
2.2 风险（Risk）：是指危害发生的可能性和造成后果的严重性的结合。 
Risk is the combination of the likelihood of harm and the seriousness of the consequences. 
2.3 风险评估（Risk Assessment）是识别工作中存在的危害、分析风险等级、考虑处于危险中
的人，评估危害是否得到充分控制、考虑到哪些措施已采取的过程。 
The risk assessment process identifies hazards present in a work undertaking, analyses the level of risk, 
considers those in danger and evaluates whether hazards are adequately controlled, taking into account 
any measures already in place. 
2.4 安全（Safety）：是指不存在不可接受的风险。 
Safety means that freedom from unacceptable risk 
2.5 本程序将危害/损害发生的可能性 (Likelihood)分成五级，使用阿拉伯数字1-2-3-4-5
表示。 
The likelihood of harm or damage may occur were divides into five levels in this procedure, represented 
by Arabic numerals 1-2-3-4-5. 
2.6 本程序将潜在危害/损害发生的严重性 (Severity)分成五级，使用罗马数字
I-II-III-IV-V 表示。. 
The potential severity of the harm or damage were divides into five levels in this procedure, which are 
represented by Roman numerals I-II-III-IV-V. 
2.7 本程序使用矩阵分析法，结合风险的两个要素：指危害/损害发生的可能性和潜在危害
/损害发生的严重性，通过乘积数值把风险分类为：极低风险，低风险，中度风险，高
风险，极高风险。 
In this procedure, a matrix analysis the product of two elements of risk: the likelihood that harm or 
damage may occur and the potential severity of the harm or damage. categorized in a risk factor matrix as: 
Very Low risk, Low risk, Medium risk, High risk, Very High risk. 
3 
职责 

123

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/4.0                         PRO-16 
Procedure Manual                     Version/Revise:3.0/4.0                    PRO-16 
 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2026/04/15        第2/12页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2026/04/15         Page: 2/12 
Responsibilities 
3.1 指定人员负责组织对安全和防污染管理活动的风险评估，负责风险评估的总体控制。 
The Designated Person is responsible for organizing the risk assessment of safety and pollution prevention 
management activities and responsible for overall control of risk assessment 
3.2 体系管理部负责组织公司可能的风险评估工作，并督促有关部门制定控制措施。 
The ISM Department is responsible for organizing the possible company risk assessment. and urging 
relevant departments to formulate control measures. 
3.3 海务部、船管部和船员部负责对本职能部门认定的风险进行管理和审核，验证船舶实
施了风险评估及风险控制。 
The Marine Department, Fleet department and crew department are responsible for manage and review the 
risks assessments identified by every department, examining the implementation of the ship risk assessment 
and control. 
3.4 体系管理部负责对风险评估结果进行汇总、整理、编制《风险评估文件夹》，《风险评
估文件夹》按照文件控制要求发放和保持，体系管理部负责每年进行一次风险评估有
效性的复查， 
The ISM department is responsible for summarizing and collating the results of risk assessment, compiling 
risk assessment folders, release and maintenance according to the Document Control Procedure. The ISM 
department shall review the validity of risk assessment annually, 
3.5 体系管理部负责定期对岸基人员进行风险评估的培训，在上船前对管理级船员进行风
险评估的培训。 
The ISM department is responsible for regular risk assessment training for shore-based personnel, and 
conducted the risk assessment training for senior officer before boarding. 
3.6 船长负责本船现场操作风险评估的培训、组织、监督、评价和改进。 
The Master is responsible for the training, organization, supervision, appraisal and improvement of 
shipboard on-site operational risk assessment. 
3.7 船长或操作执行者负责本船现场操作风险评估的实施和记录。 
The Master or the operator is responsible for the implementation and recording of shipboard on-site 
operational risk assessment. 
3.8 船舶对本船生产活动中可能出现的风险进行评估和控制，填报《风险评估报告》。 
The ship assesses and controls the risks that may occur in the ship activities and fill up the "Risk assessment 
report". 
3.9 船舶现场风险评估应该由具有丰富的工作知识和所从事工作的经验的称职人员进行，
至少应包括一名管理级船员，并尽可能让工作中涉及的人员都参加。 
The assessments should be done by a competent crew that have a good working knowledge of the vessel, 
and experience in the job at hand. At least one senior officer, other persons involved in the work as 
possible. 
4 工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 风险的识别 
Risks Identification 
4.1.1 公司在现有安全管理体系建立和运行过程中，已对船舶、人员和环境的风险进行了识
别、评估和描述。 
During the development and operation of the existing safety management system, the Company has 
identified, evaluated and described the risks of ships, personnel and the environment. 
4.1.2 公司应按本程序规定，在有关的管理活动中持续识别风险及其危害性，并采取相应的

124

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/4.0                         PRO-16 
Procedure Manual                     Version/Revise:3.0/4.0                    PRO-16 
 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2026/04/15        第3/12页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2026/04/15         Page: 3/12 
措施。 
The Company shall in accordance with the procedures, continue to identify risks and their hazards in the 
relevant management activities and take corresponding measures. 
4.2 已识别的主要风险 
Identified main risks 
 人员伤病、死亡； 
Personnel injury, death; 
 船舶火灾； 
Shipboard fire; 
 船舶碰撞、搁浅、翻沉等海上事故； 
Ship collision, grounding, capsize and other accidents at sea; 
 水体污染； 
Water pollution; 
 大气污染； 
Air pollution; 
 岸上污染； 
Land pollution; 
 货损货差； 
Cargo damage, cargo figure discrepancy; 
 船体结构损坏； 
Hull structure damage; 
 船舶机器设备损坏；  
Damage to ship machinery and equipment; 
 极端恶劣天气；  
Extreme weather; 
 船舶被港口国检查滞留； 
Ship detained by the Port State control; 
 船舶保安事件； 
Ship security incident; 
 战争威胁； 
War threat; 
 自然灾害；  
Natural disasters; 
 财产损失； 
Loss of property; 
 人员违法违纪行为。 
personnel violations of law and discipline; 
 公司声誉受损； 
Damage to company`s reputation; 
 影响客户满意度或商业损失。 
Customer satisfaction or Loss of Business. 
4.3 识别风险的方法 
Identifying risks method 
4.3.1 识别风险可通过提出并回答以下问题发现可能存在的风险： 
To identify risks, potential risks may be found by raising and answering the following questions:  

125

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/4.0                         PRO-16 
Procedure Manual                     Version/Revise:3.0/4.0                    PRO-16 
 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2026/04/15        第4/12页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2026/04/15         Page: 4/12 
 存在什么危害 
what harm exists 
 谁（什么）会受到伤害 
who (what) will be hurt 
 伤害怎样发生 
how to hurt 
4.3.2 在进行风险识别时，要充分考虑发生危害的根源及性质： 
In carrying out risk identification, fully consider the root cause and nature of the hazard: 
 机械伤害 
Mechanical injury 
 高空坠落 
Fall from height 
 冲击和撞击 
Shock and impact 
 中毒、窒息、触电及辐射 
Poisoning, suffocation, electric shock and radiation 
 暴露于化学性危害因素和物理性危害因素的工作环境. 
Exposure to chemical hazards and physical hazards of the working environment 
 人机工程因素（比如工作环境条件或位置的舒适度、重复性工作等） 
Ergonomic factors (such as working environment conditions or location comfort, repetitive work, 
etc.) 
 设备的腐蚀、老化 
Equipment corrosion, aging 
 有毒有害物料、气体的泄漏 
Toxic and hazardous materials, gas leakage 
4.3.3 可能造成的后果包括： 
Possible consequences include: 
 人身伤害、死亡（包括割伤、挫伤、擦伤、烫伤、肢体损伤等） 
personal injury, death (including cuts, contusions, abrasions, burns, physical damage, etc.) 
 疾病（如头痛、呼吸困难、失明、皮肤病、癌症、肢体不能正常动作等） 
Disease (such as headache, breathing difficulty, blindness, skin disease, cancer, limb can not normal 
action, etc.) 
 财产损失 
Property damage 
 环境破坏 
Environmental damage 
4.4 风险评估实施 
Implementation of risk assessment 
     本程序通过以下过程完成风险评估： 
The risk assessment be completed through the following procedures: 
1.    识别危害  
Hazard 
确定和作业有关的所有危害                                       
Identify all the Hazards associated with the work activity  
2.    潜在影响 
Potential 
Consequences 
列出每个风险后果。如果他发展成全部潜能，风险可能有多个结果。   
List each of the consequence of the hazard。 if allowed to develop to its full potential，
the hazard may have more than one consequence. 

126

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/4.0                         PRO-16 
Procedure Manual                     Version/Revise:3.0/4.0                    PRO-16 
 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2026/04/15        第5/12页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2026/04/15         Page: 5/12 
3.    预防措施 
Existing 
Preventive 
Controls 
包括工作安全、船舶操作、货物操作等体系要的规定和要求，行业标准
（例如COSWP 等），和相关风险评估文件。                       
Include the regulations and requirements of safe operation, ship operations, cargo 
operations, industry standards (e.g.COSWP, etc.) , relevant risk assessment document. 
4.    风险决断  
 Determined Risk  
a. 确定每一风险的潜在严重程度-参照表1， 记录到“风险决断”a 列。   
Identify the Potential Severity number of each hazard – refer to Table 1 on next page; 
Record in Determined Risk Column “a”. 
b. 确定可能发生频率的风险字母-参照表2，记录到“风险决断”b 列。  
Identify the Risk Letter for the probable Frequency – refer to Table 2 on next page; 
Record in Determined Risk Column “b” . 
c. 从风险矩阵中确定风险程度，极高，高，中，低，极低；记录到“风
险决断”c 列。                                                   
Ascertain risk, H (High) , M(Moderate) or L(Low) from the Risk Matrix, Table 3; 
Record in Determined Risk Column “c”;  
5.  额外的缓解
措施 
Additional 
Mitigating 
Controls 
确定能降低风险，额外的缓解措施（例如，特定情况的特定行动，船舶
特定行动和现有程序和标准不能鉴定的预防措施。当现有程序和标准不
包括这些额外的缓解措施，应提交安全管理体系报告以改进系统。     
Identify additional mitigating actions (e.g. situation specific actions, ship specific action 
and preventive actions not identified by existing procedures and standards) that would 
mitigate the risk.  Where Additional Mitigating Controls are identified that are not 
included in the existing procedures and standards an SMS Report shall be submitted for 
System Improvement. 
6.    剩余风险 
Residual Risk 
a. 确定每一风险的潜在严重程度-参照表1， 记录到“剩余风险”a 列。   
Identify the Potential Severity number of each hazard – refer to Table 1 on next page; 
Record in Residual Risk Column a. 
b. 确定可能发生频率的风险字母-参照表2， 记录到“剩余风险”b 列。 
Identify the Risk Letter for the probable Frequency – refer to Table 2 on next page; 
Record in Residual Risk Column b. 
c. 从风险矩阵中确定风险程度，极高，高，中，低，极低；记录到“剩
余风险”c 列。                                                   
Ascertain risk, H (High) , M(Moderate) or L(Low) from the Risk Matrix, Table 3; 
Record in Residual Risk Column c. 
7.     复核剩余风险，采取额外措施后决定是否继续工作。                          
Review the residual risk obtained at Residual Risk Column c, after additional controls are taken to decide 
whether to proceed with intended work.  
 
4.4.1 风险评估应包括以下内容 
The risk assessment shall include the following contents 
 识别危害，界定风险的定义及范围； 
Identify hazards, define the definition and scope of risk;

4.5 
进一步控制措施和额外的缓解措施 
Further Control Measures and Additional Mitigating Controls 
4.5.1 重新确定进一步控制措施应考虑的手段： 
Means should consider to re-identification of further control measures: 
 消除危险产生的来源； 
Eliminate the source of the danger; 
 尝试控制危险来源，降低风险； 
Try to control the source of danger and reduce the risk; 
 采取更先进的技术以提高防范措施； 
Take more advanced technology to improve preventive measures; 
 确保应急安排就绪。 
Ensure the readiness of emergency arrangements. 
4.5.2 应对重新确定的进一步控制措施进行评估并满足以下要求： 
Should carried out the assessment on the re-identified further control measures and meet the following 
requirements: 
 可执行； 
Executable 
 效果充分； 
Fully effectiveness 
 成本合理 
Reasonable cost； 
 不会产生新的风险； 
Do not induce new risks 
 不明显影响其它管理或操作活动。 
Does not significantly affect other management or operational activities 
4.5.3 针对中度以上级别的风险，均应进一步评估，并重新确定防范措施，将风险降到可控
制之中。 
Targeted to moderate or higher levels risks, further evaluated and re-identification preventive measures 
should be carried out to reduce the risk to controllable level. 
4.5.4 如果采取进一步控制措施和额外的缓解措施后，剩余风险仍然为极高，船舶不能直接
行动。需寻求公司的建议和批准。必须采取合适的额外控制措施去降低剩余风险。           
If Residual Risk is Very High, DO NOT PROCEED. Master should report to company for advice and 
approval. Appropriate additional controls must be taken to reduce residual risk.   
4.5.5 船长将公司的审批意见存档。以上评估活动应记录在“风险评估报告”中。 
Master should file the company comments, the above assessment activities should be recorded in the 
‘Risk Assessment Report’.

The Company and fleet shall adopt common standards for risk assessment, identify potential risks that are 
generally recognized and undesirable operations according to the source of risk and shipboard usual 
practice; then develop <Risk Assessment Folder>. 
5.2 公司为船舶的常规操作和关键性操作的通用部分进行风险评估，确定最佳做法，在船
队中推行，船舶在进行这些操作前，要参照《风险评估文件夹》该项作业的要求对即
将进行的作业可能带来的风险进行控制。当在特殊作业环境和作业条件下或进行非常
规作业前，船舶需要进行独立的风险评估来控制风险并报请指定人员批准； 
The Company shall make risk assessment on the common parts of shipboard routine operations and 
critical operations define best practice and promote it across the fleet. Before undertaking these operations, 
the ship shall control the potential risks which may be caused by forthcoming operations with reference to 
the requirement in <Risk Assessment Folder>. The ship shall make independent risk assessments to 
control the risk and obtain DPA’s approval before under taking operations under special environment and 
conditions or undertaking non-routine operations. 
5.3 体系管理部每年复查风险评估的有效性，填写PRO-16-02《风险评估复查报告》，向指

第十七章  海务安全管理工作程序 
Chapter 17  Marine Safety Management Work Procedure 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and scope 
1.1 为保证船舶航行安全，实施海务管理制度特制定本程序。 
To ensure the safety navigation of ships, the implementation of the Marine management system specially 
formulated this procedure. 
1.2 本程序适用于海务部和公司所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to the Marine Department and the ships managed by Company. 
2.0 定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
普航仪器：磁罗经(包括标准罗经操舵罗经) 、天文钟、六分仪、秒表、船钟、气压计、
温度计、干湿温度计、水温计、风向风速仪或手提风速仪、双筒望远镜、放大镜、两
脚规、平行尺或三角尺等。 
General navigation equipment: magnetic compass (including standard compassing compass, steering 
compass), chronometer, sextant, stopwatch, ship’s clock, barometer, thermometer, dry and wet 
thermometer, water thermometer, wind speed anemometer or portable anemometer, binoculars, magnifying 
glass, dividers, parallel ruler or triangular ruler. 
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 海务部 
Marine Department 
3.1.1 监控船舶航线的设计和船舶航行安全； 
Monitoring the planning of the ship's route and the safety navigation of ships; 
3.1.2 收集船舶航行海区的气象信息，适时提供给相关船舶，指导船舶安全航行; 
To collect the weather information of the ship sailing area, timely provided to the relevant ship to guide 
the ship safe navigation; 
3.1.3 对船舶申请的电子海图、纸版海图、航海图书等进行审核后负责安排供船。 
To review the order of electronic charts, paper charts, nautical publications, etc. from ships. After 
approval, arrange to order and delivery to ship. 
3.1.4 在恶劣气象条件下指导船舶落实安全预防措施； 
To guide the ship to implement safety precautions under adverse weather conditions; 
3.1.5 监督船舶对航海图书、普航仪器的管理和提供岸基支持。 
Supervise the ship's nautical publications, General navigation equipment management and provide 
shore-based support. 
3.2 船舶 
Ships 
3.2.1 保持船舶航海图书和普航仪器的完整性、实效性； 
To maintain the integrity and effectiveness of ship nautical publications and General navigation 
equipment; 
3.2.2 船舶需将所有有效的电子海图、纸质海图及航海图书资料录入SMIS 系统，任何更新
及时在SMIS 系统中予以补充或修改。 
The ship shall enter all valid electronic charts, paper charts and nautical publications data into the SMIS 
system, and any updates shall be supplemented or modified in the SMIS system in a timely manner. 
3.2.3 及时报告本船航次计划。 
Timely report of the voyage passage plan.

4.0 工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 航海图书管理 
Nautical publications management 
4.1.1 海务主管 
Marine Department Superintendent: 
 根据船舶的申请以及航经海区，及时为船舶安排航海图书资料； 
In accordance with the application of the ship and the sea area, to arrange nautical publications for 
the ship in time; 
 及时为船舶提供最新的相关图书资料的出版信息； 
timely for the ship to provide the latest relevant information on the books publication information; 
  对于公司新购进的船舶,尽早了解其航海图书资料的配备情况,根据该可能涉及
的航区的需要及时补充、配备航海图书资料。 
For the company newly purchased ship, as soon as possible to understand its nautical publications 
onboard situation, according to the sea area may be navigated in, needs of the timely supplied, 
equipped with nautical publications information. 
4.1.2 船舶按《船舶手册》中的相关规定进行航海图书的保管、改正，保持其完整性、有效
性。 
The ship should accordance with the relevant provisions in "Ship Manual", to keep, correct nautical 
publications, and maintain its integrity and validity. 
4.2 普航仪器管理 
General navigation equipment management 
4.2.1 海务主管 
Marine Department Superintendent: 
  了解船舶所配备的普航仪器; 
understand the General navigation equipment equipped onboard; 
  对船舶普航仪器的正确使用进行技术指导。 
Technical guidance for the proper use of the ship's General navigation equipment. 
4.2.2 船舶按《船舶手册》中有关规定进行普航仪器的保管、维护，保持其完整性、有效性。 
The ship should accordance with the relevant provisions in "Ship Manual", to keep, maintain General 
navigation equipment, and maintain its integrity and validity. 
4.2.3 普航仪器的配备、申领和修理向船管部申请。 
Application should make to Fleet department for the install, order and repair of General navigation 
equipment. 
4.3 监控船舶安全航行 
Monitoring the safety navigation of ships 
4.3.1 海务部经理 
Marine Department Manager 
 收集船舶航行海区的气象资料，分析船舶所在海区气象，指导船舶及早避开恶劣
海况以保证船舶安全航行，跟踪、指导在大风浪海域中航行的船舶的状况。 
Collect the weather data of the ship's sea area, analyze the weather of the ship’s sea area, and guide 
the ship to avoid the adverse sea conditions as soon as possible, so as to ensure the safety navigation 
of the ship, and to track and guide the ship condition when navigating in stormy sea area. 
 在台风直接威胁船舶前24 小时, 在海务部建立24 小时昼夜防抗台值班, 保持与
船舶通讯联系，指导船舶防抗台直至船舶脱离威胁。 
24 hours before the typhoon directly threatens the ship, Marine department should established a 
24-hour prevent and anti-typhoon duty, to maintain communication with the ship and guide the ship

escape from the threat. 
 将防抗台风及大风浪的情况及时向总经理汇报，并通知相关部门。 
Report the prevent and anti-typhoon and stormy situation to the General manager in a timely manner, 
and notify the relevant departments. 
4.3.2 海务主管 
Marine Department Superintendent:  
 跟踪监控船舶及时报备航次计划，根据不同季节的洋区海况和船舶尺度及载货特
点，在必要时及时向跨洋船舶或执行新航线的船舶提出航线设计的建议，以保证
船舶设计的航线符合安全、经济原则。 
Tracking and monitoring of the ship to prepare the voyage plan in time, according to the sea state of 
the ocean in different seasons, the ship size and cargo characteristics, if necessary, provide the 
passage plan recommendations to the trans-ocean ship or the ship implementing new routes in timely 
manner, to ensure the ship passage plan in line with the safety and economic principles. 
 对在冬季大风浪和夏季台风时期跨洋船舶以及执行新航线的特殊船舶实施安全航
行跟踪。每天收集和分析船舶海区气象资料，适时建议船长做好大风浪航行的各
项准备，避开恶劣天气的海域以确保船舶安全。 
During winter storms and summer typhoons period, implement safe navigation tracking for the 
trans-ocean vessels and special vessels implementing new routes. Daily collect and analyze the 
weather data of the ship's sea area, and timely recommend the master to prepare for the storm and 
avoid the adverse weather to ensure the safety of the ship. 
 对船舶实施登轮检查和相关海务指导。 
Implementation boarding inspection and related marine guidance for the ship. 
4.3.3 船舶按《船舶手册》中的要求，制定航次计划，并向海务主管报告航次计划。 
The ship shall, in accordance with the requirements of the "Ship Manual", formulate passage plan and 
report the passage plan to the Marine Department Superintendent. 
4.4 海损事故处理 
Marine accident handling 
4.4.1 海务主管收到船舶发生海损事故的报告后，应报告海务部经理，并按相关程序要求进
行事故调查。 
After receiving a report on the occurrence of a marine accident, the Marine Department Superintendent 
shall report to the Marine Department Manager, and conduct an accident investigation according to the 
relevant procedures. 
4.4.2 船舶按《船舶手册》中有关海事处理的规定准备海事声明、海事报告及法定日记的复
印件等，备妥海事处理所需的证据材料。 
The ship shall prepare a copy of note of protest, sea protest and official logbook in accordance with the 
provisions of marine processing in the "Ship Manual", and prepare the evidence necessary for marine 
processing.

第十八章  关键性设备和系统的标识程序 
Chapter 18 Critical equipment & System identifying procedure 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and scope 
1.1 本程序旨在对船舶安全营运和防止污染关键性设备和系统进行标识，使这些设备和设施
非常明显和清楚，对操作者提供正确的操作、试验和有效措施，保证这些设备和系统的
随时可用性和可靠性。 
This procedure is intended to identify the ship's safe operation and to prevent the contamination of critical 
equipment and systems, to made these equipment and facilities are very obvious and clear, to provide the 
correct operation, testing and effective measures to the operator, to ensure the availability and reliability of 
these devices and systems at all time. 
1.2 本程序适用于公司所管理的船舶关键性设备和系统的标识和管理。 
This procedure applies to the identification and management of the company managed ship's critical 
equipment and system. 
2.0 定义 
Definitions  
2.1 关键性设备和系统：因突发性运行故障或因操作不当而导致险情的设备和技术系统。这
些设备和系统如在操作前存在缺陷，一旦使用可能使船舶处于危险状态。 
Critical equipment and systems: Equipment and technical systems that are dangerous due to sudden 
Operational failure or due to improper operation. These equipment and systems such have defects before 
operations, if used, may make the ship in a dangerous situation. 
2.2 判断船舶关键性设备及系统的依据： 
To determine the ship's critical equipment and systems based on: 
 国际和船旗国有关公约、规则等有关资料; 
Relevant information in international conventions and flag States regulations; 
 公司船舶营运中的经验教训。 
Lessons learned from the operation of the company. 
 船舶关键设备由办公室经过全面细致的风险评估后决定。 
Critical equipment’s for the ships are determined after a careful risk assessment in the office.  
 每一条船都应该有关键设备和系统清单，并且在公司清单基础上再加上或者换上自
己评判的内容。 
Each ship should have a list of critical equipment and systems and add every own judgment to the 
company’s list

3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船管部：负责对船舶关键性设备和系统进行标识工作；对船舶设备标识负指导、监督
和检查责任。 
Fleet Department: responsible for identify the ship's critical equipment and systems, responsible for 
guidance, supervision and inspection of the ship equipment. 
3.2 船舶：船长是实施保持、检查船舶关键性设备和系统标识的主要责任人。轮机长和大
副分别对轮机部和甲板部关键性设备和系统实施标识，将标明的关键性设备和系统的
监督、检查和维护列入日常工作之中。 
Ships: The captain is the primary responsible person for the maintenance, inspection of the ship's critical 
equipment and system identification. The chief engineer and chief officer responsible for engine and deck 
department critical equipment and system identification respectively, to include the monitoring, inspection 
and maintenance of identified critical equipment and systems in the daily work. 
3.3  船舶各主管人员：负责自己职责范围内的设备和系统标识的维护、检查。 
The persons in charge of the ship: responsible for equipment and system identification maintenance, 
inspection within their scope of duties. 
4.0  关键性设备和系统 
Critical equipment & System

Ship’s critical equipment and system and spare list.

关键设备的备件应一直保持在船上，并标示为关键备件。准确的库存应保持在船上。

Spares for critical equipment shall be maintained on board at all times and shall be identified as critical 
spares. Accurate inventories shall be maintained on board. This inventory has to be approved by the 
ship management department. A monthly record of the critical spares inventory shall be maintained on 
board the vessel in Forms(PRO-8-04). 
 
4.1.2 船舶设备和系统标识要求包括但不限于如下： 
Ship equipment and system identification requirements include, but not limited to following: 
1） 关键性设备的机体上都要有明确的文字或符号标识； 
The engine body of critical equipment must have a clear text or symbol identification; 
2） 消防系统和应急消防系统阀门用信号红红色标识； 
Fire system and emergency fire system valve with red signal identification; 
3） 消防系统和应急消防系统管路用信号红红色环带和流向标识； 
Fire system and emergency fire system pipeline with red signal belt and flow direction 
identification; 
4） 救生艇、救生衣用橘黄色标识； 
Lifeboats, life jackets with orange identification; 
5） 海水系统用绿色环带和流向标识； 
Seawater system with green belt and flow direction identification; 
6） 淡水用蓝色环带和流向标识； 
Freshwater with blue belt and flow direction identification; 
7） 滑油系统用黄色环带和流向标识； 
Lubricating oil system with yellow belt and flow direction identification; 
8） 重油系统用深棕色环带和流向标识； 
Heavy fuel oil system with dark brown belt and flow direction 
identification; 
9） 轻油系统用粉红色环带和流向标识； 
Diesel & gas oil system with pink belt and flow direction identification;

4.2 关键性设备和系统的维护和试验 
Maintenance and testing of critical equipment and systems 
 
4.2.1 关键性设备和系统的维护，要列入船舶的年度维护保养计划和日常维护工作中，按
照《船舶预防性维护保养程序》进行计划维护保养。 
Maintenance of critical equipment and systems shall be included in the ship annual maintenance plan 
and routine maintenance work, implement planned maintenance in accordance with the Ship 
Preventive Maintenance Procedures. 
4.2.2 通过《船上操作方案的制定程序》将下列对关键性设备的检查和试验写入船舶操作
方案,特别是针对备用设备和非连续使用的设备（救生设备、消防设备、防污染设备、
应急设备、主机抵港前的机动操作试验）： 
Through the Shipboard Operations Establishment Procedure, the following inspection and testing of 
critical equipment written in ship operation measures, in particular for spare equipment and 
non-continuous use equipment (life-saving equipment, fire-fighting equipment, pollution prevention 
equipment, emergency equipment, main engine pre-arrival manoeuvring operation test): 
1） 船舶出航前检查和试验； 
Ships pre-departure inspection and testing; 
2） 船舶到港前检查和试验； 
Ships pre-arrival inspection and testing; 
3） 设备使用前后的检查和试验； 
Equipment before and after use inspection and testing; 
4） 部分周期性检查和试验。 
Partial periodic inspection and testing.

版本/修改：3.0/2.0

PRO-18

Page: 7/8 
 
 
4.2.4 关键设备和系统保养的要求 
Requirement of Maintenance On Critical Equipment and systems 
 
每当执行关键设备保养时，应清楚地牢记船的应急备用状态可能受到影响。正是因为
这一原因，在实施保养前，应进行全面的风险评估。 
Whenever maintenance on critical equipment is carried out, it should be clearly borne in mind that vessel’s 
emergency readiness may get affected. It is for this reason that before any maintenance is undertaken, a 
comprehensive risk assessment is carried out. 
公司已经通过 PMS 系统规定了关键保养工作。这些工作需要由船舶做风险评估并经过
DPA 技术主管或者船队经理批准。当风险评估批准后它的有效期要注明。尽可能在工作
开展前24 小时获得批准。当执行风险评估应考虑以下: 
Company has identified “Critical PMS jobs” through the PMS system. For these items a Risk  
Assessment will need to be done by the vessel and approved by DPA and Technical Superintendent or 
Fleet Manager. The validity of risk assessment should be mentioned when approving. So far as possible, 
approval for the job needs to be obtained at least 24 hours prior carrying out the job. When carrying out 
the Risk assessment following should be taken into account: 
1) 预计行动时船舶的状态 
Vessel’s status at the time of intended activity 
2) 被评估的设备及设备的功能  
Equipment being assessed and functionality of the Equipment 
3) 实施工作的时期  
Duration of work activity 
4) 如果这个设备不能运转(最坏情况)的可能的后果  
Possible Consequences if this equipment is not in operation (Worst Case Scenario) 
5) “备用”设备/可用的替代设备的具体情况 
Details of ‘Stand-by’ Unit/ Redundancy’ available including Alternative Backup  
6) 恢复/缓解措施及使用额外的‘安全程序’  
    Recovery/ Mitigation’ measures and additional ‘Safety Procedures’ to be employed. 
7) 调试和测试程序备用”设备/可用的替代设备的具体情况 
      Commissioning and Testing Procedures 
 
关闭设备前得到公司批准，就关闭的期间在公司和船舶之间达成协议。如果在同意
关闭期间内无法完成和 /或环境变化，与公司协调，考虑环境条件、船员疲劳、操
作参数等进行进一步的风险评估。根据上述风险评估任何延长或替代的行动应由DPA
及机务主管或船队经理批准并同意。 
Office approval should be taken prior shutdown and the shutdown period should be agreed upon 
between the office and the vessel. If the agreed shut down period cannot be achieved and/or the 
circumstances change, a further risk assessment is to be conducted in coordination with the office taking 
into account environmental conditions, crew fatigue, operational parameters, etc. On basis of the above 
risk assessment any extension or alternative actions should be approved by the DPA and Technical 
Superintendent or Fleet Manager and agreed with. 
 
在关键设备失灵或设备有故障的情况下，应该立即报告公司。 
In case there is a breakdown of the critical system or there is a fault in the equipment, it should be 
immediately reported to the office.

4.3 关键设备和系统的缺陷报告  
Critical equipment and systems defect reporting. Any and all defects are to be reported to the ship 
management   department and relevant risk assessment. Following reporting guideline are to be 
followed when reporting defects: 
任何和所有的缺陷都应报告给船管部，并且随同相关的风险评估。报告缺陷时应遵
守以下报告指南:  
1) Any defect developed should be informed to the Technical department at the earliest, by email. 
尽早通过电子邮件向机务部门报告任何发现的缺陷。  
2) While reporting, the details of defect must be mentioned and relevant risk assessment: 
报告时，必须提及缺陷的具体情况和相关的风险评估报告。 
a) 制造商、类型和型号  
Make, type and model 
b) 故障的详细描述  
Detailed description of fault 
c) 在发展到失灵前的任何特定状况  
Any particular conditions experienced before development of failure 
d) 再次发生的失灵  
Re-occurring failure. 
e) 纠正故障的尝试和结果  
Attempts to correct the fault and results 
f) 估计要求备件，采购订单号  
 Estimated requirements for spare parts, Purchase order no. 
g) 是否需要外部服务 
If external Service is required.

02_49_0.chapter: 第十九章 船舶预防性维护保养程序
02_49_0.text:
第十九章  船舶预防性维护保养程序 
Chapter 19 Ship Preventive Maintenance Procedures 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 本程序规定了船舶预防性维护保养工作的管理方法(不包括通讯导航等驾驶台设备)。通
过实施本程序以保证船舶的技术状态满足有关国际公约、船级社的规范标准和公司的
有关规定。保证船舶始终处于适航状态。 
This procedure specifies the management of the ship's preventive maintenance work (excluding 
communication and navigation equipment at bridge). Through the implementation of the procedures to 
ensure that the technical status of the ship meet the relevant international conventions, classification 
societies standards and the relevant provisions of the company. To ensure the ship is always in a 
seaworthiness state. 
1.2 本程序适用于公司和所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to company and managed ships. 
2.0 定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
（空） 
(blank) 
3.0 职责 
Duties 
3.1 船管部负责船舶SMIS 系统的建立，并对船舶的维护工作的实施情况进行监控和提供
技术、备件和物料等方面的支持。 
The Fleet department is responsible for the establishment of the ship SMIS system and monitors the 
implementation of the maintenance work of the ship and provides technical, spare parts and materials 
support 
3.2 船舶负责实施SMIS 规定的船舶和设备维护。 
The ship is responsible for the implementation of SMIS regulations for the maintenance of ships and 
equipment. 
4.0 工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 维护保养计划 
Maintenance plan 
4.2 各船舶会同机务总管根据船舶随船说明书或维护保养说明书，根据船级社对营运船舶
的检验规范、标准、要求及其设备的技术状况，考虑船舶保养项目的维护保养间隔期
要求，建立SMIS 系统中的维护保养计划程序。 
The ships and technical superintendent, in accordance with the ship instructions manual or maintenance 
instructions manual, according to the classification societies inspection rules, standards, requirements and 
equipment technical conditions, on the operation of the ship, consider the required maintenance interval 
of ship maintenance items, establish the maintenance plan procedures in the SMIS system. 
4.3 维护保养计划应考虑《关键性设备和系统的标识程序》中对关键性设备和系统的定期
维护保养要求。 
Maintenance plan should consider the periodic maintenance requirements for critical equipment and 
systems in the “Critical Equipment & System Identifying Procedure”. 
4.4 轮机长和大副应根据船舶设备维护保养状况，对SMIS 计划中的维护保养周期和要求
提出合理的修改意见。船上提出的修改意见经机务总管审核，部门主管经理批准后实

146

施。 
Chief engineer and chief officer should in accordance with the maintenance condition of ship equipment, 
make reasonable amendment suggestions to the maintenance cycle and requirements in the SMIS plan. 
The amendments suggestions made by ships, reviewed by the technical superintendent, and implement 
after approved by the in-charged department manager. 
4.5 船舶日常维护保养工作计划的内容包括但不限于以下方面： 
The contents of the daily maintenance work plan of the ship include but not limited to the following: 
 船体及上层建筑的钢结构； 
Hull and steel structure superstructure; 
 救生、消防及防污设备； 
Life saving, firefighting and pollution prevention equipment; 
 应急设备 
Emergency equipment 
 航行设备； 
Navigation equipment; 
 舵机及附属设备； 
Steering gear and ancillary equipment; 
 锚泊和系泊设备； 
Anchoring and mooring equipment; 
 主机和副机及其辅助设备； 
Main and auxiliary engine and auxiliary equipment; 
 锅炉及附属设备和蒸汽系统； 
Boilers and ancillary equipment and steam systems; 
 管系和阀门； 
Pipes and valves; 
 货物装卸设备(如有时)； 
Cargo handling equipment (if any); 
 火、气、热探测及警报系统； 
Fire, gas, heat detection and alarm system; 
 机舱污水泵、压载泵及分离系统； 
Engine room bilge pump, ballast pump and separation system; 
 废物处理及生活污水系统； 
waste treatment and sewage treatment plant; 
 按照新生效的公约、规定要求新装设备或改造的设备或系统。 
In accordance with the newly implemented Conventions, regulations require the installation of new 
equipment or modification of equipment or systems. 
5.0 船舶维护保养计划的实施 
Implementation of the ship maintenance plan 
5.1 船舶组织人员实施计划。 
Ship organization personnel implementation plan. 
5.1.1 轮机长和大副依据SMIS中维护保养计划的要求并结合船舶具体航次安排维护保养工
作，并全面控制航次维护保养工作的实施。 
The chief engineer and chief officer of the ship shall, in accordance with the requirements of the 
maintenance plan in SMIS, arrange the maintenance work in accordance with the specific voyage of the 
ship and fully control the implementation of the voyage maintenance work. 
5.1.2 在维护保养工作中，要求轮机长、大副合理安排工作时间，如果确定待泊时间或在港

装卸货时间超过5 天，要求轮机长和大副根据船舶实际情况，抓住时机安排好相关维
护保养工作。 
In the maintenance work, the chief engineer and chief officer are required to arrange the working time 
reasonably. If confirmed berth waiting time or time at berth for loading and discharging is more than 5 
days, the chief engineer and the chief officer are requested, in accordance with actual situation, to take 
the opportunities to arrange related maintenance work. 
5.1.3 各设备主管责任人将维护保养的情况书面报告轮机长或大副，由轮机长或大副在
SMIS 中进行记录。 
The person in-charge of the equipment shall report the maintenance condition in writing to the chief 
engineer or chief officer, chief engineer or chief officer shall record in the SMIS. 
5.1.4 轮机长、大副应对设备主管责任人报告的船舶和设备的维护情况进行审核，以验证工
作质量。 
The chief engineer and chief officer should review the maintenance condition of the ship and equipment 
reported by the person in-charge, to verify the quality of the work. 
5.2 机务总管对维护保养的监控 
Monitor of the maintenance by technical superintendent 
5.2.1 为保证维护保养工作的连续性，机务总管对主要干部船员进行上船前的培训时，向其
阐明公司在维护保养工作方面的要求，根据船舶实际情况，布置下一步的工作重点和
注意事项；加强对接班人员接班后续工作的监督，避免由于工作交接不明而影响后续
维护保养工作的开展。 
In order to ensure the continuity of maintenance work, when carrying out before boarding crew training 
to the senior engineer and officer, the technical superintendent should clarify the company's 
maintenance work requirements, according to the actual ship condition, the layout of the next focus and 
attention to matters; to strengthen the supervision of sign-on crew work, to avoid the impact on 
follow-up maintenance work carried out due to an unclear handover. 
5.2.2 机务总管必须了解自己所管船舶的技术状况和维护保养情况，有效地指导船上进行维
护保养工作，仔细审阅船舶维护保养工作报告，核实其是否和计划相符合。如果与计
划不相符，应及时向轮机长、大副询问原因，提出纠正措施并监督船上实施；对于由
于航次时间安排或海况等客观因素不能完成的项目，轮机长或大副应在报告中说明原
因，机务主管应及时安排船上顺延并重新明确完成时间。 
The technical superintendent must understand the technical condition and maintenance condition of the 
ship in-charged, guide the ship to carry out maintenance work effectively, review the ship maintenance 
work report carefully, to verify whether in line with the plan. If not match with the plan, should ask 
promptly to the chief engineer and chief officer for the reasons, suggest the corrective measures and 
supervise the implementation onboard; for the deviation due to voyage schedule or sea conditions and 
other objective factors, the chief engineer or chief officer should explain the reason in the report. The 
technical superintendent should promptly arrange the ship to postpone and re-define the completion 
time. 
5.2.3 机务总管要及时监督船上填报维护保养记录并进行仔细审阅，发现异常情况要及时反
馈给轮机长或大副，提出纠正意见并监督实施。要求机务总管及时登录SMIS，回复
船上所报的维护保养工作报告；机务总管应通过审核维护保养报告，从中发现后续维
护保养工作中应注意的问题，以便在备件、物料和检修方面提前做出相应的安排，避
免由于备件、物料供应不及时而影响下一步正常的维护保养工作的进度。 
The technical superintendent shall promptly supervise the record of maintenance records on board and 
carry out carefully review, if discovered an abnormal situation should be promptly feed back to the chief 
engineer or chief officer, suggest the corrective measures and supervise the implementation. Required 
technical superintendent promptly log-on to SMIS, reply the maintenance work report submit by the

02_50.text:
第二十章  船舶和设备缺陷的报告与处理程序 
Chapter 20  Ships and Equipment Defect Reporting and Handling Procedure 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 规定船舶和设备缺陷的报告与处理控制程序，以保证对船舶和设备缺陷报告  处理的
及时性，使船舶和设备满足安全营运的需要。 
Procedures for the reporting and handling of defects in ships and equipment，to ensure timeliness 
handling of ship and equipment defects report，to ensure that ships and equipment meet the safe operation 
requirements.  
1.2 本程序适用于公司船管部和所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to the company's fleet departments and the managed ship. 
2.0 定义 
Definition 
船舶和设备缺陷：指船体结构或机械设备、助航设备和通导设备存在的不能满足设计
或制造要求及相应的规范的情况。 
Ship and equipment defects: refers to the hull structure or mechanical equipment, navigation equipment 
and communication equipment exist condition not fulfilling the design or manufacturing requirements 
and the corresponding norm.  
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船管部负责报告的分析和处理。 
The Fleet Departments are responsible for the analysis and processing of the report. 
3.2 船舶负责缺陷的报告和处置的实施。 
The ship is responsible for the defect reporting and implementation of disposal. 
4.0 工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 报告 
Report 
4.1.1 当发现船舶或设备存在缺陷时，发现者应立即报告部门长。 
When a ship or equipment is found defective, the discoverer should immediately report to the 
department head. 
4.1.2 船舶部门长应将发现的缺陷报告船长，并实施纠正和处置。所有的缺陷均需报告公司  
船管部，报告方式可采取以下方式： 
The department head of the ship shall report the defect found to the captain and carry out the 
rectification and disposal. All defects are required to report the company Fleet departments, the report 
can be taken in the following ways: 
 在船舶营运中发现的缺陷，如果是表面化的缺陷，通过自行采取措施能够很快消
除或已经消除的缺陷，缺陷和修理的情况应记入SMIS“船舶月度维修保养完成报
告表”中； 
Defects found in the operation of the ship, if in the case of superficial defects, by taking 
self-contained measures to promptly eliminate or have been eliminated, defects and repair condition 
should be recorded in the SMIS "Ship monthly maintenance completion report form"; 
 对于发现的需要岸基支持的缺陷或者缺陷对于船舶或设备的安全性造成一定的影
响，无论其是否采取措施消除或纠正，均应在SMIS 中填写“船舶和设备缺陷报告

程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0/0.0                      PRO-20 
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise:3.0/0.0                     PRO-20 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01       第2/3页 
    Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/04/01      Page: 2/3 
与处理记录表”向船管部机务总管报告。 
For defects found, need shore-based support, or with certain effect on the safety of ships or 
equipment, whether or not take measures to eliminate or correct them, should be recorded in the 
SMIS "Ship and equipment defect report and handling record", report to the fleet department 
technical superintendent. 
 对于保修期内的新造船舶，发现的缺陷可填报“保修单”并按新造船舶保修程序
处理。 
For the new ship in warranty period, the defects found can be reported "Warranty Bill" and 
according to the new ship warranty procedures. 
4.1.3 报告应包括以下内容 
The report should include the following 
 船舶和设备缺陷的描述； 
Description of ship and equipment defects; 
 可能的原因和拟采取或正在采取的措施； 
Possible causes and measures to be taken or are being taken; 
 状况评估，包括纠正措施，发生时间、预计完成的时间，完成后的效果或缺陷对
安全的影响程度； 
Assessment of the situation, including corrective action, time of occurrence, expected completion 
time, effect after completion or defect influence degree of safety; 
 需要的支持； 
Required support; 
 其它必要的说明或备注。 
Other necessary instructions or remarks. 
4.2 报告的分析 
Report analysis 
4.2.1 机务总管收到“船舶和设备缺陷报告与处理记录表”后应对报告进行调查和分析，全
面掌握船舶或设备发生缺陷的情况，报告主管经理并向船舶回复或提供必要的支持。 
After receiving the “Ship and equipment defect report and handling record”, the technical 
superintendent shall investigate and analyze the report, fully grasp the defect condition of the ship or 
equipment, report to the in-charge manager and reply or provide the necessary support to the vessel. 
4.2.2 对于报告的调查，机务总管可以委托并指导船上的船长、轮机长和大副完成调查，必
要和方便时可亲自完成调查，将调查结果报告部门经理。 
For the investigation of the report, the technical superintendent may entrust and direct the captain, chief 
engineer and chief officer of the ship to complete the investigation. If necessary and convenient, 
technical superintendent may in person, to complete the investigation, and report the results to the 
department manager. 
4.2.3 对于报告的分析要特别注意发现管理和操作上可能存在的问题，并采取进一步的纠正
措施。比如：适当的培训、操作和管理须知的修订，管理通电和通函的发布等。 
The analysis of the report should pay particular attention to the problems that may arise in management 
and operation, and take further corrective action. Such as the revision of appropriate training, operation 
and management notes, the management of telex and circulars release. 
4.2.4 机务总管应密切关注船舶实施的纠正措施和处置情况，直至缺陷最终关闭，对涉及的
关键性的问题应提醒船舶注意。船舶在无法完全解决的情况下，根据当时情况需要，
机务总管（或者主管授权船上）征得部门经理同意后及时通知、报告船级社、船旗国
或港口国有关设备的缺陷，并说明已采取的措施和将要采取的措施。 
The technical superintendent shall pay close attention to the implementation of the corrective actions

and disposal condition of the ship, until the defect is finally closed, remind the key issues involved to 
draw the ship's attention. The defect cannot be completely resolved onboard, according to the situation 
at that time, the technical superintendent (or the authorized in-charge on board) with the consent of the 
department manager and timely notice, report the classification society, the flag state or port state 
related equipment defects, and explain the measures taken and the measures to be taken.

Records and archives

SMIS records.

02_51.chapter: 第二十一章 船岸通导管理程序
02_51.text:
第二十一章  船岸通导管理程序 
Chapter 21 Ship-Shore Communication and Navigation Equipment Management 
Procedure 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 本程序规定了船岸通信导航管理工作步骤，旨在确保通导设备满足国际、国内法定规
则的要求，为船舶安全生产服务。 
This procedure specifies the ship to shore communication and navigation equipment management 
working procedure, aims to ensure that communication and navigation equipment meets the international 
and domestic statutory rules requirements and serves the safety production of ships. 
1.2 本程序适用于公司和所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to companies and managed ships. 
2.0 职责 
Duties 
2.1 通导主管 
Communication and Navigation Equipment Superintendent  
负责船舶通导设备的维护计划以及维护情况的监督和指导，负责船舶通导设备的管理、
维护、修理和备件订购及更新改造。负责为船舶正确使用通导设备提供技术指导，负
责监控船岸通导业务。 
Responsible for the supervision and guidance of maintenance planning and condition of ship 
communication and navigation equipment, responsible for the management, maintenance, repair and 
spare parts ordering and renovation of ship communication and navigation equipment. Responsible for 
provide technical guidance to proper use of communication and navigation equipment of the ship, 
responsible for monitoring the ship shore communication and navigation equipment business.  
2.2 机务总管 
Technical superintendent 
负责安排通导设备的检验，并保持证书有效。 
Responsible for arranging inspection of the communication and navigation equipment and keeping the 
certificate valid. 
2.3 船舶 
Ships 
负责按有关规定值班，负责处理通信业务，确保通信畅通；负责协助通导设备的检验；
负责有关通导设备的维修保养和设备的说明书、图纸、备件、通信资料、工具的保管。 
Responsible to follow regulations to keep watch, responsible for handling communication business, to 
ensure communication is smooth; responsible for assist in the survey of the communication and 
navigation equipments; responsible for the maintenance related to communication and navigation 
equipment and the custody of equipment instruction manual, drawings, spare parts, communication 
materials, tools.  
3.0 通导设备的维护 
Maintenance of the communication and navigation equipment 
3.1 日常维护保养 
Routine maintenance 
3.2 通导设备除另有规定外，只进行简单的外部清洁。需要保养时，由二副负责保养。 
The communication and navigation equipment, unless otherwise specified, performs only simple external 
cleaning. Second officer responsible for maintenance, if needed. 

程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0 /0.0                     PRO-21  
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise:3.0/0.0                     PRO-21 
 青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01        第2/5页 
    Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/04/01         Page: 2/5 
3.3 保持通导设备清洁及处于良好的环境，注意保持干燥，避免腐蚀生锈。 
Keep the communication and navigation equipment clean and in a good environment, pay attention to 
keep dry, to avoid corrosion rust. 
3.4 保持通导设备各旋钮、按键、开关完整牢固，指位正确，灵活正常。各插头、插座、
接插件、电脑终端等接线完整，设备接地良好，工作正常。 
To maintain the communication and navigation equipment knobs, buttons, switch completely secure, 
pointing correctly, flexible normal. The plugs, sockets, connectors, computer terminals, etc., wiring 
integrity, equipment properly earthed, work properly. 
3.5 天线、馈线、拉索、卸克、导滑轮、固定环磨损超过三分之一者应予以更换，防止雷
达波导管碰损或内部积水，注意各天线的清洁和维护保养。 
Antenna, feeder, cable, shackle, pulley, fixed ring wear more than one-third should be replaced to prevent 
the radar wave guide tube damage or internal accumulated water, pay attention to the antenna cleaning 
and maintenance. 
3.6 定期维护保养 
Regular maintenance 
3.6.1 要加强对船舶各种应急设备的检查，检查的内容和方法按设备说明书或以下要求进
行，并记录: 
To strengthen the inspection of the various emergency equipment of the ship, the inspection detail and 
methods shall be accordance with the equipment manual or the following requirements, and recorded: 
 应急无线电示位标每三个月试验一次，注意其电池和释放器的有效期； 
EPIRB tri-monthly test, pay attention to the expiry date of the battery and release device; 
 雷达应答器每月试验一次，注意其电池的有效期； 
Radar transponder monthly test, pay attention to the expiry date of the battery; 
 VHF 设备每天试验一次； 
VHF equipment test daily; 
 双向无线电话每月试验一次。如果配有可充电电池，要保证电池随时可进入工作
状态。除试验用的电池外，要保证配备三只在有效期内的不开封的锂电池； 
Two-way portable radio monthly test. If equipped with rechargeable batteries, to ensure the batteries 
have power at any time. In addition to the testing battery, to ensure there are three in the validity 
sealed lithium batterys available; 
 蓄电池组每周检查一次，保证其处于正常工作状态; 
Battery weekly check, to ensure that it is in normal working condition; 
 每季度对航海雷达等天线进行清洁维护，检查接地是否良好; 
Quarterly cleaning and maintenance on the navigation radar and other antenna, check whether it is 
properly earthed; 
 电子海图信息系统（ECDIS）每次开机后，应根据制造商说明书对ECDIS 系统进
行性能测试；定期测试ECDIS 系统的应急供电，确保在失电等情况下系统可由应
急电源继续供电使用；每次抵离港前，应对ECDIS 系统进行功能测试。 
After each start-up of Electronic chart display and information system (ECDIS), conduct a 
performance tested to the ECDIS system as per manufacturer's instructions; regular tested on the 
ECDIS system emergency power supply, to ensure the system can be powered by emergency power 
supply in case of power loss. Before the arrival and departure port, ECDIS system should be 
functional testing. 
4.0 通导设备的修理 
Repair of communication and navigation equipment 
4.1 通导设备发生故障时，首先立足自修并报告公司船管部。自修人员应先熟悉被修设备

程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0 /0.0                     PRO-21  
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise:3.0/0.0                     PRO-21 
 青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01        第3/5页 
    Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/04/01         Page: 3/5 
的电路、结构、主要元器件工作状态及参数等，避免由于自修导致设备损坏。不能自
修复的设备要立即报告船管部，申请岸基协助派人修理。 
When the communication and navigation equipment malfunction, firstly repair onboard and report to the 
company Fleet department. Onboard repair personnel should be familiar with the circuit, structure, the 
main components working conditions and parameters of equipment being repaired, to avoid damage 
caused by onboard repair. Equipment cannot repair onboard, should report to the Fleet department 
immediately, applciation for shore-based assistance to send technician to repair. 
4.2 申请修理时，填报“船舶航修工程申请单”（SMIS 系统），说明设备的型号、故障现象、
故障发生的可能部位、需准备的备件。 
When applying for repair, fill in the "Ship voyage repair work application form" (SMIS system), specify 
the model of the equipment, the fault phenomenon, the possible parts of the failure, the spare parts to be 
prepared. 
4.3 机务总管接到船舶的修理申请后，及时给与技术指导和修理安排，并将修理计划告知
船舶。 
After receiving the ship application for repair, the technical superintendent shall promptly give technical 
guidance and repair arrangements, and inform repair plan to the ship. 
4.4 船舶设备负责人应在场监修，注意做好设备修复后的试机和验收工作。 
When carrying out the repair, the person in-charge of the ship's equipment shall be present for monitoring. 
After repairing, shall pay attention to the equipment testing and check the work done. 
4.5 设备修复后，将修理结果及时报告船管部，并记录在维修记录薄上。  
After repairing the equipment, report the repair result to the Fleet department in time and recorded on the 
maintenance log. 
4.6 当发生下列情况时，要及时向船管部报告： 
When the following circumstances occur, report to the Fleet department in time: 
 通导设备故障、发生误报警； 
Communication and navigation equipment failure, false alarm; 
 应急设备的电池将到期时； 
The battery of the emergency equipment will expire; 
 电台执照、岸基维修协议将到期时； 
Radio license, shore-based maintenance agreement will expire; 
 有关设备检验的证书将到期时； 
The certificate of the relevant equipment inspection will expire; 
 港口国检查、船旗国检查有特别要求时。 
Special requirements from Port state inspection, flag State inspection. 
5.0 实施修理注意事项 
Implementing Repair Precautions 
5.1 对各种设备进行机内清洁时，应谨慎小心，防止损坏。 
Care should be taken when cleaning inside of various equipment, to prevent damage. 
5.2 当通导设备天线有碍船舶作业时，应将天线调整或降落，并注意绝缘子不要受损，天
线升起时应将两端拧紧，保持垂度合适。  
When the communication and navigation equipment antenna obstructs the operation of the ship, the 
antenna should be adjusted or lower down, and pay attention not to damage the insulator. When hoist the 
antenna, should tighten at both ends, to maintain the appropriate sag. 
5.3 在启动雷达前，使用人员必须检查天线周围有无作业人员和障碍物，避免造成人员伤
亡或机损事故。 
Before starting the radar, the user must check around the antenna, the presence of operational personnel 
and obstacles, to avoid casualties or equipment damage accidents. 

程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0 /0.0                     PRO-21  
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise:3.0/0.0                     PRO-21 
 青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01        第4/5页 
    Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/04/01         Page: 4/5 
5.4 船舶靠泊港口，在进行中高频设备及VHF 设备检修时，不得在遇险频道、公用频道和
当地岸台专用频道上调试设备，严防误报警。 
Ships berthed at port, carrying out maintenance on the MF/HF and VHF equipment, shall not use distress 
channels, public channels and local shore station dedicated channel debugging equipment, to prevent false 
alarms. 
5.5 当天线内发生故障需检修时，修理人员在进入天线罩之前，应先切断天线内有关电源，
如果需要带电操作，应在终端机键盘上贴上明显标志，工作完毕后，关闭天线入口门。 
When there is a fault in the antenna to be overhauled, the repairer should cut off the power supply in the 
antenna before entering the radome. If the live operation is required, the obvious sign should be affixed to 
the keyboard of the terminal. After the work is finished, close the antenna entry door. 
5.6 更换保险丝或进行机内清洁检查之前，都应该首先切断电源，并将容量较大、耐压较
高的电容放电，切忌随意加大保险丝容量。 
Before replace the fuse or carry out the inside equipment cleaning inspection, should cut off the power 
first, and discharge the electric in the larger capacity, high voltage capacitor, should not arbitrarily 
increase the fuse capacity. 
5.7 进行带电高压检修或高空作业时，必须有两人在场场地。 
When carrying out, high voltage repair or working aloft operation, there must be two people in place. 
5.8 配制酸性电解液时，用瓷或玻璃器具将硫酸慢慢倒入水中，切勿将水倒入浓酸。 
When preparing acidic electrolyte, with porcelain or glass equipment will slowly pour sulfuric acid into 
the water, not the water into the concentrated sulfuric acid. 
5.9 在装卸易燃易爆物品时，如果进行设备的检查、试验，则应严格按有关规定进行。 
When handling the flammable and explosive materials, if carry out the inspection, testing of the 
equipment, should be strictly in accordance with the relevant provisions. 
5.10 设备检修完毕，查点有无工具、零件和其它杂物落入机内，确认无问题，再开机。 
After equipment repair, check any tools, parts and other debris remained inside the equipment. Only 
confirmed no problem, the equipment can be restarted. 
6.0 通导设备的检查和文件管理 
Communication and navigation equipment inspection and document management 
6.1 二副负责对通导设备进行检查并将情况及时报公司通导管。 
The second officer is responsible for inspecting the communication and navigation equipment and 
timeliness informing the conditions to the company communication and navigation equipment 
superintendent. 
6.2 二副根据备件实际情况登记造册，交接班时，应按登记册清点交接。备件使用后，应
及时销帐并申请补充。 
The second officer shall keep a registry according to the actual situation of the spare parts. When 
handover, count as per the registry. After the use of spare parts, should be write-off and apply for 
replenishment.  
6.3 船上应建立“通导设备修理报告”文件夹，把所有的修理报告单（包括船上自修的项
目）存放在该文件夹内，长期保存。 
Ship should set up "The Communication and navigation Equipment Repair Report" folder, all repair 
reports (including on board personnel repairing items) should be stored in the folder, for long-term 
archiving.

Related documents

02_52_0.chapter: 第二十二章 船舶环保和防止船舶污染管理程序
02_52_0.text:
第二十二章  船舶环保和防止船舶污染管理程序 
Chapter 22 Environmental Protection and Ship Pollution Prevention Management 
Procedure 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 本程序规定了船舶环保和防止船舶污染环境管理工作的实施步骤和控制方法，旨在消
除产生污染的原因，防止船舶污染环境事故的发生，实施对船舶防污染过程的控制。 
This procedure specifies the implementation steps and control methods of the environmental protection 
and ship pollution prevention and environmental management. It aims to eliminate the causes of pollution, 
prevent the occurrence of ship environmental pollution accident and implement the ship prevent pollution 
process control. 
1.2 本程序适用于船管部和所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to Fleet Department and managed ships. 
2.0 定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
2.1 船舶污染 
Ship pollution 
系指船舶对周围环境造成的污染，主要包括：油污染、生活污水污染、固体垃圾污染、
排气对大气污染等等。 
Refers to the pollution caused by ship to the surrounding environment, mainly include: oil pollution, 
sewage pollution, solid waste pollution, exhaust air pollution, etc. 
2.2 船舶环境保护 
Environmental Protection of ships 
防止环境污染外，也防止有害物质污染，避免携带水生物入另一海洋环境，保护生命
安全，避免对海洋环境的生态造成影响和破坏。也包括：压载水和沉积物控制、生物
污垢污染管理、有害物质管理等等。 
Includes the ship pollution, as well as the prevention of pollution by Hazardous Materials, the avoidance 
of carrying aquatic organisms into another marine environment, protection of the safety of life, and the 
prevention of the impact on and destruction of the marine environment. It also includes: Control of Ship`s 
Ballast Water and Sediments, Biofouling Management, and Management of Hazardous Materials. 
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船舶 
Ships 
负责实施防污染，向公司及有关方报告船舶污染隐患和事故。 
Responsible for the implementation of pollution prevention, report ship pollution potential hazards and 
accidents to the company and the parties concerned. 
3.2 船管部经理为岸基防污染工作的责任人,指导、监督、检查船舶防污染工作执行情况；
负责监督船舶防污设备的备件供应、产品更新；监督指导船舶维修检查防污设备；组
织污染事故的调查处理；检查指导船舶防污染管理工作。 
Fleet Department manager is shore-based person in charge of pollution prevention. Who will monitor the 
shipboard pollution prevention execution condition through guidance, supervision and inspection. Who 
will be responsible for supervising the supply and renewal of spare parts for the ship pollution prevention 
equipment. Who also is supervising and guiding the maintenance and inspection of the pollution 
prevention equipment on shipboard.  Who will organize pollution accident investigation when occurred. 

159

程序手册                       版本/修改：3.0/1.0                          PRO-22 
Procedure Manual                Version/Revise:3.0/1.0                         PRO-22
