   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2024/06/05         Page: 2/6 
3.3 机务总管负责对船舶防污染进行现场检查指导和信息更新，协助船舶处理在防污染工
作中出现的各种技术和设备问题，报告船舶防污染缺陷和污染事故。 
Technical Superintendent is responsible for conducting on-site inspection guidance and information 
updates on ship pollution prevention, assisting ships in handling various technical and equipment problems 
arising from pollution prevention work, reporting ship pollution prevention defects and pollution incidents. 
3.4 船长是船舶防污染工作的第一责任人，组织实施《船上油污应急计划》和《船舶垃圾
管理计划》，《生物污垢管理计划》和《有害物质管理规定》；严格执行防污规章，
指导、布置、监督船舶各部门做好防污染工作。 
The captain is the first person responsible for the pollution prevention work of the ship, organize the 
implementation of the "Shipboard Oil Pollution and Emergency Plan" and the "Ship Garbage Management 
Plan"; organize the implementation of the " Biofouling Management Plan" and the " Hazardous Materials 
Maintenance Management Onboard "; strictly implement the pollution prevention regulations, guide, 
arrange and supervise the various departments of the ship to conduct pollution prevention work. 
4.0 工作程序 
Working procedures  
4.1 船舶防污染应以《MARPOL 73/78 公约》为原则，考虑到《压载水管理公约》，《2009 年
香港国际船舶安全与环境无害化拆船公约》，以及欧盟拆船法规第1257/2013 号（EU）
的需要，以及适用的规范、准则和标准。 
The ship pollution prevention shall be governed by the “MARPOL 73/78 Convention”. taking into 
account the Ballast Water Management Convention, Hong Kong International Convention for the Safe 
and Environmentally Sound Recycling of Ships, 2009 and EU Regulation on Ship Recycling, 
REGULATION (EU) No 1257/2013，as well as applicable codes, guidelines and standards. 
4.2 船舶防污染工作的实施应按公司颁布的《船舶手册》中“船舶防止污染管理规定”中的
有关要求进行操作。 
The implementation of shipboard pollution prevention work should follow relevant requirement of the " 
Ship Pollution Prevention Management Regulations "in the "Ship Manual" issued by the company. 
4.3 船舶所在的港口国如有更为严格的防污染要求或规定时，应按所在的港口国的有关要
求或规定执行。 
If the port state where the ship is located has more stringent pollution prevention requirements or 
regulations, it shall be carried out in accordance with the relevant requirements or regulations. 
4.4 船上发现的有害物质和石棉的跟踪和管理，按照《船舶手册》中“船舶有害物质清单维
护管理规定”和“禁止含有石棉材料在船使用规定”的有关要求执行。 
If the port state where the ship is located has more stringent pollution prevention requirements or 
regulations, it shall be carried out in accordance with the relevant requirements or regulations.  
Tracking and management of hazardous materials found onboard should follow relevant requirement of 
the“Inventory of Hazardous Materials Maintenance Management Onboard”and“Regulations for 
Prohibiting the Use of Asbestos Containing Materials Onboard”. 
5.0 防污染设备 
Pollution prevention equipment 
5.1 船舶防污染设备由主管轮机员负责维护保养，对监控装置要定期进行测试，发现故障
要及时修复，轮机长负责检查监督，确保防污染设备的工作可靠，遇有技术和备件（物
料）问题时报告船管部。 
The designated engineer, under the supervision by Chief Engineer, is responsible for the maintenance of 
ship pollution prevention equipment. Who must ensure that the monitoring device is to be regularly tested 
and all found defects are to be promptly repaired.  Chief Engineer  must ensure that the prevention 
pollution equipment is working reliable. In case of technical issues and defective spare parts and/or stores 
Chief Engineer should  report to Fleet Department.

5.2 船管部得到船舶有关防污染设备和备件需要岸基支持时，应当引起重视和积极给予支
持和落实，必要时主管机务向船管部经理或主管副总经理报告。 
When any shore based support needed relating to pollution prevention equipment and spare parts the 
Fleet Department should take quickest response and make the appropriate arrangement. The Fleet 
Department manager and/or Vice General Manager should be informed if necessary.  
6.0 防污染的实施 
Implementation of pollution prevention 
6.1 船舶应在船长的统一组织下，每一个船员严格按《船舶防止污染管理规定》、《船舶有
害物质清单维护管理规定》、《船上油污应急计划》、《垃圾管理计划》、《压载水管理计
划》、《低硫油换油程序》、《消耗臭氧物质记录簿》、《生物污垢管理计划》和《能效管
理计划》中的有关要求实施船舶防污染工作，接受有关方面的监督检查，并向船管部
反馈防污染工作信息。 
The ship under the unified organization of the Master, all crew member should strictly accordance with the 
implement of ship pollution prevention requirement in “Ship Pollution Prevention Management 
Regulations”, “Inventory of Hazardous Materials Maintenance Management Onboard”, “Shipboard Oil 
Pollution and Emergency Plan”, “Ship Garbage Management Plan”, the Ballast Water Management Plan, 
the Low Sulfur Oil Changing over Procedure, "Ozone Depleting Substance (ODS) Consumption Record 
Book", "Biofouling Management Plan", and "Energy Efficiency Management Plan"，accept the 
supervision and inspection of the relevant parties , and feedback to the Fleet Department regarding ship's 
pollution prevention information. 
6.2 机务总管应具体指导船舶实施船舶操作须知、《垃圾管理计划》、《船上油污应急计划》
和《消耗臭氧物质记录簿》中的有关要求，根据船舶动态适时上船监督检查防污染工
作，帮助船舶消除在防污染工作中出现的各种缺陷，并报船管部经理。 
The Technical Superintendent should provide guidance to the specific ship in the pollution prevention 
implementation by the requirements of the shipboard operational instructions, "Garbage management 
plan", "Shipboard Oil Pollution and Emergency Plan" and "ODS record book" accordance with the ship 
movement, timeliness the Technical Superintendent should visit the ship and do onboard monitoring and 
inspecting the pollution prevention work, so that they can help the ship eliminate all the defects that occur 
in pollution prevention work and report to the Fleet Department manager. 
6.3 船管部经理应经常与相关部门取得联系，及时得到防污染方面的最新信息，汇总分析
船舶防污染现状，制定相应措施并通报各船舶，必要时对船舶操作须知中的有关内容
进行补充或修改。 
The Fleet Department manager should always contact with the relevant parties to obtain/acquire timely 
information on pollution prevention, summarize the current status of the ship pollution prevention, develop 
the appropriate measures and notify the ships. If necessary, supplement or amend the relevant content in the 
ship operating instructions. 
7.0 事故的应急处置和报告 
Emergency handling and reporting of accidents 
7.1 船舶发生污染事故，船管部经理应协助公司应急反应小组按照《应急计划》的步骤和
方法，指导船舶实施应急抢险，并与有关部门取得联系，协助处理污染事故。 
Ship pollution accident occurred, the Fleet Department manager should assist the Company Emergency 
Response Team in accordance with the "Contingency Plan" steps and methods, to guide the ship to 
implement emergency rescue, and contact with the relevant departments, to assist in deal with pollution 
accident. 
7.2 按照公司体系文件《不符合规定的情况、事故和险情的报告和处理程序》进行后期的
调查、报告和处置。 
According to the company Safety Management System documents " Reports and Handling Procedure

8.0 防污染记录及检查 
Pollution prevention record and inspection 
8.1 船舶应将装驳燃油情况、污油水处理情况、船舶生活污水处理系统日常运行情况、垃
圾处理情况、生物污垢管理情况和船舶废气清洗系统的工作情况等如实填妥《油类记
录簿》、《船舶垃圾记录簿》、《生活污水记录簿》、《生物污垢管理记录》和《EGCS 记
录簿》，并予以保存。每记完一页，船长应及时检查，并按规定签字。所有记录要保持
整洁，并接受有关方面的检查。 
The ship shall truthfully fill in the "Oil Record Book", " Sewage Water Record Book ", " Garbage Record 
Book", "Biofouling Record Book" and "EGCS Record Book "with the fuel bunkering condition, the 
sludge garbage disposal condition, sewage treatment plant daily roperations, biofouling management 
operations, and EGCS working condition shall properly retain them on board as required by company 
Safety Management System. Every page finished, the Captain should promptly check and sign as required. 
All the recod book should keep clean and ready for the inspection by the relevant parties. 
8.2 机务总管登轮检查时应检查《油类记录簿》、《垃圾记录簿》、《压载水记录簿》、《生活
污水记录簿》、《消耗臭氧物质记录簿》、《EGCS 记录簿》的记录,以及检查油类和垃圾
的有效退岸处理凭证，以及检查供船备件物料《材料声明》和《供应商符合声明》，
发现问题应及时指导船舶予以纠正。 
The Technical Superintendent onboard inspection should check the records including "Oil Record Book", 
"Garbage Record Book", "Ballast Water Record Book", "Sewage Water Record Book","ODS record book", 
"EGCS Record Book", and check the valid Waste Disposal Receipt for the sludge and garbage, and check  
the MD and SDoC of spare parts and stores. If any problem found, Technical Superintendent should 
promptly guide the ship to rectify. 
8.3 机务总管和公司登轮检查人员，应对船舶的防止污染设备及正确操作，列入检查内容，
认为必要时可对相关设备设施进行试验，船上主管人员的操作技能询查，船上应积极
对待。 
When Technical Superintendent and the company boarding inspectors visit a ship under the system, the 
ship pollution prevention equipment and the correct operation should be included in the inspection items. If 
necessary, physical test on the relevant equipment and facilities should be carried out. By which ship 
in-charge person operational skill are inquired and ship personnel should treat positively. 
9.0 责任人员的技能控制 
Skills control of responsible personnel 
9.1 发生污染事故或发生污染险情时，船管部经理应及时总结交流防污染工作的经验和教
训，商讨预防措施，防止污染事故的发生。船管部经理应利用各种培训机会插入防污
染课程，必要时请有关专家、专业人士授课，培训船员提高防污染意识及技能。 
In the event of a pollution accident or pollution hazard, the fleet department manager shall promptly 
summarize the exchange of pollution prevention work experiences and lessons, and discuss the preventive 
measures, to prevent the occurrence of pollution accidents. The fleet department manager should use 
various training opportunities, to insert pollution prevention courses and, if necessary, invite relevant 
experts and professionals teach lessons, train the crew to improve pollution prevention awareness and 
skills. 
9.2 船管部在得到最新的防污染规则、通函、通电和新技术、新动态，应及时通报公司有
关人员和船舶或进行必要的培训。 
The Fleet Department when obtained the latest pollution prevention rules, circulars, telex and new 
technologies and new developments, shall promptly notify the relevant personnel of the company and ships 
or carry out the necessary training. 
9.3 船长每三个月按照《船上油污应急计划》的要求，组织船舶进行应急溢油演习，使船

02_53_0.chapter: 第二十三章 船舶修理控制程序
02_53_0.text:
第二十三章  船舶修理控制程序 
Chapter 23 Ship Repairing Control Procedure 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope. 
1.1 规定船舶修理的控制方法，以保证船舶的修理质量达到规定的标准，保证船舶的适航
要求和保持设备完好。 
To regulate the ship repair control methods, to ensure the repair quality of the ship meet the required 
standards, to ensure that the ship's seaworthiness requirements and maintain the equipment intact. 
1.2 本程序适用于公司经营和所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to companies operating and managing ships. 
2.0 定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
2.1 船舶计划性修理：计划性的船舶进厂修理工程。一般2~3 年一个周期，结合船舶的期
间检验、特别检验及坞检进行。 
Ship planned repair: planned ship into the shipyard repair works. Generally 2 to 3 years a cycle, 
combined with the ship intermediate survey, special survey and docking inspection carried out. 
2.2 航修：为解决船舶营运中发生的影响航行安全的局部故障或缺陷，而临时安排的修理
工程。 
Voyage repair: in order to solve the partial failure or defects, that will affect the safety navigation, 
occurred during the ship operation, the temporary arrangements for the repair works. 
2.3 事故性修理：是指船舶发生事故，根据船舶损坏情况和检验部门提出的修理范围和要
求进行的修理。 
Accidental repairs: refers repair from the ship accident, according to the ship damage condition and the 
inspection/ survey organization’s recommendation repair scope and requirements. 
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船舶 
Ships 
船长负责组织船舶各部门制定修理工程项目并报公司审批，轮机长、大副是船舶厂修
工程质量监督和验收的总负责人。 
The Captain is responsible for organizing the various departments of the ship to develop repair work 
items and report to the company for approval, Chief Engineer, Chief Mate are the person-in-charge of the 
shipyard repair quality supervision and acceptance. 
3.2 船管部 
Fleet Department 
机务总管负责修船计划的落实、审核、修订；负责船舶在厂的修理进度的监控，协调
厂方和船方的关系；监督并评估船舶的修理质量。 
The Technical Superintendent shall be responsible for the implement, review, revise of ship repair plan, 
responsible for the monitoring of the repair progress of the ship at the shipyard, coordinate the 
relationship between the shipyard and the ship, and supervise and evaluate the quality of the repair of the 
ship. 
4.0 工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 船舶计划性修理

   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2018/04/01           Page: 2/6 
Ship planned repairs 
4.2 船管部经理根据船舶检验信息情况和船舶设备状况，在年底前制定出下年度“年度船
舶修理计划”和预算，报主管副总批准后实施。 
The Fleet Department manager, according to the ship inspection information and ship equipment 
condition, before the end of the year, develop the "Annual ship repair plan" and budget for next year, 
inform the in-charged Vice-General Manager VGM, implement after approval. 
4.3 机务总管依据公司年度修理计划，对需要修理的船舶提前4-6 个月通知船舶按要求编
制修船工程单。 
The Technical Superintendent, according to the company's annual repair plan, 4-6 months in advance, 
notify the ship needed to be repaired, in accordance with the requirements, to prepare ship repair list. 
4.4  船舶修理单的编写要求按照《船舶手册》中的要求执行。 
The preparation of a ship repair list should be in accordance with the requirements of the “Ship Manual”. 
4.5 船舶接到通知后由轮机长和大副编制详细修理工程单经船长审批签字后于预计厂修时
间前3 个月报船管部。 
After the ships received notification, the Chief Engineer and Chief Mate shall prepare a detailed repair list, 
with the approval and sign by the captain, report to Fleet Department 3 months before the expected 
shipyard repair time. 
4.6  机务总管收到修理单后进行审核。 
Technical Superintendent must review the repair list once received from ship. 
4.7 机务总管在条件许可时应提前一个航次上船核对修理工程，确定修理项目并报船管部
经理审核，部门经理审核后报主管副总批准。 
The Technical Superintendent shall, if the conditions permit, visit the ship to verify the work needed to 
repair one voyage before expected docking repair window, confirm the repair items and report to Fleet 
Department manager for verification, after that inform in-charged Vice-General Manager VGM for 
approval. 
4.8 轮机长和大副依照修理工程单，对于修船所用备件、物料，提前3 个月向公司船管部
提出申请。 
The Chief Engineer and Chief Mate, in accordance with the repair list, the spare parts, stores to be used 
during ship repair, should make an application to the company Fleet Department, 3 months in advance. 
4.9 机务总管以批准后的“修理工程单”向拟定的修理厂进行询价、议价，将有关情况提
交船管部经理审核，船管部经理请示主管副总经理后通知机务总管书面确认船厂报价。 
Based on the approved “Repair List” the Technical Superintendent shall inquiry/bargain, with the 
proposed shipyard, submit the relative condition to the Fleet Department Manager for review. After 
consult the in-charged Vice-General Manager VGM, the fleet department Manager will notify the 
Technical Superintendent to confirm offer with shipyard in written manner. 
4.10 机务总管将确定的修船时间和地点通知船上，船上应提前做好进厂的准备工作（包括：
吃水的调整、修理部位的标明、机舱污油水的处理、清洁等）。 
The Technical Superintendent will notify the ship of the confirmed time and place for repair, the ship 
should be well prepared in advance (including: draft adjustment, the identification of the repair items, 
engine room bilge treatment, cleaning, etc) 
4.11 舶进厂前与船厂签订修船合同。 
Before entering the shipyard, sign the ship repair contract with shipyard. 
5.0 船舶修理质量、进度和安全的控制 
Ship repairing quality, progress and safety control 
5.1 船舶设备管理责任人应对责任范围内的修理工程进行质量监控（为质量监控的第一责
任人），负责职责范围内工程的修理过程监控与质量验收。轮机长和大副应对本部门进

166

程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0 / 0.0                      PRO-23 
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise: 3.0/0.0                     PRO-23 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01         第3/6页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2018/04/01           Page: 3/6 
厂修理的工程进度和质量实施全面监控（为质量监控的第二责任人），全面负责本部门
修理工程的质量验收。发现不符合船方要求的情况，第一责任人和第二责任人均应加
以制止或拒收，并报告机务总管。机务总管对实际情况进行分析和协调，妥善解决。 
The assigned person responsible for the ship's equipment management, as the first person responsible for 
the quality control of the repair work, shall carry out the quality control for the equipment under his/her 
custody. responsible for the repair work process monitoring and quality acceptance within his scope of 
duties. The Chief Engineer and Chief Mate should be responsible for specific department shipyard repair 
work schedule and quality, implement a comprehensive monitoring (the second person responsible for 
quality control), fully responsible for repair work quality acceptance of specific department. Found the 
works which do not meet ship’s requirements, the first and the second responsible person should stop or 
reject the repair work, and report to the Technical Superintendent. The Technical Superintendent will 
analyze and coordinate the actual situation, properly resolved. 
5.2 机务总管应对船舶进厂修理工程的进度实施全面控制，负责协调厂方和船 方所存在的
问题，每天组织召开协调会；船舶进厂后，机务总管应及时和船厂修船总管建立联系，
要求其提供船舶修理进度计划表，并将该计划表提供给船长和各部门负责人，安排工
程检修和验收工作。如果机务总管或船方对计划表的安排有异议，应向厂方提出，通
过协商修订修理计划。 
The Technical Superintendent shall take fully control for the progress of the ship's repair work in the 
shipyard, coordinate the problems existing between the shipyard and the ship, to organize and attend the 
coordination meeting every day along with the shipyard assigned superintendents. After the ship entered 
the shipyard, the Technical Superintendent should timeliness establish contact with the shipyard 
superintendent, request to provide the ship repair schedule, and provide the schedule to the shipboard 
Captain and the head of department, arrange inspection work and agreement. If the Technical 
Superintendent or the ship board personnel has any objection to the schedule arrangement, it shall raise 
out to the shipyard, and revise the repair plan through discussion. 
5.3 机务总管于每天下午收工前组织召开厂方主管、船长、轮机长和大副参加的修船联系
会议，协调工程的有关问题，掌握修理工程的进度和计划，并将情况通报船管部经理。
如在修理过程发现问题需调整修理项目，且该调整不影响修理工期计划，机务总管自
行进行调整并通报船管部经理；如果修理项目的调整对修理工期计划有影响，应经船
管部经理复核，报主管副总批准。所有对修理项目的调整，应尽可能在整个计划工期
的前三分之一时间内完成。 
Every afternoon before knock off, the Technical Superintendent organizes the shipyard supervisor, 
Captain, Chief Engineer Officer and Chief Mate to attend the coordination meeting, to discuss the 
relevant issues during the repair work, develop the progress and plan of the repair work, and inform the 
condition to Fleet Department manager. If any repair items found during the repair by which the planned 
work schedule could be affected the Fleet Department manager and Vice General Manger must be 
informed/noticed as soon as possible. Other wise the Technical Superintendent will decide the changes by 
self. All adjustments to the repair items, should be completed as far as possible within the one third of the 
entire planned schedule. 
5.4 机务总管应在重要工程开工前，要求船厂提供修理工艺，如果认为修理工艺不合理应
要求船厂解释或修正，如果对该工艺的合理性难以确定，机务总管应报船管部经理审
批。 
The Technical Superintendent shall, before the commencement of the important works, require the 
shipyard to provide the repair technology. If the repair technology is unreasonable, shall request the 
shipyard explain or amend. If the justifiability of the repair technology is difficult to determine, the Fleet 
Department manager shall be informed for approval.

02_53_1.chapter: 第二十三章 船舶修理控制程序
02_53_1.text:
程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0 / 0.0                      PRO-23 
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise: 3.0/0.0                     PRO-23 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01         第4/6页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2018/04/01           Page: 4/6 
5.5 机务总管、轮机长对交厂修理的主要设备，如：主机的导板间隙、主轴承间隙、连杆
瓦间隙、十字头瓦间隙；副机的主轴颈、曲柄销轴颈、连杆大端座孔的圆度等主要部
件的测量数据一定要掌握，测量结果要求签字确认。 
The Technical Superintendent, the Chief Engineer should take srrict control on the measurement data of 
the main equipment under shipyard repair, such as: Main Engine guide clearance, main bearing clearance, 
connecting rod bearing clearance, cross head bearing clearance; Auxiliary Engine main journal, crankpin 
journal, roundness of connecting rod big round hole and other major parts, measurement results must 
request signatures to confirm. 
5.6 对交厂的修理项目，轮机长和大副应在施工前与项目主管再次进行仔细的 核对，向船
厂提出工程的修理要求，需要解决的问题，并提供修理所需的参考资料（如说明书等）。
督促本部门设备维护责任人监督船厂是否按照修理单指定的范围和要求施工，并监督
修理工程进度、工艺、材料、安装质量和测量数据是否符合技术要求；施工中有无船
厂责任引起的部件及设备的损坏。 
Repair items under shipyard the Chief Engineer and the Chief Mate should carefully check with the 
shipyard project in-charge before carrying out the works, raise out the repair work requirements to the 
shipyard, the problem needed to be solved, and provide the necessary reference materials for repair (such 
as instructions manual, etc). They will supervise own department equipment maintenance responsible 
person to monitor whether shipyard have follow the repair list, carry out repair work in accordance with 
the specified scope and requirement, and monitor the repair work schedule, workmanship, materials, 
installation quality and measurement data are in line with technical requirements; any parts and 
equipment damage caused by the shipyard responsibility during the repair. 
5.7 轮机长和大副检查修理质量是否达到技术要求及确认修理范围。修理工程 完工或试验
合格后，由轮机长和大副检查认可。完工单是制作结账单的依据，要严格把关，对于
双方有争议的修理项目应在完工单上签字注明。必须试航才能验收的项目，可等待试
航时验收。凡不符合要求的项目，应由船厂负责解决。 
The Chief Engineer and the Chief Mate should check the repair quality to meet the technical requirements 
and collate/confirm the repair scope. Delivery order is the basis for making the shipyard bill, to be strictly 
controlled/observed by Chief Engineer and Chief Mate.  For disputable repairing items should be signed 
and marked on the delivery order. Items can only be tested by a sea trial, should wait for the sea trial and 
accept. Items not met the requirements, shipyard should be responsible to solve. 
5.8 船舶进厂后，船长应及时和船厂联系，了解船厂的安全制度，并向船厂说明船舶有关
安全要求，共同落实防火、防盗、防台、防冻、防污染等安全措施，船长与船厂签署
船舶安全协议书，船方要做好安全工作，对热工作业的部位，应安排专人看火。 
After the ship enter the shipyard, the Captain shall contact the shipyard in time, to understand the 
shipyard safety system, and explain the safety requirements of the ship, to jointly implement the safety 
measures, such as fire prevention, safety and security prevention, typhoon prevention, cold weather 
precaution and pollution prevention. The Captain and shipyard should sign the Ship safety agreement, 
ship staff should well prepare the safety measures. Fire guard should be arranged for any hot work area. 
6.0 航修和事故性修理 
Voyage repair and accidental repair 
6.1 轮机长、大副对船级社、船旗国、港口国和其他第三方的检验和检查提出的缺陷、维
护保养报告中存在的问题、船舶机械设备运行中突发的故障以及船舶无能力通过自修
解决的问题填写“船舶航修工程申请单”经船长同意，报机务总管审批，机务总管报
船管部经理、主管副总审核后实施。注；通过SMIS 系统。 
The Chief Engineer and Chief Mate will fill up "Ship voyage repair work application form" for any defect 
pointed out   by classification society, Flag State, Port State and other third parties survey and 

168

程序手册                          版本/修改：3.0 / 0.0                      PRO-23 
Procedure Manual                   Version/Revise: 3.0/0.0                     PRO-23 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01         第5/6页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd       Effective Date: 2018/04/01           Page: 5/6 
inspection, which also include the problems exist in the maintenance report, the sudden failure of the 
ship's machinery equipment during operation, and the problems cannot be fixed by ships personnel.  The 
report should be verified by the captain and report to Technical Superintendent for approval. The Fleet 
Department manager and Vice-General Manager (VGM) should be notified before the implementation. 
Note: This should be done through SMIS system. 
6.2 船长、轮机长、大副具体负责航修项目的监督验收，确保按期保质完成。 
Captain, Chief Engineer, Chief Mate are responsible for the supervision and acceptance of voyage repair 
items and to ensure the qualification and duration as required. 
6.3 修理期间如发生修理项目和修理范围需调整的情况，轮机长和大副应首先报告船长，
由船长请示机务总管，机务总管视情请示部门经理后及时给船上明确答复并及时通知
修理单位。 
During the repair period, if the repair items and the repair scope need to be adjusted, the Chief Engineer 
and the Chief Mater should first report to the Captain, and the Captain should consult the Technical 
Superintendent in charge.  The Technical Superintendent, after consult the department manager as 
required, shall promptly provide the ship a clear reply and notify the contractor. 
6.4 在修理中，如主管机务不在现场时，船长应每天向机务总管报告修理进度和修理情况。 
If Technical Superintendent is absence of the event of repair the Captain shall daily report the repair 
progress and repair condition to the person in charge from Fleet Department. 
6.5 修理结束后，船长应将总的航修情况及时报机务总管，整理船舶修理资料， 船上与机
务总管要分别存档。 
After the repair, the Captain should report the voyage repair final situation to Technical Superintendent on 
time and all concerned repair information should be sorted and filed/archived separately by the ship and 
Technical Superintendent in charge. 
7.0 结账 ： 
Bill payment: 
工程结账总体要求，要严格按照三级审核制度，机务总管—部门经理—主管副总。To 
follow the overall requirements of the repair work bill payment and to be strictly in accordance with the 
three-level verifying system, Technical Superintendent - Department manager - in-charged Vice-General 
Manager VGM. 
7.1 修理工程完工后，经轮机长和大副对工程进行验收后，船厂主管与船长、轮机长和大
副签署完工单，核对完工单上修理项目的尺寸、材料、设备试验情况，将发现的问题
标注在完工单上，作为谈帐的依据。 
After the completion of the repair work, with the acceptance of repair work by the Chief Engineer and the 
Chief Mate, the shipyard in-charge shall sign the work complete order with the captain, chief engineer 
and chief officer, and check the size, material and equipment testing condition of the repair items on the 
work complete order. The problem found, should be marked on the work complete order, as the basis for 
discuss. 
7.2 机务总管收到修理厂的结账单后，将按照进厂前的报价单、轮机长大副签字的完工单
认真细致的核对，并将审核意见交部门经理审核。对保险索赔工程应另外开具结账单。 
After received the invoice from the shipyard the Technical Superintendent will conduct a careful and 
meticulous check accordance with the quotation, the work complete order signed by Chief Engineer and 
Chief Mate, and submit audit opinion to own department manager for verification. For the insurance 
claim works, separate invoice should be issued. 
7.3 部门经理将结合机务反馈的意见和完工单内容进行审核把关，不同意见再次和船厂进
行谈价，直到双方达成一致的意见后，报主管副总审核。.

Department manager will combine the views of maintenance feedback and the details of delivery order, 
for verification. negotiate with shipyard directly, until both parties reached a consensus, report to 
in-charged Vice-General Manager VGM for approval. 
7.4 主管副总收到审核报告后，再召集相关人员审议确认后批准。 
After receiving the review report, the in-charged Vice-General Manager VGM will convene the relevant 
personnel to review, confirm and approve. 
7.5 机务总管接到批准后，通知船厂开发票；机务总管收到发票后，进行核对报经部门经
理、主管副总、总经理签字后提交财务部安排付款。 
After receiving the approval, the Technical Superintendent will notify the shipyard to invoice. After 
receiving the invoice, the Technical Superintendent will conduct the checking and report to the 
department manager, in-charged Vice-General Manager VGM and General Manager GM for signature, 
and submit to the financial department to arrange the payment. 
7.6 船舶将（厂）航修情况填报“（厂）航修工程完成情况反馈表”， 报告船管部，并对工
程质量、修理情况及服务商进行评价。 
The ship will give shipyard/voyage repair condition by filling in "shipyard/voyage repair work 
completion condition feedback form", report to the Fleet Department. The work quality, repair condition 
and service providers’ performance will be evaluated Fleet Department. 
8.0 记录与归档 
Record and archive 
8.1 修船档案管理： 
Ship repair file management: 
机务总管、轮机长、大副负责船舶修理档案的保存（机务总管保存：修理项目单、报
价单、完工单、结账单、油漆配套单、测量记录和试验报告、材料报告；轮机长和大
副保存：修理项目单、完工单、测量记录和试验报告）。 
Technical Superintendent, Chief Engineer, Chief Mate are responsible for the record keeping of ship 
repair file. (Technical superintendent keeping: repair items list, quotation list, work complete orders, 
shipyard bill, paint chart, measurement record and test report, certificate of material report; Chief 
Engineer and Chief Mate keeping: repair items list, work complete orders, measurement records and test 
reports).

02_54_0.text:
第二十四章 交接船管理程序 
Chapter 24 Ship Takeover Management Procedure 
 
1 目的范围Purpose scope 
1.1 
通过对船舶交接过程的有效控制，保证船舶交接顺利、及时，防止意外事件的出现。
Through the effective control of the ship takeover procedure, to ensure smooth and timely takeover of 
the ship, to avoid accidents. 
1.2 
适用于公司新造船、二手船舶买卖的管理。 
Applies to the new ship, second-hand ship trading management. 
2 职责Responsibility 
2.1 船管部 
Fleet Department 
2.1.1 负责新造船舶的接船、二手船舶买卖的前期准备工作； 
Responsible for the new ship takeover, second-hand ship trading initial preparation work; 
2.1.2 负责接入和交出船舶的现场交接工作； 
Responsible for takeover and handover of the ship's on-site transferring work; 
2.1.3 负责船舶注销工作； 
Responsible for the ship’s registration and cancellation of registration; 
2.1.4 负责船舶及设备维修保养体系的配置，备件物料的审批,相关文件记录、报表供船和
GMDSS 岸基维修协议的办理工作； 
Responsible for the initialization of ship and equipment maintenance system and review of spare parts and 
stores application, and the supply of related documents/records, and arrange to sign the GMDSS 
shore-based maintenance agreement with recognized organization. 
2.1.5 负责为交接船所需的印章、相机、手机、电脑、打印和影印机及办公设备的配备； 
Responsible for the needs of the stamp，camera, mobile phone, computer, printer, photocopiers and other 
necessary office equipment. 
2.1.6 负责船舶相关印章的制作安排； 
Responsible for the production of ship-related stamps arrangements. 
2.1.7 负责新购入船舶的公司注册和船舶注册事宜，负责办理有关登记证书。 
Responsible for the matter of company registration and the ship registration of the newly purchased ship, 
responsible for handling the relevant registration certificate. 
2.1.8 负责跟踪新购入船舶船壳和保赔保险的安排以及船舶交接所需的买（卖）方法律文件。 
Be responsible for tracking the arrangements for hull and P&I insurance of newly purchased vessels, as 
well as the legal documents of the buyer (seller) required for vessel handover. 
 
2.2 海务部 
Marine Department 
2.2.1 负责安排审核取得临时SMC 和ISSC。 
Responsible for arrangement of interim audits by class to obtain interim SMC and ISSC. 
2.2.2 负责配备有关公约、法规及外来文件，航海图书资料和普航设备。 
Responsible to equip with the relevant conventions, regulations and foreign documents, nautical 
publications and general navigation equipment.

2.3.1 负责船舶安全管理体系实施计划的制定, 报指定人员批准和实施的监控。 
Responsible for the development of the ship Safety Management System (SMS) implementation plan, 
submitting it to the designated person for approval, and monitoring the implementation.. 
2.3.2 为新购船舶提供体系文件和DOC 副本。 
Provide SMS documents and DOC copy for newly purchased ships. 
2.4 船员部 
Crew Department 
负责接船船员的调配、培训和派遣及相关船员手续。 
Responsible for the deployment of the crew, training and placement and related crew formalities. 
3  程序 
Procedure 
3.1 新造船舶接船 
New building ship takeover 
3.1.1 接船准备工作 
Preparation work of takeover the ship 
1） 接船船期预告；船管部负责提前一个月将试航和接船的预定日期通知公司领导和
相关部门。如有变更，应补充通知。 
Notice of takeover ship schedule. The Fleet Department is responsible for notification to the top 
management and related department 1 month in advance of the proposed sea trial and takeover date. 
If there is any change, should send a supplement notice. 
2） 接船船员的派遣；确定接船船员名单。由船员部负责接船船员的调配、培训和派
遣。 
Placement of takeover crewmember. Crew Department is responsible for the takeover ship crew 
deployment, training and dispatch. 
3） 接船船员分两批派遣，第一批由主要干部船员组成，由船长带队，试航前5-7 天
抵船厂，并参加船舶试航。其余船员在接船前3 天抵厂。 
The takeover crew were sent in two batches. The first batch consisting of the main cadre crew, led by 
the captain, arrive the shipyard 5-7 days before the sea trial, and participated in the ship sea trial. The 
rest of the crew should arrive the shipyard 3 days before takeover. 
4） 接船船员去接船前，由船员部牵头，会同交接船相关部门召开接船会议，布置接
船工作，提出接船要求和注意事项。 
Takeover crew members before proceeding to the ship, organized by the Crew Department, in 
conjunction with the relevant departments of the takeover to have a ship takeover meeting, discuss 
the takeover works, list out takeover requirements and precautions. 
3.1.2 接船现场组织工作 
Takeover ship on site work 
1） 接船工作必须在机务总管和监造组的统一领导下进行。发现的问题，集中向机务
总管或监造项目经理反映，由监造项目组同船厂协商解决。 
The takeover work must be carried out under the unified leadership of the Technical Superintendent 
and the supervisory team. If any problem found during the takeover, these matter should be 
summarized and reported to the Technical Superintendent and/or supervisory project manager. Which 
they will discuss and consult with the shipyard for resolution.  
2） 第一批接船船员试航后，应继续在机务总管和驻厂监造组的领导下参加有关项目
的试验和检查工作，不得无故离开接船地点。 
After the sea trial, the first batch of takeover crew members should continue, under the leadership of

the Technical Superintendent and supervisory team to participate in the testing and inspection works, 
and shall not leave the ship without reasonable excuse. 
3.1.3 备件、物料供应 
Spare parts and stores supply 
1） 接船船员应根据船厂提交的《备件物料申请单》提出追加备件物料清单，交船管
部审核后转交供应部订购；或由供应部根据监造组提供的新造船船厂配备的备件、
物料情况，制定供船备件、物料清单，经机务总管审核，在接船后安排供船。 
The takeover crew should submit the additional spare parts stores requisition list according to the 
"Spare parts stores application form" submitted by the shipyard, and send to the Fleet Department for 
review and then based on that Purchasing Department will order timely. Another way to supply the 
spare part and stores on board is that the Purchasing Department, according to the spare parts and 
stores condition provided by supervisory team, supervisory team develop supply list and supply on 
board after take over from ship yard Technical Superintendent whichever will be arranged to supply 
should be reviewed by Technical Superintendent. 
2） 船舶应将公司所供应备件、物料、有关文件和资料送船的交接、清点分类、登记
和签收。 
Once received the spare parts, stores, document and other material ship side should well arrange to 
make inventory and feedback to head office. 
3） 对船厂供配船的备件物品，接船船员做好检查、验收、登记工作，对遗留问题应
做好记录并取得书面协议。 
The spare parts supplied by the shipyard, the takeover crew should conduct an inspection, acceptance, 
registration work, for the outstanding issues should be recorded and made a written agreement. 
3.1.4 检查 
Inspection 
1） 接船船员抵厂后，应在监造组协助下熟悉有关图纸、资料、文件、设备操作规程
及船舶建造过程中的有关情况。 
After arrived in the shipyard, the takeover crew members should, with the assistant from the 
supervisory team, familiar with the relevant drawings, data, documents, equipment operating 
procedures and the relevant circumstances during the ship construction process. 
2） 为了更好地掌握船舶技术状况，接船船员应在机务总管或监造组的安排下参加接
船期间的各种试验和检查工作。船员在检查中发现的问题应及时向机务总管或监造
组反映，机务总管或监造组根据监造合同、技术说明书和相关技术文件的规定和说
明，统一向船厂交涉。 
In order to better grasp the technical condition of the ship, the takeover crew should, under the 
arrangement of the Technical Superintendent or supervisory team, participate in various testing and 
inspection work during the takeover period. The problems found by the crew in the inspection shall 
be promptly reflected to the Technical Superintendent or the supervisory team. The Technical 
Superintendent or the supervisory team shall unified negotiate with the shipyard in accordance with 
the provisions and instructions of the supervision contract, technical instructions and relevant 
technical documents. 
3.1.5 试航 
Sea trial 
1） 第一批接船船员应在机务代表或监造组统一指挥下参加试航，并于试航前尽快熟
悉技术规格书的内容、试航大纲和设备的基本状况。 
The first batch takeover crew members should participate in the sea trial under the unified command 
of the Technical Superintendent or supervisory team, and familiarize themselves with the contents of

the technical specifications, the outline of the sea trial and the basic condition of the equipment as 
soon as possible before the trial. 
2） 试航中船员必须认真参加与本职业务有关的试验项目。按照技术规范书的要求记
录所管设备的实验结果；特别是主机方面，一定要详细记录各种工况下主机的主要
参数、转速、油耗和船舶航速是否满足技术规范书的要求，对在试航中发现的缺陷
做好相应的记录，先向部门长汇报，由部门长汇总后及时报告机务总管或监造组，
由监造组统一向船厂交涉解决。 
In the sea trial, crew must seriously participate in their own job-related testing items. In accordance 
with the requirements of technical specifications, records in-charged equipment test results; in 
particular, the main engine, must detail record under the various conditions the Main Engine main 
parameters, speed, fuel consumption and ship speed to meet the requirements of technical 
specifications. The problems found by the crew in the inspection shall be promptly reflected to the 
Technical Superintendent or the supervisory team. The Technical Superintendent or the supervisory 
team shall unified negotiate with the shipyard in accordance with the provisions and instructions of 
the supervision contract, technical instructions and relevant technical documents. The defects found 
during sea trail, should make the corresponding record, firstly report to the department head, the head 
will summarize and report to the Technical Superintendent or supervisory team timely, supervisory 
team shall unified negotiate and solve with the shipyard. 
3） 试航后对需返修的项目，由部门长开列清单及时交机务总管或监造组。机务总管
或监造组对所提问题认真研究，确需解决的应立即与有关方面联系，并逐项落实。
对不能解决的项目，应向船舶和船管部部经理说明原因，并得到船管部部经理的认
可。对船舶提出的加账项目，监造组要向船管部经理报告，船管部经理认为必要，
并协调各方和征得公司领导同意后，方可进行。原则上不允许额外加账。 
After the sea trial, items needed to re-work, the department head will make a list and timely pass to 
the Technical Superintendent or supervisory team. The Technical Superintendent or supervisory team 
shall seriously study the questions mentioned, questions needed to be resolved shall immediately 
contact the relevant parties, and implemented one by one. For items that cannot be solved, the 
reasons shall be given to the ship and Fleet Department manager, and approved by whom. For the 
additional items raised by the ship, the supervisory team should report to the Fleet Department 
manager. If Fleet Department manager considers it is necessary, after coordinate the parties and 
obtain the consent of the company leader, the work can only be proceeded. In principle, no additional 
billing is allowed. 
4） 试航完毕，船长应尽快电告公司加油、加水计划。 
After sea trial completed, the captain should promptly call the company oil bunkering, water 
replenishment plan. 
3.1.6 接船 
Takeover the ship 
1） 在船舶交接之前，船管部应至少提前3 天通知财务部准确的交船时间以及最后一
期船价款金额(因合同条款限制时，应尽快通知)，财务部应备妥资金，按造船合同
规定的时间和方式支付最后一期船价款。 
Before the takeover of the ship, the Fleet Department shall inform the Finance Department of the 
exact delivery time and the last installment amount (Due to the limitation of the terms and conditions 
of the contract, shall notify as soon as possible) at least 3 days in advance. The Finance Department 
shall prepare the funds, pay the last installment according to the time and method stipulated in the 
ship building contract.

2） 船长在接船前要组织船员进一步检查、熟悉并掌握船舶设备的技术状态和操作规
程，并在机务代表或监造组的指导下，按合同和有关规定接船。 
Before the takeover, the captain shall organize the crew to further inspect, familiarize and grasp the 
technical status and operating procedures of the ship's equipment, and under the guidance of technical 
representative or supervisory team, takeover the ship in accordance with the contract and the relevant 
regulations. 
3） 船长要做好正式开航前的各项准备工作，使船舶处于适航状态，认真落实公司下
达的航次任务。 
The captain should well perform various preparatory work for sailing, ensure the ship is 
seaworthiness, conscientious implement the company voyage instruction. 
4） 船长要做好船厂提供的各种交船文件、图纸和资料的交接、造册登记及分工保管
工作，对遗留问题由监造组与船厂交涉取得书面协议，交船管部和船长保存，在保
修期内安排修理。 
The captain is required to conduct the filing, registration, division and keeping of various ship 
documents, drawings and takeover data provided by the shipyard. For the outstanding problem, 
negotiated by supervisory team and recorded in a written agreement, pass to the Fleet Department 
and captain for retention, arrange to repair within the warranty claims period. 
5） 接船结束后，机务总管或监造组应立即通知公司接船结束的时间。 
After takeover the ship, the Technical Superintendent or supervisory team should immediately inform 
the head office the takeover end time. 
6） 接船后，船长要汇总各部门接船情况并写出接船总结报送船管部机务总管 
After takeover the ship, the captain should summarize the takeover ship situation of the various 
departments and write a takeover summary submitted to the Fleet Department Technical 
Superintendent. 
3.1.7 接船后 
After takeover the ship 
1） 船舶交接后，监造项目组负责向接船机务总管移交各种接船文件、船级社证书和
检验报告、完工图纸、设备说明书、备件册等技术资料，由机务总管负责按照资料
接收清单转交给接船相关船员，并指导船员接收和归档工作。属于公司保存的文件
资料由机务总管负责监造项目组协助将其运回公司。 
After takeover the ship, the supervisory team is responsible for transferring the various takeover 
documents, the certificate of the classification society and inspection report, the final drawing, the 
equipment manual and spare parts list, technical data, etc., to the takeover ship Technical 
Superintendent. The Technical Superintendent is responsible, in accordance to the received data list, 
forward to the takeover ship crew concerned, and guide the crew in receiving and filing work. The 
documents belong the company archiving, the Technical Superintendent should be responsible, with 
the assist from the supervisory team, to send back to the company. 
2） 船舶离开造船厂投入营运后，船舶后续管理由机务总管按照正常的营运船舶管理
程序进行管理。 
After the ship leaves the shipyard and is in operation, the ship's follow-up management shall be 
managed by the Technical Superintendent in accordance with the normal operating vessel 
management procedures. 
3） 机务总管负责船旗国长期注册证书和船级社长期证书的更换和送船；监造项目组
负责对交船前可能未完成审批的图纸、资料的跟踪处理，完成审批后转交给机务总
管进行更换和送船。 
The Technical Superintendent is responsible for the replacement and delivery of flag state long-term

registration certificate and the classification society of the long-term certificate. The supervisory team 
responsible for the follow-up of the drawings and data that may not be completely approved before 
the delivery. After completed the approval, forward to the Technical Superintendent, delivery and 
replace onboard. 
4） 机务总管负责对运回公司的接船资料、图纸、技术档案进行整理和归档。 
The Technical Superintendent is responsible for sorting and filing of the takeover ship data, drawings 
and technical files sent back to the company. 
5） 机务总管负责跟踪船舶航行经济性指标的测算、统计，并将结果及时报告给部门
负责人。 
The Technical Superintendent is responsible for tracking the ship’s navigation economic indicators 
measures, statistics, and report the results to the department heads in time. 
6） 机务总管负责跟踪定期的船体结构检查情况。 
The Technical Superintendent is responsible for tracking the regular hull structure inspection 
condition. 
7） 机务总管负责保修项目的联系、安排和完成情况的跟踪并确认完成情况。监造项
目组负责对遗留物品备件的索要并对保修项目的完成提供 必要的协助。在船舶保
修期间，船舶按照要求填报《船舶保修单》，待船舶完成保修期后，再按照《船舶
和设备缺陷的报告与程序》进行相关报告。 
The Technical Superintendent is responsible for the contact, arrangement and completion of the 
warranty claim items, tracking and confirming the completion conditions. The supervisory team 
responsible for the request of left behind spare parts and provide the necessary assistance for the 
completion of the warranty. During the ship's warranty period, the ship shall fill in the "Ship 
Guarantee Claim Form" as per requirement. After the warranty period, completion the relevant report 
in according with “Ship and equipment defect report and procedure”. 
 
3.2 二手船舶的接船 
Takeover the second-hand ship 
3.2.1 接船前的准备 
Preparation before takeover 
1） 船管部根据买船（包括光租船）过程中的看船报告、查阅船级记录等资料，整理
出船舶简要规范，机务总管负责以书面形式通知有关部门。 
The Fleet Department, according to ship visit report, checking the classification society record and 
data during the ship purchasing (including bare boat charter) process, sort out the ship brief 
specification. Technical Superintendent is responsible for notification to the relevant departments in 
writing. 
2） 船管部主管根据船旗国政府的要求准备文件，办理公司注册和船舶注册并取得登
记证书（包括最低配员证书、电台执照和吨位证书）及公司印章。 
The Fleet Department prepares the documents according to the requirements of the Flag State 
government, handles the company registration and ship registration and obtains the registration 
certificate (including the minimum safe manning certificate, the radio license and the tonnage 
certificate) and the company seal. 
3） 船员部根据船舶买卖合同的有关条款，安排船员跟船并了解船舶设备和其他方面
的实际情况，为下一步实体交接做好准备工作。 
The Crew Department shall arrange crew to sail onboard the ship and observe the actual situation of 
the ship's equipment and other aspects, in accordance with the relevant provisions in the Vessel Sale 
and Purchase Agreement, to prepare for the next step entity takeover work.

4） 根据船舶买卖合同的有关条款，船管部视情联系、安排水下检验或坞检。如检验
中船舶状况不满足船级社要求，船管部应写出详细的报告，由公司按合同内容向卖
方提出要求。 
According to the relevant terms/clauses in the Vessel Sale and Purchase Agreement, the Fleet 
Department, as appropriate, shall arrange underwater inspection or docking inspection. If the status of 
the ship in the inspection does not meet the classification society requirements, the Fleet Department 
should provide a detailed report, the company raise the request to the seller in according to the terms 
of agreement. 
5） 船管部要提前15 天将预定的接船日期通知有关部门。并向需做检验的船级社发出
检验申请。 
The shipping department shall inform the relevant department 15 days in advance of the scheduled 
takeover, and to make a survey application to the classification society which needed to conduct a 
survey. 
6） 跟船人员或抵港后提前登轮的人员在船舶移交前对船舶交接时船存燃油、润滑油、
化学品双方进行测量、确认，签署存量报告，报公司以便公司安排付款。 
The person who riding onboard or early boarding of the arrived ship, should conduct the join measure 
and confirm of, the fuel oil, lubricating oil, chemicals takeover quantity, signed the ROB quantity 
report, reported to the company for the company to arrange payment. 
7） 当卖方将所交船舶按照买卖合同要求准备妥当后，将向买方提交备妥通知书，现
场机务总管或指定现场交接人员应在备妥通知书上签字，并将通知书传真公司。 
After the seller prepared the ship in accordance with the requirements of the Vessel Sale and Purchase 
Agreement for handover, will serve a notice of readiness to the buyer, on-site Technical 
Superintendent or designated on-site takeover staff should sign on the notice, and fax the notice to the 
company. 
3.2.2 接船船员的派遣 
Dispatch of takeover ship crew 
1） 根据船舶特性，由船员部确定接船船员名单。船员部负责接船船员的调配、培训
和派遣。 
According to the characteristics of the ship, to determine the list of crew by the crew department. The 
crew department is responsible for the deployment, training and dispatch of the takeover ship crew. 
2） 接船船员出发前，由船员部牵头召集一次接船和培训会议，组织有关部门布置和
培训接船要求和注意事项以及下一步工作中的管理要点。 
Before departure of the takeover ship crew, the crew department will lead a takeover ship and 
training session, organize the relevant departments to arrange and train the takeover ship 
requirements and precautions, and the management main points in the next step works. 
3） 船管部应根据所掌握的看船报告、船级记录、检验动态、跟船人员反馈的信息等
资料，向接船船员介绍船舶的主要技术状况。 
The fleet department shall brief the takeover ship crew on the main technical condition of the ship 
according to the information and data from the ship visit report, classification society record, 
inspection status, riding crew feedback. 
4） 船管部应根据接船动态，向接船船员介绍转船级和更换船东的检验要求、注意事
项。介绍接船步骤和以前所发生的教训，提醒大家注意。 
The fleet department shall, according to the status of the takeover ship, introduce to the takeover ship 
crew, the inspection requirements and precautions for the change of classification society and 
shipowner. Describe the takeover ship steps and the previous experience lessons, remind for all 
attention.

3.2.3 文件资料和备件、物料 
Document data and spare parts, materials 
1） 各有关部门按照接新船的要求准备文件、资料交船管部统一送船。 
The relevant departments in accordance with the new ship requirements to prepare the documents, 
data, unified delivery onboard via fleet department. 
2） 船管部根据所掌握的船舶技术状况，提前配备必要的备件、物料。 
The fleet department base on the known technical condition of the ship, prepare the necessary spare 
parts and materials in advance 
3） 船员部负责船员劳保用品的配备。 
The crew department is responsible for the crews’ personal protective equipment supplies. 
4） 机务总管负责船章的提供。 
The Technical Superintendent is responsible for the ship seal supply. 
3.2.4 现场交接 
On-site takeover 
1） 接船船员在公司机务总管或委托的代理人的领导下，认真做好船舶现场交接工作。 
Takeover crew under the company's Technical Superintendent or authorized agent's leading, well 
conduct the on-site ship takeover work. 
2） 接船船员按照各自职责尽快熟悉所管设备性能，对存在的问题，由部门长汇总后
形成书面材料，交给现场机务总管并报公司船管部，船管部根据船舶买卖合同的有
关条款，视情况与交船方进行交涉，并将交涉结果通知现场机务总管。 
Takeover crew in accordance with their respective responsibilities as soon as possible familiar with 
the performance of the equipment. For the existing problems, summarize by the department head in 
writing, submit to the on-site Technical Superintendent and report to company Fleet Department. The 
Fleet Department will, in according with relevant terms in the Vessel Sale and Purchase Agreement, 
as appropriate, negotiate with the delivery party, and inform the negotiations results to the on-site 
Technical Superintendent. 
3） 接船轮机长和主管轮机员应尽快熟悉船舶燃油、滑油舱室的布置，做好接船后加
油的准备工作。 
Chief Engineer and engineers in-charge should, as soon as possible, be familiar with the ship fuel oil, 
lubricating oil tank layout and/or arrangement, well prepare for bunkering work after takeover. 
4） 接船完毕后，船长应立即电告公司，各部门应在日志中写明交接时间。船管部下
发接船通知。 
After takeover the ship, the captain should immediately inform the company, all department should 
clearly state the takeover time in the logbooks. The Fleet Department should issue a takeover ship 
notice. 
5） 船舶交接完毕后，船管部负责按照合同要求向卖方索要船舶注销证明书和向卖家
索要公司管理的有关的船舶资料。 
After takeover the ship, the Fleet Department is responsible for requesting the seller to provide the 
Certificate of Cancellation of the ship and company management of the relevant ship information, as 
per the agreement. 
6） 对接船的资料和报告进行整理并进行归档。 
Sort out and archive the takeover ship information and reports. 
3.3 卖船 
Selling ships 
3.3.1 根据公司部署，船管部负责提供所卖船舶的基本规范和技术资料，按要求安排买家在

3.3.3 当买卖合同签署后，船管部应组织有关人员进行审阅，并及时通知船上交船时间和注

After signing the Vessel Sale and Purchase Agreement, the fleet department should organize the relevant

3.3.4 船管部按照合同要求办理交船前的船舶无债务（抵押）证明、买卖合同中约定的文档

The Fleet Department, before ship handover, in accordance with the requirements of the Agreement, 
handle Certificate of no Liens, the agreed document signing and notarization formalities needed before 
handover the ship in Vessel Sale and Purchase Agreement. In accordance with the Agreement 
requirements, inform the buyer the ship status in a timely manner. When the ship condition is ready to 
delivery, the Fleet Department issued a notice of readiness to the buyer, the Finance Department pay 
attention to check the remaining amount are deposited as per Agreement terms. 
3.3.5 船舶正式交接时，经公司领导授权的交船代表全权负责现场交船的一切事宜。必要时，

部门。 
When the ship is officially handed over, the company leader delegated representative shall be solely 
responsible for all matters on-site concerning the delivery of the ship. If necessary, in accordance with 
the Vessel Sale and Purchase Agreement requirements, responsible for organizing materials, equipment, 
spare parts or other items, especially rental equipment, the work of the retreat. The ship fuel oil, 
lubricating oil, the ship should join with the buyer representative to complete the measurement and 
verification work. The master should be in accordance with the company instructions to properly destroy 
the relevant documents and logo, register the certificate documents and information needed to return, 
bring back to the company and delivery to the relevant departments. 
3.3.6 船舶实体交接证明签署后，交船代表应立即电告公司，船管部下发交船结束通知，各

After the signing of the ship entity handover certificate, the delivery representative shall promptly notify 
the company of the delivery of the ship, and the fleet departments shall issue handover complete 
notification, all relevant department go through the follow-up matters such as the termination and 
withdrawal of the ship's insurance, the cancellation of the radio station, etc. 
3.3.7 船管部将船长带回的船舶注册证书、船舶最低配员证书、船舶电台执照邮寄船旗国政
府，同时向船旗国政府申请办理注销证明书，并按照合同要求在规定的时间内寄给买

4  接船须知 
Takeover Ship Instructions 
4.1 熟悉合同：每个船员，特别是干部船员更要熟悉，船长、轮机长、大副等应对买卖船
合同的条款一定要熟悉，一切交接手续按合同规定办理。 
Each crew member, especially the officers and engineers, is to be more familiar with the agreement. The 
captain, Chief Engineer, Chief Officer, must familiarize with the terms of the Agreement. All takeover 
procedures should handle in according with the Agreement. 
4.2 收集情况：特别是先上船的船员，要采取一切可能的方式： 
Collection information: In particular, firstly boarding crew, to take all possible ways to do the following, 
4.2.1 询问该轮是否发生过重大海损事故，尽量了解事故的原因，以避免我方重复发生此类
事故。 
Ask whether the ship has happened a major accident, try to understand the cause of the accident, in order 
to avoid our re-occurrence of such accidents. 
4.2.2 查清该轮是否被PSC 滞留过。如有，此尽量弄清时间与地点和所发生的详细情况。 
Check whether the ship had been detained by PSC. If so, try to figure out the time, place and what 
happened in detail. 
4.2.3 对于机舱的设备运转情况了解清楚，询问是否发生过机损和在管理中容易出现的问题，
允许的情况下，尽量查阅轮机日志与工作日志。 
To clearly understand the operation condition of the engine room equipment, ask whether there have been 
machinery damage and the problems easily to occur in the management. If the condition permitted, try to 
read the engine logbook and daily record. 
4.2.4 将副机运转状况作为一个重点，认真观察，并询问他们曾经采取过什么措施。 
The operation condition of the Auxiliary Engine as a focus, observe carefully, and ask what measures had 
been taken. 
4.2.5 对照合同，认真寻找问题，不论是在甲板还是机舱，特别是运行中发现的问题，都要
详细地记录下来，为正式的交接准备好第一手资料。 
Compared with the Agreement, carefully looking for problems, whether in the deck or engine room, 
especially problem found in the operation, should be recorded in detail, and ready for the first-hand 
information to the formal handover. 
4.2.6 由于卖家可能会告知该轮的船员对接班人员保密，但希望大家出主意，想办法，多收
集一些资料，为接船和以后的运营的管理工作奠定基础。 
As the seller may inform the handover crew keep confidential to the takeover crew, but hope all can give 
the idea, find the ways, to collect more information, for the takeover ship and the future operation 
management works to make the foundation. 
4.3 保存资料：应提倡“片纸不易丢”，注意保留原始资料，以备今后的转级与查阅之用。 
Preservation of information: should promote the "think twice before trash a paper", pay attention to retain

Oil water separator.

All drawings should record in a register. 
4.6 甲板部：特别是大副应注意船底板、锚、锚链、船壳板、大舱肋骨和隔舱壁的锈蚀情
况，以及吊货属具、救生设备、通导设备、系泊设备、安全设备等情况。 
Deck department: especially the Chief Officer, should pay more attention to the ship bottom plate, anchor, 
anchor chain, hull plate, cargo hold web frame and bulkhead corrosion condition, and cargo handling gear,

4.7 轮机部：特别是轮机长、大管轮、电机员应注意主机、副机、舵机、尾轴、配电板等
有关安全设备的检验日期，设备维修及操作方法。备件的存放地点和数量的清查，主
要的专用工具，例如：主机吊缸、抽尾轴、封缸、拆卸增压器的工具等，和一些专用
的测量工具，设备运行中存在的主要问题。 
Engine department: In particular, the Chief Engineer, Second Engineer and Electrical Engineer, should pay 
much attention to the Main Engine, Auxiliary Engine, steering gear, tail shaft, power distribution board 
and other safety equipment inspection date, equipment maintenance and operation methods. Spare parts 
storage place and quantity inventory, the main special tools, such as: Main Engine overhaul, withdrawal 
tail shaft, cylinder cut out, turbocharger special tools, and some special measurement tools, the main 
problems exist during equipment running. 
4.8 水下检验：按合同要求进行水下检验，船长、轮机长都要密切注意检查情况如：水下
部分的尾轴、螺旋桨、舵等情况，检查船底是否有碰撞、搁浅的痕迹，如果发现问题
或影响船级证书的有效性，对必须修理的紧急情况立即报告公司。 
Underwater inspection: according to the contract requirements to conduct the underwater inspection, the 
Captain, Chief Engineer should pay close attention to check the situation such as: underwater part of the 
tail shaft, propeller, rudder, etc., check whether there is the bottom of the collision, stranded traces, if 
found problems or affect the class certificate validity, and report the company for the emergency situation 
that must be repaired. 
4.9 驾驶台、舵机房、机舱集控室等重要地方接收后上锁或由专人看管。 
Bridge, steering gear room, engine control room and other important places should be locked or attended 
by crew after takeover. 
5 协调方面： 
Coordination: 
5.1 迅速查询备件，如果缺少航行必备的备件，应迅速报告公司。 
Quickly check the spare parts, if lack of necessary spare parts for sailing, should report to the company 
quickly. 
5.2 接船后，船舶领导要立即组织船员进行安全大检查，作好防火、防毒、防事故的工作，
发动船员进行技术练兵，熟悉船舶技术状况，熟悉管理操作，特别是应急设备要尽快
作到能熟练操作。 
After takeover the ship, the ship leader should immediately organize the crew to carry out safety 
inspection, prevent fire, prevent drug used on board, prevent accident work, organize the crew to carry out 
technical training, familiarize with the technical situation of the ship, the management operation, 
especially the proficiency operation of emergency equipment as soon as possible. 
5.3 三副、三管轮要对港口国检查的物品、设备等认真检查一遍，对产品的数量、日期要
认真检查是否有过期的。水手长、木匠要对所有的水密门、消防栓和灭火设备认真检
查，全船要熟悉消防、救生设备的使用。 
Third Officer and Fourth Engineer should conduct a careful check to the items, equipment of the port state 
control inspection, the quantity, the date of items to seriously check for expiry. Bosun, Carpenters to 
seriously check all the watertight doors, fire hydrants and fire-fighting equipment, the whole ship 
personnel should be familiar with the use of fire-fighting, life-saving equipment. 
5.4 轮机部在接船时，对船存的各种油数进行认真核对，宁少勿多，要仔细进行测量和计
算各个油舱的数量，滑油数量的计算是可明确计量的储存柜内的油数和未开封的油桶
内滑油的数量都列入买卖船油账数。 
When takeover the ship, ship’s engine department should carefully check on a variety of oil quantity, 
report less rather than more, carefully measure and calculate the remaining on board quantity of each tank.

timely manner. 
5.9 先行上船的船员要注意各部门的物料与备件情况，不要让他们偷偷处理掉，要作到上

接时使用。 
The early boarding crew should pay attention to the materials and spare parts of each department, do not 
let previous crew secretly deal with. To ensure no difference between early boarding and takeover. If 
found any doubt, or found being sold, should be noted down and to be used during handover.

02_55.text:
第二十五章  船舶备件、物料采购程序 
Chapter 25 Ship spares & stores Purchase Procedure 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and Scope 
1.1 本程序规定了船舶备件、物料采购的基本要求和操作步骤，确保供应的船用备件、物
料满足船舶营运和维护保养的要求。 
This procedure specifies the basic requirements and operating procedures for ship spare parts and stores 
purchase, to ensure the spare parts and stores supplied to ship meet the operation and maintenance 
requirements. 
1.2 本程序适用于供应部和公司所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to the purchasing department and the ships managed by Company. 
2.0 定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
(空) 
(blank) 
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船舶：提出备件、物料申请；检查、接收送船的备件、物料。并将相关信息及时反馈
供应部。 
Ship: made spare parts, stores applications; inspection, receiving of spare parts, stores delivered onboard. 
And timely feedback of relevant information to purchasing department. 
3.2 供应部：根据机务总管审核的备件、物料申请单；选择合格的供应商；组织备件、物
料供船；跟踪备件、物料的到船情况及质量情况。 
Purchasing department: According to the spare parts, store application form reviewed by technical 
superintendent; select qualified suppliers; organization spare parts, stores for the ship; tracking spare parts, 
stores delivery onboard situation and quality condition. 
4.0 工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 备件物料供应商的评定和选择 
Evaluation and selection of spare parts stores suppliers 
4.1.1 公司认可所有有资质从事船舶备件和物料供应商为合格供应商。但已经与公司有良好
的合作关系的供应商作为首要选择。 
The company recognizes all qualified suppliers engaged in ship spare parts and stores suppliers as 
qualified suppliers. But has a good relationship with the company's suppliers as a first choice. 
4.1.2 对于由于质量和供船服务而被船舶投诉的供应商，供应部将进行分析和评价。不合格
的供应商将被记录。 
For supplier had complained by ship, due to the quality and delivery service, the purchasing department 
will analyze and evaluate. Unqualified suppliers will be recorded. 
4.1.3 对于作为公司首要选择的供应商为重点供应商，应每年对其供应的情况，从产品质量、
服务等方面进行评价，评价由部门经理或其指定的人员主持，对于存在问题的供应商
应通知其评价意见并要求其纠正或直接弃用。 
The primary suppliers of the company as the key suppliers, they should be evaluated annually on the 
product quality, service and other aspects. The evaluation is presided by the department manager or other 
designated person. For the supplier with problems, shall inform the evaluation opinion and request to

rectify or direct abandonment. 
4.1.4 对于重点供应商应以文件形式列明。 
For key suppliers, should be listed in documents form. 
4.2 备件、物料的订购 
Spare parts, stores, orders 
4.2.1 船舶根据船舶和设备维护的需求，在SMIS 中填写备件、物料申请。申请单应尽可能
包括以下信息：设备、备件名称、设备、备件型号、系列号、生产厂家、出厂编号、
出厂日期、物料名称、物料型号、物料的国际编号、船存数量、申请数量、申请理由。 
The ship shall fill in the spare parts and stores application in SMIS according to the needs of ship and 
equipment maintenance. The application form should include as much as possible the following 
information: equipment, spare parts name, equipment, spare parts model number, serial number, 
manufacturer, factory number, ex-factory date, store name, store model number, store IMPA code, 
onboard inventory, applications quantity, application reason, etc. 
4.2.2 船舶备件、物料申请单需由船舶主管人员提出，经船舶轮机长、大副和船长审批后，
上报船管部。 
Ship spare parts, store application form must be made by the ship's in-charged person, through the ship's 
chief engineer, chief officer and captain approval, reported to the fleet department. 
4.2.3 机务总管根据船舶提供的申请，结合备件物料的库存、维护保养工作的要求等，对申
请数量进行审核，然后交供应部物料、备件主管安排询价。 
The Technical superintendent review the applications quantity, according to the application provided by 
the ship, the spare parts inventory, the requirements of the maintenance work, etc., and then forward to 
the stores and spare parts in-charged officer of purchasing department for inquiry. 
4.2.4 物料、备件主管按照审定的内容进行询价。也可以在机务总管没有审核前直接对船舶
提出的申请单进行询价。供应商返回报价后，由机务总管从价格、交货期、产地、是
否原厂等因素综合考虑，进行审定。 
Stores and spare parts in-charged officer according to the reviewed contents to make inquiry. It is also 
possible to direct inquiry on the ship application form before the review by the technical superintendent. 
After the supplier provided the offer, technical superintendent review by integrated considered the price, 
the delivery period, the origin, whether made by the original factory and other factors. 
4.2.5 备件和物料的审批，按照备件单件、物料单个供应单的费用价值，由机务总管审批、
报请部门经理审批、主管机务副总经理审批的审批程序； 
Spare parts and stores review, in accordance with the cost value of one piece spare part, one piece store in 
application list to purchase, and follow the review procedures. Firstly, reviewed by technical 
superintendent, then report to the department manager review, in-charged technical Vice-General 
Manager VGM review. 
4.2.6 确认的订单由备件物料主管负责订购。 
The confirmed order is placed by the spare parts and store in-charged officer. 
4.2.7 机务总管对于确定的备件、物料清单，及时通报船上做好接收准备。 
For the confirmed spare parts, stores list, the technical superintendent will timely notify the ship to 
prepare for receive. 
4.3 备件、物料的验证 
Verification of spare parts and stores 
4.3.1 当所供应的设备、备件、物料到船时，各主管船员要认真核查，船长及时向机务总管
报告接收的情况。 
When the supplied equipment, spare parts, stores delivered to the ship, the in-charged crew should verify 
carefully, captain report to the technical superintendent the receiving situation in time.

4.3.2 凡船级社检验要求提供合格证明的主要零部件、重要阀件、缆绳及消防救生用品等，
应要求供方提供合格证明文件或相应的船检证明并保留在船上。 
船上要对备件和物料的质量进行全程跟踪，当发现所供物品存有质量问题时，应立即
以《船舶备件、物料反馈表》形式通过SMIS 系统报告公司供应部。 
For the classification societies survey required the provision of qualified certificates for major parts, 
important valves, cables and fire-fighting and life-saving equipment, etc., should request the supplier to 
provide proof of conformity or the corresponding ship inspection certificate and remain on board. The 
ship should track the quality of spare parts and stores. When found the supplied items had quality 
problems, shall immediately use "Ship spare parts and store feedback form" format through the SMIS 
system report to the company purchasing department. 
4.3.3 若数量与签收单不符，应以实际供应数量为准，进行签批。 
If the quantity and the receipt does not match, should sign for the actual supplied quantity. 
4.3.4 船舶收取物料时，没有IHM 的船舶要求供应商提供无石棉声明。 
When the ship without IHM receives the store, please request the suppliers to provide the Asbestos-free 
declaration. 
4.3.5 船舶收取物料时，持有IHM 的船舶要求供应商提供材料声明（MD）和供应商符合证
明（SDoC）。 
When the ship with IHM receives the store, please request the suppliers to provide the "Asbestos-free 
declaration "(Material Declaration (MD) and Suppliers Declaration of Conformity (SDoC). 
4.4 设备和属具 
Equipment and attachments 
 
4.4.1 为恢复设备性能而采购的替代设备归属于备件采购，为船舶保养和生活需要而采购的
装备和属具属于物料采购。 
Replacement parts purchased for restoring equipment performance belongs to spare parts purchase. The 
equipment and attachments purchased for ship maintenance and life needs belongs to store purchase. 
4.4.2 替代设备应尽可能的采购船级社认可产品。 
Replacement parts, as far as possible, purchase the classification societies recognized products. 
5.0 记录和归档 
Records and archives 
申请、审核、批准和入库等在SMIS 中进行，并保存相关文本记录 
Application, review, approval and inventory in SMIS, and preserve the relevant text records

Related documents

02_56.text:
第二十六章  船舶证书和检验报告的管理程序 
Chapter 26 Ship Certificate & Survey Report Management Procedure 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and scope 
1.1 规定船舶证书、检验报告管理办法，保证船舶证书、检验记录的完整性和有效性。 
To stipulate management method of the ship certificate, inspection report and to ensure the integrity and 
effectiveness of those records. 
1.2 本程序适用于船管部和所管理的船舶。 
This procedure applies to Fleet Department and all managed ships. 
1.3 本程序只限于船管部管理职责范围内的船舶入级证书、船旗国颁发或者授权船级社颁
发的各种证书及其检验记录和报告。 
This procedure is limited to within the scope of management duties of the Fleet Departments which 
includes the ship's in classification certificate, inspection records and reports issued by flag state and/or 
their authorized classification society . 
2.0 定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
（空）(Blank) 
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船长负责船舶证书和检验报告的保存和有效性控制。 
The Captain is responsible for the preservation and validity control of the ship's certificate and inspection 
report. 
3.2 船管部保存船舶证书的副本或者复制文件，并负责安排保持证书有效性的检验。 
The Fleet Department shall keep a ship's certificate duplicate or a copy of document and shall be 
responsible for application of the certificate re-validation inspection. 
3.3 船管部负责公司主服务器上电子版证书、检验报告和记录的录入、修改和维护。无关
人员不得随意修改、删除。 
The Fleet Department is responsible for the entry, modification and maintenance of electronic certificates, 
inspection reports and records on the company main server. These data should not be modified or deleted 
by any unauthorized personnel. 
4.0 程序 
Procedures 
4.1 船舶证书和检验报告 
Ship certificate and inspection report 
 船长应熟悉船舶保持证书的要求，并负责证书和检验报告的保存；如果船舶签发了
双重载重线证书，只有当前的证书应保存在证书文件/文件夹；不适用的证书应放
到一边，保存在安全的地方；并及时将收到的证书及报告在SMIS 中更新。 
The Captain should be familiar with the maintaining requirements of ship's certificate and be 
responsible for the preservation of the certificate and survey report; If the vessel has been issued with 
multiple load-line certificates, only the current certificate should be kept in certificates file/folder; 
non- applicable certificates should be kept away, secure in safe place. and update the certificate and 
report received in SMIS in a timely manner. 
 船管部保存船舶证书的副本或者复制文件； 

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/1.0                      PRO-26 
Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/1.0                      PRO-26 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/09/30        第2/3页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/09/30           Page: 2/3 
The Fleet Department shall keep a ship's certificate copy or copy document; 
 保存的证书和检验报告清单参照相应船舶的SMIS—“证书管理”—“船舶证书信
息”所列细目。 
List of certificates and inspection reports preserved, in accordance with the details of the ship's SMIS- 
"Certificate Management" - "Ship Certificate Information". 
4.2 证书有效性保持 
Maintenance of certificate validity 
 船长应在SMIS 上对船舶证书进行登记，记录有效期或者到期日等相关信息在证书
到期或进入检验窗口前，向船管部申请安排相关的检验，并根据船管部的检验安排
做好迎检准备。 
The Captain should register the ship certificate on SMIS, record the validity period or expiration date 
and other relevant information. Before the certificate expires or enter the inspection window, apply to 
the Fleet Department to arrange the relevant inspection, and according to the inspection arrangement 
by fleet department to be well prepared. 
 机务总管应掌握船舶证书相应的检验时间，并负责检验的安排。包括，确定检验地
点，联系检验机构，通知船舶准备检验等。 
The Technical Superintendent shall grasp the appropriate inspection time for the ship certificate, and 
be responsible for the inspection arrangements. These arrangements should include at least to 
determine the location of the inspection, to contact the inspection organizations, to notify the ship to 
prepare for inspection. 
 机务总管负责船级社检验信息的收集，并每季度发送船舶。 
The Technical Superintendent is responsible for collecting the classification societies survey status 
and sending the ship on a quarterly basis. 
 船长对收到的检验信息进行验证，并根据公司每季度发到船上的《检验信息》，及
时核对各种证书、报告的有效性，并保存检验信息。 
The Captain verifies the survey status received and, in accordance with the "survey status" sent by the 
company on a quarterly basis, verifies the validity of the various certificates and reports in timely 
manner and preserve the survey status. 
4.3 证书及报告审查 
Certificate and report review 
 机务总管和船长应熟悉证书、检验报告，每次收到证书、检验报告后，一定要详细
阅读、检查。 
Technical Superintendent and the Captain should be familiar with the certificate, survey report. Each 
time when received a certificate, survey report, must read and check in detail. 
 机务总管在收到证书和检验报告正本后，要及时送船，并保存副本 
After receiving the original certificate and survey report, the Technical Superintendent shall send the 
vessel in time and keep the copy in head office for reference. 
 船管部之外的其它证书由海务部海务主管负责。 
Superintendent from the Marine Department is responsible for certificates other than that in-charged 
by the Fleet Department. 
 有关船员的相关证书由船员部负责。 
Crew Department is responsible for the relevant certificate of the crew member.  
4.4 电子证书 
Electronic Certificates 
4.4.1 初次签发电子证书通常在完成船舶建造检验、转级检验、重大改建检验、最近一次定
期检验/审核或更换船名/船旗的附加检验等工作时进行，船级社将在后续的检验/审核

程序手册                           版本/修改：3.0/1.0                      PRO-26 
Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/1.0                      PRO-26 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/09/30        第3/3页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/09/30           Page: 3/3 
中继续为其签发电子证书，除非船舶更改为未授权船级社签发电子证书的船旗，或船
东/船公司自身提出取消电子证书的需求。  
Normally the electronic certificates are to be initially issued upon the completion of new construction 
survey, survey for transfer of class, major conversion survey, the latest periodical survey or audit and the 
additional survey for change of ship’s name or flag, etc. The class will issue Declaration of issuance of 
electronic certificates to ship. Electronic certificates will be issued subsequently, unless the ship changes 
the flag to that not authorizes class to issue electronic certificates, or the ship owner/ company itself 
requests to cancel the service. 
4.4.2 船舶在收到最新的电子证书前，应注意保存经验船师/审核员签署的打印版电子证书； 
The printed E-Cert. signed by the class surveyor/auditor should be kept on board prior to receive the latest 
e-cert.  
4.4.3 使用电子证书的船舶应注意将最新有效的电子证书保存在船上，并与失效的电子证书
分开存放以免混用；船长需要在办公电脑中建立专用文件夹保存有效地电子版证书和
检验报告，收到电子证书后及时保存并清晰打印保存； 
The ship with e-cert. should be careful to keep the latest valid e-cert. on board, and store separately with 
invalid e-cert., Captain need to set up a special folder in the office computer to keep e-cert. and survey 
reports, after receiving the e-cert, the captain should print and keep in document file. 
4.4.4 熟悉船旗国/船级社的有关电子证书的通函或通告，能够熟练验证，有效地保存这些
通函或通告，方便向港口国检察官、验船师、审核员出示； 
Captain should understand the e-cert circulars or notes of the flag state/classification society, could 
verified the validity, keep those circulars or notes to show them to PSCO, surveyor, auditor. 
4.4.5 电子证书传送和接收需使用邮件回执的方式确认签收. 
The transmission and reception of the electronic certificate shall be confirmed by means of an email 
receipt. 
5.0 记录与归档 
Records and archives 
5.1 船舶有效证书应由船长在SMIS 系统上进行登记并建立文件清单。 
The ship's valid certificate shall be registered by the master on the SMIS system and a list of documents 
shall be established. 
6.0 相关文件 
Related documents

02_57.chapter: 第二十七章 新造船保修管理程序
02_57.text:
第二十七章   新造船保修管理程序 
Chapter 27 New shipbuilding warranty management procedures 
 
1.0 目的范围 
Purpose scope 
1.1 通过对新造船保修单的有效控制，细化保修工作的管理，保证船舶缺陷及时、有效的
消除。 
Through the effective control of the new building warranty order, detailed warranty works management, 
to ensure timely and effective eliminate ship defects. 
1.2 适用于公司新造船保修期内的保修工作管理。 
Applies to the warranty works management of the company's new building ship within warranty period. 
2.0 定义和缩写 
Definitions and abbreviations 
（空）(blank) 
3.0 工作流程  
Workflow 
3.1 保修的基本内容：保修是依据合同、备忘录等对双方或多方有效的法律文件的规定，
在保修期内由造船厂免费提供保修服务，以满足双方或多方需求的质量保证。基本内
容如下：  
The basic content of the warranty: the warranty is based on the clause of contract, memorandum, etc. on 
both sides or more effective legal documents, through which during the warranty period the free warranty 
service will be performed by the shipyard to meet the needs of both parties or multi-quality assurance. 
The basic contents are as follows: 
 提供完整的产品使用维护说明书、备件册和有关技术文件；  
Provide a complete product instruction and maintenance manual, spare parts list and related technical 
documents; 
 配备合同规定的备品和维护工具；  
Equipped with contracted spare parts and maintenance tools; 
 提供技术培训和咨询；  
Provide technical training and advice; 
 保修期间，造船厂及时为新造船排除保修范围内的故障或派出保船工程师随船服
务，必要时可派出服务人员登船服务；  
During the warranty period, the shipyard in a timely manner for the new ship to eliminate the failure 
within the warranty scope or send the ship warranty engineers service sailing onboard. If necessary 
services should be well arranged accordingly. 
3.2 船舶保修期限  
Ship Warranty Period  
 按合同中的规定执行。船舶保修期通常为一年，起始于船东接受本船之日，终止于
周年日。  
Implement in accordance with the provisions of the contract. Usually the ship's warranty period is one 
year, beginning on the date of acceptance of the owner, ending on the anniversary. 
 船舶设备厂商直接与公司签署的保修期参照具体协议。 
For the ship equipment manufacturers directly signed with the company, the warranty period refer to 
specific agreements. 
 保修期在合同签订后，一般不予改动，特殊情况经双方同意，可对保修期做出新的
规定。  

程序手册                          版次/修改：3.0/0.0                     PRO-27 
Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/0.0                   PRO-27 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01         第2/4页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/04/01           Page: 2/4 
Once the contract is signed th warranty period generally is not to be changed. In special circumstances, 
it could be revised with agreement by both sides. 
3.3 船舶保修适用 
Applicable to ship warranty scope 
3.4 造船厂承制或采购(包括外包)的船体、机电设备(包括附属设备)、材料、舱室设施等，
属设计错误、材料缺陷、施工不良、机电设备非人为因素运行不正常都属保修范围。 
Built or purchased (including outsourcing) by shipyard include but not limited to hull, mechanical and 
electrical equipment (including ancillary equipment), materials, cabin facilities, those defects caused by 
design error, material defects, poor workmanship, mechanical and electrical equipment not functioning 
properly due to non-human factors, are covered under ship warranty. 
3.5 以下情况不属于造船厂保修范围：  
The following conditions do not fall within the scope of the shipyard warranty: 
 船东提供产品；  
Products provided by ship owner; 
 超过保修期限(包括合同条款、双方已签署的备忘录的规定)；  
Warranty period expired (including the terms of the contract, the two sides signed memorandum); 
 属于正常维护保养范围；  
Items upon the normal maintenance scope; 
 由于管理不善，使用不当； 
Due to mismanagement, improper use;  
 不可抗力因素，自然灾害等造成的意外事故 ； 
Cause of force majeure, natural disasters and other accidents; 
 正常磨损件、正常寿命损坏件等；  
Normal wear down parts and normal life damage parts; 
 船舶自行修理后损坏及未经造船厂同意或使用方自行请其他单位修理后损坏的项
目(不包括特殊应急项目)。  
Damage after repair by the ship crew and damage after repair without the consent of the shipyard or 
by other repair services provider (not including special emergency items). 
3.6 保修信息处理  
Warranty Information handling 
 船长负责将甲板部、轮机部经过保船工程师（如在船）认可的保修单及时发送给造
船厂售后负责人和公司机务总管，同时将保修单(WORD 文档)发给机务总管以便统
计存档。 
The guarantee claim application form from deck and engine department, recognized by the warranty 
engineer (if onboard), shall be sent to shipyard person in-charge after sale and Technical 
Superintendent timely. Meanwhile it should be sent to Technical Superintendent for record keeping by 
word format. 
 轮机长、大副分别负责轮机部、甲板部保修单的编制、归档统计并跟踪，保修单中
的故障描述要清晰扼要，列明故障设备的生产厂家、设备型号、系列号、所需备件
或材料的编号尺寸数量等，并附相关部位照片等资料和信息。如果因专业技术的原
因船上不能提供详细的情况，可标注未知。 
The Chief Engineer and the Chief Officer are responsible for the preparation, statistical archiving and 
tracing the warranty order of the engine department and the deck department respectively. The fault 
description in the warranty order should be clear and detailed, list out the manufacturer, equipment 
model, serial number, code number, dimensions, quantity of spare parts or material needed of the 
faulty equipment, and attach the related parts photos and information. If due to professional and 
technical reasons, ship cannot provide detailed information, it can be marked as unknown. 

程序手册                          版次/修改：3.0/0.0                     PRO-27 
Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/0.0                   PRO-27 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2018/04/01         第3/4页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/04/01           Page: 3/4 
 船长负责将（到港的时间和地点）船舶动态及当地代理的详细通讯地址提前通知造
船厂售后负责人和公司机务总管，以便保证保修备件的运输和(保船)服务工程师登
轮服务。 
The Captain is responsible for informing the shipyard after sales in-charge and the company's 
Technical Superintendent in advance of ship movement (estimated arrival time and location) and the 
local agent's details, in order to ensure the transport of the warranty spare parts and (ship warranty) the 
service engineer attend onboard. 
 船长负责将每个保修单的备件和（保船）服务工程师登轮服务结果及时反馈给公司。
船长要对厂家给出的指导及时回复。 
The Captain is responsible for the timely feedback of each warranty order spare parts and (ship 
warranty) the service engineer onboard service result to the company. The Captain should give a 
timely reply to the instructions given by the manufacturer. 
 机务总管将保修单情况向主管经理汇报，将保修单归档统计并跟踪。将造船厂的保
修信息及时和船舶进行沟通，协调售后争议，重要事宜向主管经理汇报。公司机务
总管负责向造船厂售后负责人索要保修单备件运单和保船工程师信息。提前告知船
舶做好备件的接收和修理的准备工作。 
The Technical Superintendent reports the warranty order status to the in-charged manager, statistical 
archiving and tracking the warranty order. Timely provide the ship with the shipyard warranty 
information, coordinate after sale disputes, report the important matters to the in-charged manager. 
The company's Technical Superintendent is responsible for requesting the shipyard after sales 
in-charge to provide warranty order spare parts waybill and ship warranty service engineer 
information. Advise the ship in advance to prepare spare parts delivery and repair. 
 在保修工作中如果产生意见分歧，一般采用相互协商的方法解决。在双方无法达成
一致意见时，可按合同条款申请仲裁机构进行仲裁。 
In the warranty work if there are different opinion, generally use of mutual consultation method to 
solve. When two parties cannot reach an agreement, they may make application to the arbitration 
institution for arbitration in accordance with the terms of the contract. 
3.7 保修的实施  
Implementation of the warranty 
 船长、轮机长、大副负责保修备件的清点签收（参照备件物料申请程序）和保船工
程师登轮的接待。设备主管负责人监督（保船）服务工程师保修工作，验证修理结
果，（通知相关）部门负责人签署保修完工单，船长、轮机长、大副各自负责保存
签署的保修完工单。 
Captain, Chief Engineer, Chief Officer are responsible for the check and receipt of the warranty spare 
parts (refer to the spare parts store application procedure) and the boarding reception of the warranty 
service engineer. The in-charged crew of the equipment is responsible to supervise (ship warranty) 
service engineer's warranty work, verify the repair result. and inform related department head to sign 
the warranty completion order. The Captain, the Chief Engineer and the Chief Officer are responsible 
to preserve the warranty completion order signed by himself. 
 保修项目中属于重大建造质量、设计错误问题的，机务总管应向主管经理汇报，由
主管经理通报给主管副总。机务总管经过请示主管经理方可通报其它同类型船舶。 
The warranty item leading to a major construction quality, design errors, the Technical Superintendent 
should report to the in-charged manager, informed the VGM by the in-charged manager. The 
Technical Superintendent shall only notify the sister ship after approved by the in-charged manager. 
 保修单、保修单信息统计表等资料的保存期限为船舶保修期结束后三年。  
Warranty order, warranty order information statistic table and other information on the shelf life is 
three years after the end of the ship warranty period.

Procedure manual                    Version/Revise:3.0/0.0                   PRO-27

   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2018/04/01           Page: 4/4 
 船长每季度应向公司写一份保修总结，对船舶发生的主要问题、事故、故障及其原
因等进行描述。 
The Captain should report a warranty summary to the company on a quarterly basis, to describe the 
main problems, accidents, failures and causes analysis of them. 
 保修单闭合时相关人员填写完成情况（详见保修单要求），以便船舶和公司闭合保
修单。分别由轮机长和大副收集（使用WORD 文档）并发给机务总管存档。 
When the warranty order is closed, the relevant personnel fill in the completion situation (see the 
warranty order requirements), so that the ship and the company can close the warranty order. These 
kind of material should be collected by the Chief Engineer and Chief Officer respectively (WORD 
format) and sent to the Technical Superintendent for archive.
