02_58.chapter: 第二十八章 船舶修理厂选择程序
02_58.text:
第二十八章  船舶修理厂选择程序 
Chapter 28 Shipyard selection Procedure 
 
1.0 目的和范围 
Purpose and scope 
1.1 本程序规定了船舶修理厂选择的控制要求，以确保选择合格的船舶修理厂，并保证修
理厂的工作质量符合公司规定的要求。 
This procedure specifies the control requirements for the shipyard selection, to ensure the selected 
shipyard is qualified and the quality of the work is in accordance with the company requirements. 
1.2 本程序适用于船管部对船舶修理厂的选择。 
This procedure is applicable to Fleet Department for choosing shipyards. 
2.0 定义和缩写  
Definitions and abbreviations 
（空）(Blank) 
3.0 职责 
Responsibilities 
3.1 船舶：负责提出修理工程单。 
Ships: responsible for the repair lists. 
3.2 船管部：负责组织船舶修理厂的选择，签订修船协议或修船合同，公布合格修理厂名
单。确定合格修理厂报送主管副总批准。 
Fleet Department: responsible for organizing shipyard selection, signing a ship repair agreement or ship 
repair contract, preparing a qualified shipyard list. To determine the qualified shipyard and submitted to 
the Vice General Manager for approval. 
4.0 工作程序 
Working procedures 
4.1 修理厂选择资料的控制 
Control of the chosen shipyard data 
4.2 在修理厂选择资料确认审核时，必要时应参考： 
In checking chosen shipyard data, if needed, followings should be considered: 
 修理厂选择应贯彻“择优选厂”、“就近选厂”和“先国内后国外”的原则。 
The basic principle should be as following: “Reputation – Good first”, “Location – Nearby first” and 
“ Domestic First - International Second”. 
 在质量保证、价格合理的基础上，所选修理厂要保证修期。 
In the basis of quality assurance and reasonable price, the chosen shipyard should confirm the 
warranty period. 
 船舶精密仪器、高速设备等专业工程的修理，以选择本专业厂家为主。 
Ship precision instruments, high-speed equipment and other professional engineering repair, should be 
repaired by the professional manufacturers and/or their authorized organizations. 
4.3 修理厂选择和确定 
Shipyard selection and determination 
 船舶就修理工程的类别、内容和要求等方面提出修理工程单，报船管部。 
The ship will prepare a list of the repair works including, category, content and requirements, and 
report to Fleet Department. 
 船舶航修和事故性修理由船管部机务总管根据船舶修理工程单的要求在合格修理厂
名单中选择修理厂，交船管部经理审核批准。 
Ship voyage repair and accidental repair shipyard should be chosen by the Technical Superintendent 

程序手册                         版次/修改： 3.0/1.0                         PRO-28 
Procedure manual                  Version/Revise:3.0/1.0                         PRO-28 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2022/08/05         第2/3页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2022/08/05          Page: 2/3 
of Fleet Department. According to the requirements in repair list, choose a shipyard from the qualified 
shipyard list, and submit to Fleet Department manager for review and approval. 
 船舶计划性进厂修理的工程，船管部经理根据工程内容和要求，在合格修理厂名单
中选择修理厂报主管副总批准。船舶进厂修理前应与承修厂签订修理协议书（修船
合同）。 
Ship planned shipyard repair works, the Fleet Department manager according to the work content and 
requirements, choose a shipyard from the qualified shipyard list and report to Vice-General Manager 
(VGM) for approval. Before the ship enters the shipyard, a repair agreement should be signed with the 
shipyard (ship repair contract). 
 如航线、租期和工程等特殊原因，需要选择合格修理厂名单以外的修理厂进行承修
时，机务总管应将特殊原因报告部门经理，经部门经理同意后实施。 
If special reasons such as routes, leases and repair works, need to choose a shipyard not in the 
qualified shipyard list, the Technical Superintendent should report the special reason to the department 
manager, implement after the consent from department manager. 
4.4 修理厂的评价和控制 
Evaluation and control of shipyard 
4.5 修理厂的评价依据包括其以往的修理能力和修理业绩的记录、其他公司或船 舶在该厂
修理的质量情况、质量体系运行情况、实地考证等。 
Shipyard evaluation is based on the past repair ability and repair performance record, other companies or 
ships repair quality in that shipyard, the operation of quality control system, observation result from field 
visit, etc. 
4.6 对合格修理厂名单以外的修理厂，机务总管可根据其承担本公司或其他公司  修理业
务的情况，提出推荐意见报船管部经理。 
For the shipyard not in the qualified shipyard list, Technical Superintendent may, in accordance with the 
circumstances of the repair case of the company or other companies, make recommendations to the Fleet 
Department manager. 
4.7 船管部根据修理厂提供的资质材料（可以包括：厂况介绍、质量证明、修理业绩和营
业执照等）以及推荐意见，适时对拟纳入合格修理厂名单的厂家进行评价，并填妥评
价表。 
The Fleet Department shall in accordance with the qualification information provided by the shipyard 
(which may include: shipyard introduction, quality certificate, repair performance and business license, 
etc.) and recommendations, evaluate the shipyard which intended to enter the qualified shipyard list, and 
fill in shipyard evaluation form. 
4.8 对拟纳入合格修理厂名单的修理厂，必要时派员实地考察，报公司主管副总批准。 
Before allow shipyard enter the qualified shipyard list, somebody should be sent to have a field visit, 
report to company in-charged Vice-General Manager VGM approval. 
4.9 经批准的航修厂和修理厂，由船管部编制合格修理厂名单公布通知。 
Approved voyage repair workshop and shipyard, the Fleet Department will prepare a qualified shipyard 
list to publish and notify all concerned personnel within the system. 
4.10 船管部根据修理厂承修情况，建立修理厂质量档案，汇总修船质量信息。 
According to the repair works of the shipyard, the Fleet Department shall establish a shipyard quality files 
and file the summary ship repair quality information.  
4.11 由船管部对合格修理厂名单中的厂家每年年底进行一次综合评价，填写《合格修理厂
评价表》，经评价和批准的合格修理厂，由船管部重新编制《合格修理厂名单》予以公
布。每次修船结束后，对承修船厂进行一次评价，填写《修理厂评价（或入选推荐）
表》评估此次修船完成情况。 
At the end of each year, the Ship Management Department shall conduct a comprehensive evaluation of

the manufacturers in the list of qualified repair shops, fill in the "Shipyard Evaluation Form", and the 
qualified repair shops that have been evaluated and approved shall be re-compiled by the Ship 
Management Department to compile the "List of Qualified Shipyard" and publish it. After each ship 
repair, an evaluation of the shipyard is conducted, and the "Shipyard Evaluation (or Selection 
Recommendation) Form" is filled in to evaluate the completion of the ship repair. 
4.12 应增加对在修理中出现质量问题的修理厂的评价频次，对在修理中出现两次及以上质
量问题的修理厂，应取消其合格修理厂资格。 
For shipyards which have got quality problems in repair works, the evaluation frequency should be 
increased. For shipyards that have twice or more quality problems during repairs, they should be 
disqualified from the list. 
4.13 评价认为不合格的修理厂，将不再列入合格修理厂名录。 
The shipyard considered to be unqualified in evaluations, will no longer be included in the list of 
qualified shipyards. 
5.0 修理厂的验证 
Shipyard verification 
船管部认为有必要在修理厂处进行验证其工作时，应在签订修理合同或航修协议中规
定验证的安排和方法。 
When the Fleet Department deemed necessary to verify the works at the shipyard, it should specify the 
verification arrangements and methods in the repair contract or voyage repair agreement. 
6.0 记录和归档 
Records and archives 
6.1 船管部应保存合格修理厂修理质量记录、修理厂评价记录和修船协议和合同。 
The Fleet Department shall maintain the repair quality records, the shipyard evaluation record and the 
ship repair agreements and contracts of the qualified shipyards. 
6.2 船管部负责“合格修理厂名单”的保存和归档。并负责保存“修理厂入选推荐表”和
“修理厂评价表”。 
The Fleet Department is responsible for the preservation and filing of the "list of qualified shipyards"and 
is responsible for preserving the "Shipyard recommendation form" and "Shipyard evaluation form".

02_59.chapter: 第二十九章 变更管理程序
02_59.text:
第二十九章  变更管理程序 
Chapter 29  Management of Change Procedure 
 
1 
目的 
 
Purpose 
 
本程序描述了变更管理程序的各项要求。旨在建立识别机制和控制那些对健康、安全、
环境及质量的不利影响，同时也定义了职责范围以及这些变更的各种文件。 
This procedure describes the requirements for the management of change procedure. It aims to establish 
mechanisms to identify and control those adverse impacts on health, safety, environment and quality, 
and also defines the scope of responsibilities and the various documents for the management of change. 
 
2 
适用范围 
Application  
 
本程序适用于所有对安全管理有影响的变化,如：临时和永久的对人员、程序、系统、
设备的变更。 
This procedure applies to all changes that affect safety management, such as temporary and permanent 
changes to personnel, procedures, systems, and equipment. 
 
3 
定义 
Definition 
3.1 
变更管理： 是指在公司、船舶的安全管理活动中，关键岗位人员、设备、管理程序
或系统的变化。 
Management of change：refers to the change of key position personnel, equipment, management 
procedures or systems in the safety management activities of a company or ship. 
3.2 
变更申请人：是指按照职责权限，对变更事项提出审批申请的人。 
Change initiator: refers to the person submits an application for approval of the change in accordance 
with the duties and responsibilities. 
3.3 
申请核准人： 是指有权对申请内容进行核准的人，通常是变更申请人的上一级领导。 
Verifier: refers to the person authorized to verify the content of the application for change, usually the 
higher level of leadership of the change initiator. 
3.4 
变更批准人：是指按照职责权限，对变更申请作出审批决定的人员。 
Change approver: refers to the person who approves the change request in accordance with the duties 
and responsibilities. 
3.5 
关键岗位人员： 本文件中所述关键岗位人员是指公司总经理、副总经理、指定人员、
各部门经理。 
Key position personnel: The key position personnel mentioned refers to the General Manager, Vice 
General Manager, Designated Personnel, and managers of department of the company. 
 
4 
变更要求和职责权限 
Requirements and responsibilities of change 
4.1 
所有的变更必须进行风险评估，必须保证此变更所产生的风险控制在尽量小的范围
内。这些变更必须符合新的法规要求。 
A risk assessment must be carried out for all changes and the risks arising from the changes must be 
minimized as far as possible, while ensuring that these changes comply with the new regulatory 
requirements.

公司认为下述项目发生变化时，应遵从变更管理的流程。变更的审批人应有合适的资

5 
程序 
Procedures 
 
5.1 
变更管理的申请 
Change management application 
 
任何人要求或表明变更的需求，需完成“PRO-29-01 变更的管理记录”的“A”部分并提
交给由公司指定的负责核实和监控变更管理程序的负责人。填妥的A 部分表格必须
包含充足的细节内容以便负责人判断变更过程是否继续。 
Any person requesting or indicating the need for a change shall complete part "A" of the "Pro-29-01 
Change Management Record" and submit it to the person designated by the Company to verify and 
monitor the management of change process. The completed Part A form must contain sufficient detail 
for the responsible person to determine whether the change process continues. 
5.2 
对是否进行变更进行核实 
Verify the management of change process 
 
收到表格“A”部分后，申请核准人应该仔细阅读文件，做一个初步评估，以判断该变
更是否为必须。该判断必须由申请核准人以书面形式记录在表格的“B”部分。并交还
给变更申请人，并由其完成表格“C”部分。 
Upon receipt of form "A", the verifier should read the document carefully and make an initial 
assessment to determine if the change is necessary. The determination must be recorded in writing by 
the verifier on Form "B". 
The form must be returned to the initiator who completes Form "C". 
5.3 
风险评估 
Risk Assessment 
 
如果变更能继续进行，变更申请人必须根据公司的“PRO-16 风险评估程序”对其完成
风险评估。 
If the change process proceeds, the initiator of the change must conduct a risk assessment in accordance 
with the company's PRO-16 Risk Assessment Procedure. 
 
风险评估应包括以下方面： 
The risk assessment shall include the following contents: 
 
1) 符合适用的国际公约、船旗国的法律，公司的法律法规及规章制度，船级社及航
运组织的建议、指南等； 
Comply with applicable international conventions, laws of flag states, regulations and rules of the 
company, suggestions and guidelines of classification societies and shipping organizations, etc.; 
2) 对安全管理系统的影响； 
Impact on the security management system; 
3) 人员和/或签约人的资质； 
Qualifications of personnel and/or contractors; 
4) 设备的说明书； 
Manuals of the equipment;

5) 健康和安全问题； 
Health and safety issues; 
6) 公司组织的影响； 
Impact on the company organization; 
 
风险评估要表明初始风险水平，风险降低措施需将风险降低到最低程度。 
The risk assessment should reflect the initial level of risk and minimizes the risk through risk mitigation 
measures. 
5.4 
变更程序文件 
Documents of Change procedures   
 
如果变更的细节在表格“A”部分不够充分完整，变更程序文件（计划方案）必须要有
详细说明 
If the details of the change are not fully reflected in Form "A", they must be detailed in the change 
procedure document (scheme). 
 
1) 变更的细节和执行程序； 
Details of the changes and the procedures for implementing them. 
2) 操作手册和图表更新的要求； 
Requirements for updating of operating manuals and diagrams. 
3) 必要的通信以标明相关人员都是公司内部的； 
Necessary correspondence to indicate that relevant personnel are internal of the company; 
4) 必要的培训以更有效的执行变更； 
Necessary training to implement the changes more effectively. 
5) 公司提供相应的资源使所有相关人员均在规定的时间内接受培训； 
The company shall provide appropriate resources to ensure that all relevant employees are trained 
within the specified time. 
6) 接新船时，要保证主管和船员足够的熟悉时间，对设备进行熟悉和操作培训，公
司建立一个接新船的熟悉检查清单。 
When taking over a new ship, ensure sufficient familiarization time for the supervisor and crew to 
familiarize and train on the operation of the equipment, and the company establishes a 
familiarization checklist for taking over a new ship. 
5.5 
变更的核实与查证 
Verification and inspection of changes 
 
任何一个变更必须得到上级领导的批准，确认执行了正确的步骤，并由批准人在表“D”
部分签署。变更的核实与查证应包括：  
Any change should be approved by the direct supervisor to confirm that the correct steps have been 
taken and signed by the approver on Form "D". Verification and validation of changes should include 
the following: 
 
1) 变更文件的内容； 
Content

Reason 
4) 风险评估；

5) 风险降低程序；

6) 变更的财政核实。 
Financial verification of changes 
 
7) 核实查证完毕， 
Verification completed 
5.6 
执行和监控 
Execution and Monitoring 
 
变更管理（MOC）文件必须标明负责变更的执行和监控的人员，负责监控的人员必须
保证变更在约定的时间范围内完成。如果不能在此期限内完成变更或临时的变更超出
当初授权的范围，该变更的批准人员必须对其进行核实，如继续变更须重新授权。 
The Management of Change (MOC) documents shall identify the person responsible for executing and 
monitoring the change process, and the person responsible for monitoring should ensure that the change 
is completed within the agreed time frame. If the changes cannot be completed within this timeframe, or 
if the temporary change is beyond the scope of the original approval, the person who approved the 
change must review and reapprove it if it is continued. 
 
完成变更管理，由执行人和（或）监控人填报表（E）部分，并送交公司DPA 进行评
审。 
After completing the Management of Change, the executor and/or monitor should fill out Form (E) 
section and send it to the company DPA for review. 
5.7 
评价变更的有效性 
Evaluate the effectiveness of changes 
 
指定人员应该评审变更是否被有效实施，完成“PRO-29-01 变更的管理记录”F 部分。
评审应包括： 
The DPA shall assess whether the change has been effectively implemented and complete Section F of 
the "PRO-29-01 Management of Change Record". The assessment shall include: 
 
1) 变更是否在时间范围内完成？ 
Were the changes completed on time? 
2) 是否所有的降低风险措施都已执行？ 
Have all risk mitigation measures been implemented? 
3) 是否所有的出版物，操作守则，图纸都已更新了？ 
Have all publications, practice guidelines, drawings been updated? 
4) 变更设计的文件和图纸，技术资料及时更新，对船舶结构或设备等技术变化和演

变纳入船舶的历史记录； 
Documents, drawings and technical information with changes are updated in a timely manner, and 
technical changes and evolution such as ship structure or equipment are included in the ship's

5) 变更是否达到了变更的目标？ 
Does the change meet the objectives? 
6) 是否还有附加的变更要进行？ 
Are there any additional changes to be made? 
7) 是否要附加变更去弥补不足？ 
Do additional changes need to be made to address the deficiencies?

以下作为变更管理文件与记录，应保持3 年。

02_60.chapter: 第三十章 船员招募和安置机构的评估程序
02_60.text:
第三十章 船员招募和安置机构的评估程序 
Chapter 30   Procedure of RPS evaluation 
1 
目的Purpose 
 
1.1 本程序规定了对船员招募和安置机构的审核评估程序。 
This procedure sets out the audit and evaluation process for crew recruitment/placement agencies. 
1.2 旨在为船舶配备合格、持证、健康、整体素质较高的船员，满足管理公司的船舶管理
要求； 
Aiming to equip the ship with qualified, licensed, healthy and overall high quality crew to meet the 
management company's ship management requirements. 
1.3 管理公司提供符合MLC 要求的安全健康保障，船员部需验证船员能够获得体面的船上
工作和生活条件, 享受健康保护、医疗、福利措施及其他形式的社会保护。并获得公
平的就业条件。 
The management company provides safety and health protection in accordance with MLC requirements 
to ensure that crew members are able to obtain decent working and living conditions on board, enjoy 
health protection, medical treatment, welfare measures and other forms of social protection and to obtain 
fair employment conditions. 
1.4 使船员招募和安置机构和船员了解公司的安全文化，熟悉公司的管理目标和措施。  
To make crew recruitment/placement agencies and crew members aware of the company's safety culture 
and familiar with the company's management objectives and measures.  
2 
适用范围Application 
本程序适用于船舶管理公司和船员招募和安置机构，以及参与船员招募/培训/保障活动
的相关部门。  
This procedure applies to ship management companies and crew recruitment and placement agencies, as 
well as relevant departments involved in crew recruitment/training/support activities. 
3 
定义和缩写Definitions and Abbreviations. 
3.1 例行评估：参考体系要求，依照公司制定的船员招募和安置机构年度评估计划安排的
评估活动。 
Routine evaluation: the evaluation activities arranged by the company according to the company's 
annual evaluation plan in accordance with the requirements of the SMS code 
3.2 附加评估：例行审核以外临时安排的评估。 
Additional evaluation: Temporary arranged evaluation s other than routine evaluations 
3.3 船员招募和安置服务机构系指公共或私营部门中从事代表公司招募船员或与公司安置
船员的任何个人、公司、机构、代理或其它组织。 
Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Service （RPS）: means any person, company, institution, agency or 
other organization, in the public or the private sector, which is engaged in recruiting crew on behalf of 
Company or placing crew with Company.  
3.4  船员就业协议：包括就业合同和协议条款； 
Crew Employment Agreement: includes both a contract of employment and articles of agreement.

   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2022/06/10           Page: 2/5 
4 职责Responsibility    
4.1 船员部，使用船员招募和安置服务机构（RPS）时，船员部应核对RPS 对MLC2006 标
准的符合情况并对该机构的服务情况进行评估。 
When using a recruitment and placement service (RPS). CD shall verify compliance with the 
requirements of MLC 2006 and carry out RPS evaluation. 
4.2 船员部负责制定船员招募和安置服务机构（RPS）的年度评估计划，根据船旗国要求和
船员所在国家的劳动法规要求，制定《船员招募和安置机构评估表》，和海务部、船
管部一起组建审核小组进行评估。船员部保存《船员招募和安置机构评估表》。 
The Crew Department is responsible for formulating the annual evaluation plan of the Recruitment and 
Placement Service (RPS), according to the requirements of the flag state and the labor regulations of the 
country where the crew is located, to formulate the “Crew Recruitment and Placement Agency Evaluation 
Form”, together with the Marine Department and Fleet Department form a review team to evaluate. The 
Crew Department keeps the Crew Recruitment and Placement Agency Evaluation Form. 
4.3 海务部和船管部应对船员招募和安置服务机构（RPS）的使用和评估提出合理化建议，
和船员部一起完成评估。 
The Marine Department and Fleet Department should make rational recommendations for the use and 
evaluation of Recruitment and Placement Services (RPS), and complete the evaluation together with the 
Crew Department. 
4.4 在确定使用某船员招募和安置服务机构（RPS）后，船员公司代表管理公司签署并保
管派员协议。 
After confirming the use of a Recruitment and Placement Service (RPS), the crewing company signs and 
maintains the assignment agreement on behalf of the management company.

船员部应每年进行一次（通常是在每年的12 月底），或使用新的船员招募和安置机构
时，或在船员部经理认为有必要时根据《船员招募和安置机构评估表》 应对船员招募
和安置机构进行评估，确保其符合MLC 2006 A/1.4 和船旗国的要求。 
To ensure RPS establishes management procedures of crew’ recruitment and placement in accordance 
with the STCW, MLC 2006 and the laws and/or regulations of flag state，RPS Evaluation shall be carried 
out by CD once a year (as a rule, by the end of Dec) , or new RPS introduced, or when deemed necessary 
by CD manager in accordance with the  <RPS Evaluation Sheet> to confirm compliance with standard 
A/1.4 of MLC 2006 & flag state requirements, etc. is carried out 
5.2 船员招募和安置机构年度评估计划由船员部制定，在指定人员和总经理审核后实施。
评估小组成员应包括海务部经理、船管部经理、体系主管。当海务部经理、船管部经
理不能参加时，应由其指定的人员代其进行评审。 
The recruitment and placement assessment plan is formulated by the crew department and implemented 
after review by the designated personnel and the general manager. The members of the assessment team 
should include the manager of the Marine Department, the manager of the Fleet Department, and the 
System Superintendent. When the manager of the Maritime Department and the manager of the Fleet 
Department cannot participate, the personnel designated by them shall conduct the review on their behalf.

第三十一章 相关方控制程序  
Chapter 31 Procedure for Management of Interested Parties 
 
1 
目的和范围 Purpose and application 
1.1 本程序规定了对可能产生环境影响/职业健康安全危险的相关方进行管理的方法和要
求，旨在保证公司环境、职业健康安全管理相关程序的正常运行； 
This procedure defines the methods and requirements for management of relevant parties which may 
produce hazards to the environment or to occupational health and safety management, and aims to 
ensure the normal operation of Company procedures for the environment and for occupational health & 
safety management. 
1.1 
本程序适用于与公司环境、职业健康安全管理有关的、涉及相关方的所有部门和船舶。 
This procedure applies to all departments and ships involved in the Company environment and 
occupational health & safety management, both of which are related to relevant parties. 
2 
定义和缩写Definitions and abbreviations 
2.1 
本程序采用公司《SMM-01总则》的有关定义和缩写及下述定义； 
The procedure adopts relative definitions and abbreviations in “SMM-01 General” and the following. 
2.2 
相关方：包括顾客、供方、公众及其它进入公司或船舶区域的个人或团体、港口装 
卸货工人。 
Interested parties mean persons or groups having access to the Company and ships, including customers, 
suppliers, public, and other personnel, stevedores. 
3 
职责 Responsibility 
3.1 
与相关方有业务关系的部门 
负责对与之有业务关系的相关方的环境、职业健康安全管理工作。 
The departments that conduct business with relevant parties shall be responsible for the management of 
the environment and occupational health management involved in relevant parties. 
3.2 
其他各相关部门 
公司各部门和船舶负责对进入本部门工作现场的外来人员的环境、职业健康安全管理
工作。 
Others departments and ship of the Company shall be responsible for the management of the 
environment and occupational health & safety management of visitors having access to its workplace. 
4 
工作程序 Procedure 
4.1 
船舶负责对外来维修商和供应商人员进行公司环境、职业健康安全知识的宣传，对外
来维修人员贯彻执行设备检修安全管理标准，防止事故的发生； 
The ship is responsible for publicizing the knowledge of Company environment and occupational

healthy management to visitors, and executing the safety maintenance standards to external repairmen 
and ship chandler in avoidance of accidents. 
1) 船长在服务商、供应商的服务人员登轮时，必须与他们签订《外来人员安全协议》
PRO-31-02； 
The Master shall sign “external personnel safety agreement” with service providers and 
suppliers when they are boarding （Refer to annex）. 
2) 船长必须根据供应商、服务商的服务性质限定其人员活动区域并安排专人监督其
活动，如果发现外来人员有不安全行为应立即制止，并报告公司。 
The Master shall limit the working area of service providers and suppliers in accordance with 
their service characters, and arrange specific seafarers to attend, if any unsafe activity is found, 
it shall be stopped immediately and report to the company. 
3) 船长必须留存《外来人员安全协议》，保存2年，岸基主管访船检查监督。 
The Master shall keep “external personnel safety agreement” for 2 years, which shall be 
inspected and supervised by shore-based superintendents during they visit the ship. 
4.2 
船员部负责对船员代理公司，外聘船员进行公司环境、职业健康安全管理知识宣传，
监督检查船员代理公司对国家法规、条例的执行情况，在签订合同时应尽可能包括劳
动保护用品的配备、发生事故的处理等内容等； 
Crewing Department is responsible for publicizing the knowledge of Company environment and 
occupational health & safety management to manning agents and crews employed from external parties, 
and monitoring the execution of national laws and regulations by manning agents. The contents of 
contract shall cover the protection equipment for crew and the disposal procedure of accidents as far as 
possible. 
4.3 
机务主管负责对修船相关方的管理，将公司对环境、职业健康安全的有关要求提交给
修船服务方，将《外来人员安全协议》的要求发给该修理商，通知修理商其服务人员
登轮时，必须和船方签订《外来人员安全协议》；并进行不定期的监督与检查，对违
反要求的及时指出； 
Technical Superintendent  is responsible for the management of shipyards, and shall submit relative 
requirements of Company environment and occupational health & “external personnel safety 
management” to the shipyard, notice shipyard that their service personnel must sign “external personnel 
safety management” with the vessel. And irregularly monitor and inspect its performance and promptly 
point out its violations. 
4.4 
机务主管安排船舶厂修时，对修船厂应提出包括环境保护、职业健康安全的要求。
Technical Superintendent and the ship shall make demands to the shipyard on environmental protection 
and occupational health & safety management during yard repair. 
4.5 
采购主管在采购前，应向供应商索要采购物品的环境方面特性以及安全性能指标和运
输、包装、贮存条件说明等信息，对供应商的评价应包括环境、职业健康安全要求。

对不符合要求的供应商，本公司将提出整改意见，对整改不符或拒绝整改、可能造成
严重环境污染和影响职业健康的企业，本公司将采取减少订货、更换供应商等措施施
加影响。采购主管必须通知所有的供应商，他们的服务人员登轮时必须和船方签订《外
来人员安全协议》； 
Purchasing Superintendent shall request the supplier for information on environmental-protection, 
safety indication, transportation, packing and storage prior to purchase. The evaluation on suppliers 
shall contain the requirements of the environment and occupational health. As for unqualified suppliers, 
the Company shall put forward corrective suggestions. The Company may reduce orders or change the 
supplier when the correction is not in conformity with the Company requirements or is not executed at 
all. Purchasing Superintendent shall notice all supplier that their service personnel must sign “external 
personnel safety management” with the vessel. 
4.6 
对相关方所提供的产品及产品的原材料、生产过程、服务应满足（或设法满足）国家、
地方、行业的有关环境/职业健康安全的法律、法规要求；在保证质量的前提下，减
少包装材料； 
The product, raw materials of product, production process and service provided by relevant parties shall 
meet (or manage to meet) the requirements of national, local and industry laws & regulations on the 
environment and occupational healthy. Reduction of packing materials shall be executed on the premise 
of quality assurance. 
4.7 
外来人员由对口接待的部门负责进行安全、环境宣传，并提出安全、环境技术要求；  
The reception department is responsible for publicizing safety and environmental protection to visitors 
and making demands on safety and environmental technology. 
4.8 
与相关方有业务关系的部门负责搜集整理相关方的合理抱怨、意见，并予以答复，处
理不了的向指定人员报告，直至问题的圆满解决； 
The departments that conduct business with relevant parties shall collect and summarize reasonable 
complaints and suggestions from relevant parties, and feed back the results. If the problem can not be 
resolved, it shall be reported to Designated Person Ashore until final resolution. 
4.9 
对合同方人员在本公司船舶上服务时所发生的险情或事故以及引起的时间损失应进
行统计、分析，此类安全简报传递给合同方； 
The near-misses or incidents take place when personnel of contracted parties are in service onboard the 
Company ships, as well as the resulting time loss shall be collected and analyzed. Such safety bulletins 
shall be sent to contracted parties. 
4.10 对相关方需定期评估，除了日常修理、供应时的反馈外，岸基机务、采购主管还需   进
行至少每年一次的合格修理商、供应商评估，评估结果按“PRO-25 船舶备件、物料

采购程序”、“PRO-28 船舶修理厂选择程序”处理。 
Regularly assess the demand of related party, in addition to the daily repair, supply feedback, 
shore-based technical and purchasing Superintendent of qualified shipyards and  suppliers evaluation 
at least once a year, evaluation results according to " Chapter 25 Ship Spares & Stores Purchasing 
Procedure "and " Chapter 28 Shipyard Selection Procedure ". 
5 
 船舶与装卸货工人 Ship and Stevedores 
5.1 装卸货前，船舶将根据“SHIP-07-01船舶货运安全管理条例”规定，船、岸（码头工
人负责人或代表）双方签署“散装船装卸船/岸检查表” “外来人员熟悉船舶检查”，
明确双方共同的责任，包括为解决货物操作期间装卸工人的安全问题，包括工前通报、
通道控制、监督、风险评估以及在出现不安全情况时启动停工授权。 
Before loading or unloading cargo, the  will, in accordance with the "SHIP-07-01 Safety Management 
Regulations for Cargo Shipping", have both the vessel and the shore (the person in charge or 
representative of the dock workers) sign the "Ship/Shore Safety Checklist" and the " Checklist For 
Visitors Familiarity With Ship", clarifying the common responsibilities of both parties, including 
addressing the safety issues of the stevedores during the cargo operation. This includes pre-work 
notification, access control, supervision, risk assessment, and the activation of Stop Work Authority in the 
event of unsafe situations. 
5.2 港口装卸货工人进入货舱作业，需要遵守体系“进入封闭处所的安全规定”。 
Stevedores entering the cargo hold for cargo operations must abide by the "Regulations on the Safety of 
Entry into Enclosed Spaces". 
5.3 当遇到装卸工人在货舱需要救助的情况，需要遵守体系“应急计划”中船舶应急操作
指南中“10.0封闭处所人员救助”来展开相应的救助。  
When encountering rescue situations of stevedores in the cargo hold, it is necessary to follow the "10.0 
Rescue people from enclosed space" in the ship emergency operation guidelines of the "Contingency 
Plan" to carry out corresponding rescue. 
 
6 
记录 Records 
6.1 相关协议、合同分别由责任部门或船舶负责保存，保存期不少于2年。 
The relevant department is responsible for maintaining the agreements and contracts at least for 2 years. 
6.2 《外来人员安全协议》External Personnel Safety Management          PRO-31-01 
6.3 外来人员熟悉船舶检查 Checklist For Visitors Familiarity With Ship     PRO-31-02
